title_en: Transmission and distribution network collaborative optimization method and system considering electric power and traffic multilayer network coupling model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cooperative optimization of transmission and distribution networks, in particular to a cooperative optimization method and a cooperative optimization system of transmission and distribution networks, which take an electric power and traffic multilayer network coupling model into consideration. Because the single-moment operation feasible region of the power distribution network is influenced by the current state parameters of the system, the method adopts a deep learning method to realize the prediction of the single-moment operation feasible region of the power distribution network, and simultaneously, the lower boundary of the operation feasible region of the power distribution network is approximately processed in order to improve the accuracy of the prediction.

title_en: Informer model improvement-based intelligent automobile charging load probability prediction method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent automobile charging load probability prediction method based on Informer model improvement, which comprises the steps of 1, collecting and arranging charging data of a relevant area, 2, improving an original model, designing a space-time multi-scale attention network (SMAN) module and a bidirectional interaction attention (DDI) module, 3, obtaining an accurate charging demand prediction model through training, calculating a prediction error, comparing with the prediction effect of other existing models, and 4, carrying out an ablation experiment, and comparing the improvement effects of different modules on model performance. And 5, realizing probability prediction of the charging load of the electric automobile, improving prediction precision and assisting power grid management. The invention creatively provides the SMAN and the DDI module based on Informer model, the SMAN module aims at solving the space-time dependency modeling problem in the charge load prediction, the prediction precision is obviously improved, the DDI module captures the space-time dependency relationship more effectively, and the accuracy of the dynamic charge demand prediction is further improved.

title_en: Mobile field survey system and method
title_ko: 모바일 현장조사 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a location-based mobile field survey method and a location-based mobile field survey system implementing the method, which comprises the steps of: viewing field information, stored in a field survey management system server, through a field survey application loaded on a terminal; inputting, into the field survey application, the field information such as the address of a field, the names of buildings or facilities around the field, and the name of the field, and receiving, from the field survey management system server, a field survey method type, selected from the group consisting of point inspection, node checking and route following, as the field survey method type of the field corresponding to the inputted field information; and transmitting, to the field survey management system server, a field survey result carried out according to a field type. According to the present invention, when a field survey on various urban elements such as urban infrastructures, buildings, transportation, cultural assets, and public facilities in a complex city is carried out, the information that should be continuously collected for a long time can be systematically and integratively managed, and an efficient monitoring system can be implemented.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 단말기에 탑재된 현장조사 앱을 통해 현장조사 관리시스템 서버에 저장된 현장정보를 열람하는 단계, 상기 현장조사 앱에 현장의 주소, 현장 주변 건물이나 시설물 이름, 현장의 지명 등과 같은 현장 정보를 입력하고, 상기 입력된 현장 정보에 대응되는 현장의 현장조사방법 유형으로서, point inspection, node checking 및 route following으로 이루어진 군에서 선택된 현장조사방법 유형을 상기 현장조사 관리시스템 서버로부터 제공받는 단계 및 상기 현장 유형에 따라 수행된 현장조사 결과를 상기 현장조사 관리시스템 서버에 전송하는 단계를 포함하는 위치기반 모바일 현장조사 방법 및 이러한 방법을 구현하는 위치기반 모바일 현장조사 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 복잡한 도시에서 도시 기반시설, 건축물, 교통, 문화재, 공공시설 등 다양한 도시 요소들에 대한 현장조사 수행에 있어서, 지속적이고 장기적으로 수집해야 할 정보를 체계적이고 통합적으로 관리할 수 있고, 효율적인 모니터링 시스템을 구현할 수 있다.

title_en: Dynamic contingency avoidance and mitigation system
abstract_en: Systems and methods for allocating resources within an infrastructure, such as an electrical grid, in response to changes to inputs and output demands on the infrastructure, such as energy sources and sinks. A disclosed system includes one or more processors, each having respective communication interfaces to receive data from the infrastructure, the data comprising infrastructure network data, one or more software applications, operatively coupled to and at least partially controlling the one or more processors, to process and characterize the infrastructure network data; and a display, coupled to aid one or more processors, for visually presenting a depiction of at least a portion of the infrastructure including any changes in condition thereof, and one or more controllers in communication with the one or more processors, to manage processing of the resource, wherein the resource is obtained and/or distributed based on the characterization of said real time infrastructure data.
assignees: UNIV COLUMBIA;ANDERSON ROGER N;BOULANGER ALBERT;JOHNSON JOHN A

title_en: Multi-station photovoltaic power generation power prediction method and system based on graph attention network
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-station photovoltaic power generation power prediction method and a system based on a graph attention network, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining a space dependency model containing a station space relationship according to the station dependency relationship based on the graph attention network; the method comprises the steps of constructing a time-dependent model containing site time relation based on an autoregressive long-term memory network and a probability framework, constructing a first missing data filling layer according to a spatial feature compensation strategy, constructing a second missing data filling layer according to a temporal feature compensation strategy, constructing a third missing data filling layer according to the space-time correlation of a neighbor site set, constructing a space-time data processing layer, and constructing a photovoltaic power generation power prediction model according to the spatial-dependent model, the time-dependent model and the time-space data processing layer by utilizing historical operation data of a photovoltaic site. The method has the beneficial effects of reducing the requirement on training data, improving the photovoltaic power generation power prediction pertinence, and improving the photovoltaic power generation power prediction accuracy and the model applicability.

title_en: Reverse powering system for telecommunications node
abstract_en:
To initiate the transmission of electrical power over a telecommunications connection 14 from a power-collecting telecommunications interface unit 16 such as a customer premises equipment, connectable to a power supply 18, to a power-receiving unit (22, Fig 4) such as a kerbside electrical/optical interface, when a connection 14 is first established, or the collecting unit is first powered up, or in order to re-establish connection after a power outage, control signals are transmitted between low-power modems 55 in the interface units using a low-power communications protocol. This allows the controlled initiation of a larger power output and a higher speed exchange of data once the full telecommunications connection has been established. A low-powered beacon signal is transmitted over the telecommunications connection 14 by the power-collecting telecommunications interface unit on connection to a power supply 18, for detection by the power-receiving telecommunications interface unit. 
     In the event of a loss of power at the input 18, the low power modem 55 initiates power management control signals to cause the power-receiving telecommunications interface to shut down certain functions in order to preserve backup power for essential "lifeline" services.

title_en: Urban lifeline waterlogging risk assessment rapid simulation method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid simulation method, a rapid simulation system and a storage medium for urban lifeline waterlogging risk assessment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining key data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-layer overlapped grid model comprising a ground surface layer, a subsurface pipe network layer and a life line facility layer based on key data, pre-calculating accumulated water depth distribution data under different rainfall intensities by using a numerical simulation method based on the multi-layer overlapped grid model, interpolating by using the pre-calculation method to obtain accumulated water depth values under the live rainfall intensities, overlapping the accumulated water depth values with the life line facility, calculating the flooding risk degree of the life line facility, and visually displaying the accumulated water depth distribution data and the flooding risk degree. According to the invention, the pre-calculation and the real-time interpolation of the ponding depth distribution under different rainfall conditions are realized, the accurate ponding depth distribution can be quickly obtained without complex real-time calculation under the live rainfall conditions, the simulation time is greatly shortened, and the high-efficiency technical support is provided for urban waterlogging emergency response.
assignees: NANJING HYDRAULIC RES INST;JIANGSU QINHUAI RIVER WATER CONSEVANCY ENG DIVISION;JIANGSU SURVEYING AND DESIGN INST OF WATER RESOURCES CO LTD

title_en: Power scheduling method and system based on multi-mode multi-agent RAG
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power dispatching method and a system based on a multi-mode multi-agent RAG, which are characterized in that a dispatching plan is generated through the cooperative work of a plurality of heterogeneous agents with different labor division, query input containing power dispatching tasks is received, and a planner agent decomposes the power dispatching tasks into a plurality of interdependent sub-tasks and generates a corresponding execution plan; according to the execution plan, the searcher agent sequentially executes two-stage fine-granularity multi-mode search from the multi-mode power knowledge base for each subtask, the first stage carries out coarse-granularity whole-page search, the second stage carries out fine-granularity regional fine reading and modal expansion, the evidence related to the current subtask is obtained and added into an evidence pool, and according to all the evidence in the evidence pool, the responder agent answers the initially input inquiry to generate a dispatching plan. The invention effectively solves the problems of timeliness and multi-scene adaptability in ultra-large scale power dispatching and provides an innovative path for guaranteeing dynamic safety and stability of the power grid.

title_en: Method for monitoring infrastructure, site facility and human health and safety by using earthquake sensor
abstract_en: The present disclosure describes systems, methods, and workflows for real-time monitoring of modern urban infrastructure, computer-implemented methods, computer software products, and machine learning models based on seismic data. The infrastructure includes bridges, highway tunnels, airports, buildings and wind power towers. Monitoring is not limited to recorded seismic data. The present disclosure also emphasizes the importance of utilizing seismic sensors to monitor various critical infrastructures, including security sites and manufacturing facilities, to promote security and security capabilities, to detect infrastructure health, and to prevent unauthorized intrusion. In addition, the seismic sensors may also be used for indoor human activity monitoring. Bridge monitoring involves continuous assessment to ensure structural integrity and extend service life, highway tunnel monitoring focuses on optimizing traffic conditions and monitoring structural images, airport monitoring helps to improve runway safety, ensures optimal performance of aviation infrastructure, reduces potential risks to the greatest extent, and improves overall safety and efficiency of aviation travel. By deploying seismic sensors to monitor building infrastructure, detection and localization of potential risks to the building structure can be achieved. Monitoring of wind power towers is critical to optimizing green energy production and ensuring structural health of fans. The monitoring of security and manufacturing sites aims to ensure the safety and security of facilities and prevent unauthorized intrusion. By monitoring and analyzing the seismic data of indoor human activity, different types of activity can be identified and events such as walking, falling, etc. detected. By adopting the seismic sensors and processing the seismic data in real time, the monitoring systems jointly improve the safety, security, toughness and reliability of key infrastructure in different fields.
assignees: SHENZHEN BAFANG DIDONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-region-oriented wind power, load and electricity price combined prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-region-oriented wind power, load and electricity price combined prediction method and system. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting wind power, load and electricity price data of a plurality of areas, obtaining relevant weather and geographical position information, processing the obtained data to form a characteristic input channel, then constructing multi-scale graph convolution by carrying out frequency decomposition on a Laplacian matrix of a graph, capturing multi-scale information in the characteristic channel, defining a new loss function and parameter updating rule to optimize model training, then sharing an intermediate characteristic layer, integrating intermediate characteristics of all target variables to form a shared characteristic matrix, inputting the shared characteristic matrix into the model for training, and finally outputting the wind power, the load and the electricity price target variables simultaneously. The method can extract the unique characteristics of each region, capture the interdependence between different regions and target variables, remarkably improve the prediction precision, and is suitable for the scenes of wind power output, load demand, electricity price prediction and the like of multiple regions.

title_en: Multi-layer coupling considered integrated modeling method for information physical system of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of information physical fusion of power systems and discloses an integrated modeling method of an information physical system of a power distribution network, which considers multi-layer coupling, and comprises the following steps of dividing system layers according to the entity architecture of the information physical system of the power distribution network, wherein the system layers comprise a physical layer, an information physical coupling layer and an information layer; the method comprises the steps of converting a physical architecture of a power distribution network information physical system into a graph theory model by using a complex network theory framework, characterizing system topology and functional interaction characteristics by establishing a multi-layer network structure, constructing a physical layer model, an information physical coupling layer model and an information layer model in a layered mode, describing coupling relations and association characteristics among all layers of models by using an association matrix, and accurately describing essential characteristics of a multi-layer heterogeneous system by considering coupling relations among multiple layers, so that dynamic regulation capacity and operation efficiency of the system are improved.

title_en: Method for establishing water-energy contact network model with close coupling relation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a water-energy connection network model with a close coupling relation, which comprises the steps of firstly respectively establishing a power transmission network model, a gas transmission network model, a heat supply network model and a water distribution network model; building a water-energy contact network model which is interdependent and acts on the basis of the four built models; the water-energy connection network model is expressed as a mixed integer nonlinear programming model, and is optimized and solved through an IPOPT solver. The method builds a water-energy contact network which is interdependent and acted, thereby improving the reliability and flexibility of the operation of the whole system.

title_en: Fire place smoke-removing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire scene smoke remover which can effectively eliminate the dense smoke and comprises a smoke removing chamber enclosed by a shell (1), an electric room positioned at the lower part of the shell (1) and a light activated switch (11) arranged at the upper part of the shell (1); wherein, the front wall of the chamber is provided with an air inlet while the side wall of the chamber is provided with an air outlet (6); two-track multi-layer networks (3, 4 ) are arranged in the chamber and between the air outlet (6) and the air inlet which is provided with a suction fan (2); the electric room is internally provided with a storage battery (5), a direct current voltmeter (7), an inverter (9), a high voltage direct current packet (10) and a buzzing alarm (12); direct current positive and negative electrodes of the high voltage direct current packet (10) are respectively connected with the two-track multi-layer networks (3, 4). When in use, the fire scene smoke remover can effectively eliminate the heavy smoke and lead people to see the escape direction clearly and to escape from the fire scene quickly.

title_en: Portable multifunctional life-saving rope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable multifunctional lifeline, which comprises: the life-saving rope comprises a storage bin and a life-saving rope body stored in the storage bin, wherein the life-saving rope body comprises a main steel rope, a floating body steel rope, an auxiliary steel rope, a floating ball, a retarder, a plurality of grabbing-assisting thin ropes and a sinking body steel rope. One end of the main steel rope is fixed on the inner wall of the storage bin, and the other end of the main steel rope is provided with the floating ball; 2 pieces of buffer devices are arranged on the main steel rope at intervals, and each buffer device is provided with two arms capable of gradually expanding; two ends of the floating body steel rope are respectively connected with the outer end of one arm of each retarder; two ends of the sinking steel rope are respectively connected with the outer end of the other arm of each retarder; the multiple grabbing-assisting thin ropes are interwoven in a net shape, and two ends of each grabbing-assisting thin rope are respectively connected with two arms of the two retarders or respectively connected with the floating body steel rope and the sinking body steel rope; a handle is arranged on the containing bin. The device is convenient to carry and simple to operate, is in a net shape after being unfolded, is convenient for a person falling into water to grasp, and is also convenient for a rescuer to rescue.

title_en: Electrical Safety Emergency Response Systems and Related Methods
abstract_en: An electrical safety system and method is provided which includes a flexible electrical safety vest, a lifeline coupled with the vest in various configurations, and leg straps. The electrical safety vest includes a number of loops which are used to couple the lifeline in a variety of relationships that enable different types of maneuvering of a worker with relation to a hazard. Various embodiments of the invention can be used to rapidly and safety remove a worker from proximity to an immediate threat to their life, health, or safety. Direct and indirect extraction from a danger are enabled. A variety of methods are also provided for operating various embodiments of the invention.

title_en: Multi-target library real-time data synchronization method for electric power metering
abstract_en: The invention provides a power metering-oriented multi-target library real-time data synchronization method which comprises the steps of constructing a metering data dependency model based on a power load curve theory, optimizing a multi-target scheduling strategy by utilizing an improved non-dominant sorting genetic algorithm, processing power data by applying an intelligent slicing and mixed compression strategy, executing synchronization based on a multi-level buffering strategy and a batch writing algorithm, and implementing multi-dimensional consistency verification and generating a layered restoration scheme. The scheme realizes the real-time synchronization of the power metering data with high efficiency, high reliability and low resource consumption, and provides a high-quality data base for the power grid dispatching decision.

title_en: A kind of horizontal rails device at shock insulation seam
abstract_en: A kind of horizontal rails device at shock insulation seam disclosed by the utility model, including left rotary shaft column steel pipe and right spindle column steel pipe, left built-in fitting and right built-in fitting, left flange plate and right ring flange, the dynamic steel pipe and dynamic steel pipe of right-hand rotation that turns left, several left horizontal steel tubes and several right horizontal steel tubes identical with left horizontal steel tube quantity.When an earthquake occurs, turn left to move steel pipe and dynamic steel pipe of turning right can be freely rotated, left horizontal steel tube and right horizontal steel tube is set smoothly to be moved in same straight line Free water always, to realize in seismic process, any direction movement can planar occur with both sides beam slab for the lifeline at shock insulation seam, and lifeline is in protection state always.

title_en: Urban lifeline pipeline risk identification method based on GIS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GIS-based urban lifeline pipeline risk identification method which comprises the steps of S1, collecting underground water initial data, metal mineral initial data, pipeline data, engineering longitude and latitude coordinates and population distribution map data, preprocessing, S2, extracting underground environment characteristics through a convolution layer, updating a preprocessed pipeline map model to obtain an updated pipeline map model, constructing an improved double-gate map neural network, extracting fusion characteristics of all pipelines, S3, extracting construction influence characteristics of the pipelines and population risk characteristics of the pipelines, combining the fusion characteristics of all the pipelines, extracting comprehensive risk characteristics, converting the comprehensive risk characteristics into risk grades, and S4, calculating the pipeline risk map model and identifying and displaying in a GIS platform. The method can solve the problems that the traditional method has low inspection efficiency, is difficult to combine multi-source heterogeneous data, and further cannot realize accurate risk identification of urban lifeline pipelines.

title_en: Risk management support system for gas infrastructure
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a risk management support system for gas infrastructure to determine social risk generated by the gas construction based on gas construction information performed on a lifeline forming a gas infrastructure.  <P>SOLUTION: The risk management support system (100) for gas infrastructure includes a storage section (150) for storing a gas construction risk master table (152) for matching gas construction with the risk at a point where the gas construction is performed and gas construction risk link information (154) for matching the gas construction with the risk at at least one remote place separated from the point caused by the gas construction, an information acquiring section (112) for acquiring the gas construction information, and a risk calculating section (114) for calculating social risk generated by an objective construction included in the gas construction information referring to the table and link information based on the acquired gas construction information.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Information processing method, information processing apparatus, and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To perform prior and sequential analysis of works for recovering lifelines when disaster, such as an earthquake and a typhoon occurs.SOLUTION: A local information storage part 120 stores local data 10. An electric power distribution facility information storage part 130 stores electric power distribution facility data 20. A commander simulation part 141, a patrolman simulation part 142, and a recovery person simulation part 143 refer to the local information storage part 120 and the electric power distribution facility information storage part 130, and simulate works done by a commander, a patrolman, and a recovery person, respectively. The recovery person simulation part 143 simulates moving of the recovery person to a disaster place and command waiting from the commander.

title_en: Wind power plant prediction model construction method and system based on space-time correlation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a wind power plant prediction model based on time-space correlation, wherein a time-space dependency method for wind field multi-fan space lattice wind speed prediction is explored by using wind power plant position information and actually measured wind speed data; establishing a wind field multi-fan wind speed probabilistic prediction model combining space-time typical characteristic parameters and current fan operation state monitoring by combining a dependency model of typical wind field fan group wind speed tracking measurement and wind field multi-fan space lattice wind speed prediction; on the basis, a wind speed probabilistic prediction method of multiple wind turbines of a wind power plant on different time scales is researched. An effective analysis tool is provided for forecasting the wind speed field of the multi-fan in the complex terrain and climate variable environment, and the running efficiency of the fan is promoted to be improved.

title_en: Underground utilities managing system
title_ko: 지하 전기선로 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an underground electric line management system. That is, the present invention relates to a system device for managing a buried object such as an electric line buried underground, and a buried object such as an electric line, a communication line, and the like is an infrastructure of a city and is a very important element for maintaining the city. Such buried objects are generally buried and installed underground in order to be safely protected and to meet complex requirements such as the environment and urban aesthetics. In addition, an electronic recognition indicator recognized through an rfid tag is used to check the buried location required for renovation construction, maintenance, etc.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하 전기선로 관리 시스템에 대한 것이다. 즉, 지하에 매립되는 전기선로 등 매설물을 관리하기 위한 시스템 장치에 관한 것으로서, 매설물 예컨대 전기선로, 통신선로 등은 도시의 기반시설이며 도시를 유지하는 매우 중요한 요소이다. 이러한 매설물은 안전하게 보호되기 위해서, 그리고 환경이나 도시 미관 등의 복합적인 요건을 충족하기 위해서 일반적으로 지하에 매립되어 설치된다. 그리고 개보수 공사, 유지보수 등에 필요한 매립 위치를 확인하기 위하여 RFID태그를 통하여 인식되는 전자인식표시기를 활용한다.

title_en: Remote fee control system and method for checking power failure instruction of remote fee control ammeter in compliance
abstract_en: A remote fee control system and a method for checking power failure instructions of a remote fee control ammeter in compliance are disclosed, wherein a marketing system is used for calculating and deducting the interdependence relationship between upstream and downstream business processes when power is saved, and a fee control instruction checking module is arranged in a metering automation system to check the compliance of the remote fee control instructions sent by the marketing system. The marketing system calculates the issue deduction electricity consumption according to the meter reading day freezing data, forms a remote cost control electricity stop user list, and sends a remote cost control electricity meter power stop instruction after business approval is completed; and the metering automation system checks the electricity charge according to the freezing data of the meter reading date, and judges and sends a power failure instruction of the remote charge control electricity meter or gives an alarm according to whether the electricity charge is actually owed. Therefore, the power failure instruction of the remote fee control electric meter issued by the marketing system is subjected to compliance inspection in the metering automation system, and the power failure accident of a user caused by violation and misoperation can be effectively avoided.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Comprehensive information management service system suitable for small-scale operator
abstract_en: The method is suitable for a comprehensive information management service system of a small-scale operator. The patent is used as a pioneer of a global small-scale operator comprehensive information management service system, forms a great leading position in the industry on the aspects of technology, completion degree, specialty degree and comprehensive performance, and has obvious characteristics. It mainly includes seven major centers of fund flow management system, stock receiving and dispatching system, commodity code scanning and trading system, customer management system, supplier management system, tourism information management system and financial management system. All subsystems in the system are interdependent and linked to form a powerful and efficient management system. With the complication of social business environment and the high-speed development of internet, mobile phone hardware equipment and software technology, it is important to bring the function and concept of the comprehensive information management system to the small-scale operator. It can help them improve financial performance, risk control awareness and ability to cope with emergency events.

title_en: The interdependent deposit system network attack methods of risk assessment of power distribution network CPS based on attacker visual angle
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of interdependent deposit system network attack methods of risk assessment of the power distribution network CPS based on attacker visual angle, from attacker's angle, analysis is for risk level caused by the attack of power grid cps system mounts premised on different attack invasion purposes, analyze the risk situation in power grid potential attack path, new visual angle can be provided for the safety analysis of power grid cps and means of defence research, formulate defensive measure for power grid operation personnel and accurate foundation is provided.

title_en: System and method of mobile field inspection
title_ko: 모바일 현장조사 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko:

title_en: Intelligent management and control method and system for risk of switching misoperation of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation switching misoperation risk intelligent management and control method and system, which relate to the technical field of safety production of electric power systems and comprise the steps of collecting multidimensional real-time risk factor data, constructing a dynamic probability dependency model based on the risk factor data, quantifying the association influence among different dimensionalities and updating model parameters, converting characteristic information of a current operation scene into a standardized vector, carrying out similarity matching with a scene template, screening an adaptive basic strategy, dynamically adjusting the basic strategy according to a real-time risk assessment result to generate a scene risk management and control strategy, implementing the scene risk management and control strategy, collecting multidimensional feedback data in the executing process, generating a new generation of optimization strategy based on the feedback data, and updating a strategy library. According to the invention, the risk management and control strategy is generated and regulated according to the actual situation, the strategy is continuously optimized, the safety and reliability of switching operation of the transformer substation are improved, accidents caused by misoperation are reduced, and the stable operation of the power grid is ensured.

title_en: Dangerous perception guidance system of the member's store using the value-added network
title_ko: 밴사의 통신망을 이용한 가맹점의 위험감지 안내시스템
abstract_en: A danger sensing and guidance system for member stores using the VAN(Value-Added Network) is provided to offer a danger sensing and guidance service using a communication network connected to a control panel which operates, and controls various sensors installed in member stores and a danger sensing and guidance server connected to the control panel through the communication network. A danger sensing and guidance system for member stores using the VAN includes a danger sensor(10), a controller(20), a credit card inquiry terminal(30) and a VAN server(40). The danger sensor is installed in a member store, senses a danger in the member store and generates a danger sensing signal corresponding to the danger. The controller receives the danger sensing signal and processes the danger sensing signal into a danger generation signal. The credit card inquiry terminal stores identification information of the member store, receives the danger generation signal from the controller and combines the danger generation signal and the identification information. The VAN server receives the danger generation signal combined with the identification information from the credit card inquiry terminal and notifies a terminal(50) of a fire station or a police station of the danger of the member store.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 가맹점주에게 위험감지 안내서비스를 제공 시 별도의 기반시설의 구축 없이도 제공이 가능한 밴사의 통신망을 이용한 가맹점의 위험감지 안내시스템에 관한 것으로, 가맹점에 설치되는 것으로 가맹점 내에 위험이 감지된 경우 이를 위험감지신호로 생성하는 위험감지센서부(10)와, 상기 침입감지센서(11)로부터 생성된 위험감지신호를 전송받아 위험발생신호로 가공하는 컨트롤러(20)와, 해당 가맹점을 식별하는 식별정보인 가맹점 식별정보가 기저장된 것으로 상기 컨트롤러(20)로부터 위험발생신호를 전송받아 그 전송된 위험발생신호에 상기 가맹점 식별정보를 취합하는 신용카드조회단말기(30)와, 상기 신용카드조회단말기(30)로부터 가맹점 식별정보가 취합된 위험발생신호를 전송받아 해당 위험을 제압하는 위험제압업체가 운영하는 업체단말기(50)로 해당 가맹점의 위험이 통보되도록 제어하는 VAN사 서버(40)로 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.  
       
     신용카드조회단말기, 화재감지, 가스누출, 위험감지 안내, VAN사

title_en: Functional recovery decision-making method of interdependent hydropower system based on flexible city
abstract_en: The invention discloses a functional recovery decision-making method of an interdependent hydropower system based on a flexible city, which comprises the following steps: s1, initializing data: s2, randomly generating a plurality of sequences of the serial numbers of the damage components, wherein the sequences are used as chromosomes, namely an initial population, setting identity codes of chromosome slices and an information pool of the integral hydroelectric function level in a corresponding damage state, and setting the iteration times of a genetic algorithm; s3, judging whether the identity code of the chromosome slice to be evaluated exists in the information pool or not: if the water-electricity integral function level exists, the water-electricity integral function level in the information pool is directly called; otherwise, calculating to obtain the integral function level of the hydropower; and S4, operating the chromosome to obtain the next generation of chromosomes, and selecting the optimal chromosome based on the adaptive function value if the iteration times are reached. The method can meet the requirement of time urgency of recovery after disasters when optimizing the function recovery decision method of the interdependent hydropower system, thereby being really applied to actual disaster scenes.

title_en: Underground utilities managing system
title_ko: Rfid태그 이용 매설물 관리 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an underground facility management device using an RFID tag. More specifically, the underground facility management device using an RFID tag comprises: an electronic identification tag including a fixture fixed to a buried object to be managed, a string attached to the fixture, and an RFID tag unit fixed to the string; an electronic identification reader configured to communicate with the RFID tag in the RFID tag unit via the LF band and read information from the electronic identification tag; a GIS configured to exchange necessary information regarding the buried object with the electronic identification reader; and a GPS configured to provide location information of the buried object to the electronic identification reader. With this configuration, when a plurality of buried objects of different types are buried underground, an electronic identification tag incorporating a unique RFID tag can be installed for each buried object so as to enable each buried object to be identified without confusion.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 RFID태그 이용 매설물 관리 장치에 관한 것으로서 더욱 구체적으로는, 지하에 매설되어서 관리대상이 되는 매설물에 고정되는 고정체와, 상기 고정체에 부착되는 스트링과, 상기 스트링체 고정되는 RFID태그유니트로 이루어진 전자인식표시기와,  
상기 RFID태그유니트 내의 RFID태그와 LF대역으로 무선 통신하는 RFID리더로서의 기능을 가지고 상기 전자인식표시기의 정보를 판독하는 전자인식판독기와,  
상기 전자인식판독기와, 매설물에 관한 필요 정보를 교환하는 GIS와,  
상기 전자인식판독기에 상기 매설물의 위치정보를 제공하는 GPS를 포함하여 구성된다.  
이러한 구성을 통하면, 지중에 종류가 다른 다수의 매설물이 매설된 경우에는, 각 매설물 별로 고유의 RFID태그를 내장하는 전자인식표시기를 설치하여서 타 매설물과 혼돈하지 않고 구분을 할 수 있다.  
여기서, 매설물 예컨대 전기선로, 통신선로, 도시가스관, 상하수도관 등은 도시의 기반시설이며 도시를 유지하는 핵심요소이고 이러한 매설물은 안전하게 보호되기 위해서, 그리고 환경이나 도시 미관 등의 복합적인 요건을 충족하기 위해서 일반적으로 지하에 매립되어 설치된다.

title_en: Power outage and restoration notification in an advanced metering infrastructure network
abstract_en: A method and system are provided to transmit a meter power status. The method includes recognizing a power status change at a meter. The method includes, if the meter is scheduled to transmit first, transmitting a notification message to at least one neighboring meter towards a mesh gate, wherein the notification message includes a power status indicator and a meter identifier. The method includes, if the meter is not scheduled to transmit first, waiting a predetermined time period to receive a notification message from at least one neighboring meter. The method includes, responsive to receiving a notification message, adding a meter identifier to the received notification message before retransmitting the modified notification message to at least one neighboring meter. The method includes retransmitting the notification message.

title_en: Power supply system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a power supply system which can promptly determine damages at an occurrence of disaster to perform countermeasure to cope with the damages.SOLUTION: A server 12 predicts a damage situation such as collapse or damage of a building, and electric outrage on the basis of: prior information (e.g. power generation amount, power consumption in a high-rise apartment district 18, power consumption in a low-rise apartment district 20, height of the building, age of the building, structure, installation ground or district, number of vehicles 24 in the high-rise apartment building 18, number of vehicles 24 in the low-rise apartment building 20, etc.,); and disaster information (seismic intensity of earthquake, flood damage information, etc.,). Locations requiring a lifeline, and amounts thereof are predicted, and then countermeasure against disaster (prioritization of electric power generated by a large-scale photovoltaic power plant 14 and power supplied from grid-connected power 16, shifting of vehicles for power source) is determined to supply the required locations with the required amounts.

title_en: Planning method, device and equipment for disaster-resistant bottom-protecting power grid
abstract_en: The application discloses a planning method, a device and equipment of an anti-disaster and bottom-protecting power grid, which form a lifeline channel of a cable-outdoor station-cable-indoor station by constructing a minimum-scale power grid basic network frame, can provide reliable power supply for a local power grid, simultaneously, an anti-disaster and bottom-protecting power supply serving as a main power supply has black start and isolated network operation capacity, is directly connected into a key transformer substation, aims to improve the self-balancing operation capacity of the local power grid, selects the key transformer substation to dispersedly configure energy storage power stations for the power grid basic network frame, integrates the power grid basic network frame, the anti-disaster and bottom-protecting power supply, the energy storage power stations and power supply loads, forms an anti-disaster and bottom-protecting power grid scheme of an anti-disaster area to be planned, can comprehensively consider the power grid, the power supply, the loads and the energy storage, plan and construct a high-reliability anti-disaster power grid, so that the power grid of an important area of a coastal city can locally and self-balancing operation during a severe natural disaster core period, the emergency disaster-resistant guarantee capability of the power grid in the core area is strong.

title_en: A kind of information physical emerging system vulnerability assessment method under cascading failure mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of information physical emerging system vulnerability assessment methods under cascading failure mode, include the following steps: S1, according to Complex Networks Theory, establish information layer model and physical layer model；S2, according to information layer model and physical layer model, the dependence of Information Level and physical layer is modeled using interdependent theory, obtains coupling model；S3, according to coupling model, electric power CPS cascading failure is modeled using seepage theory, whole surviving nodes of output coupling model；S4, vulnerability assessment index is established, and according to the surviving node of vulnerability assessment index and coupling model, the fragility of electric power CPS is assessed；The present invention solves the problems, such as that step of the existing technology is complicated, validity is low, practicability is low and lacks versatility, avoids the serious consequence of power loss, causes huge economic loss and social influence.
assignees: INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION COMPANY STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Method and system for building urban traffic lifeline in extreme rainstorm weather
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for constructing an urban traffic lifeline in extreme rainstorm weather, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out rainstorm waterlogging simulation; removing inland inundation failure road sections, carrying out traffic simulation on the retained effective road network, and obtaining severely congested road sections; analyzing urban road accident black points according to the traffic accident data to obtain high-risk road sections; identifying an initial traffic lifeline set by combining the results of rainstorm waterlogging simulation, traffic simulation and urban road accident black spot analysis; and judging whether the traffic lifeline set meets the expected requirement, if so, outputting the urban traffic lifeline set in the extreme rainstorm weather, otherwise, perfecting drainage and waterlogging prevention facilities by taking the recovery of the use function of the part of the failed road sections as a target, and re-identifying the corrected traffic lifeline set until the corrected traffic lifeline set meets the requirement. The method and the system are beneficial to identifying and improving the urban traffic lifeline and improving the anti-catastrophe capability of the urban traffic in extreme rainstorm weather.
assignees: FUZHOU PLANNING & DESIGN RES INSTITUTE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power backup system
abstract_en:
An electrically powered node 3 of a telecommunications system has a battery power backup 37 associated with its power control unit 33. Under normal conditions it are maintained fully charged by means of trickle currents from the mains power feeds 14 to each of a number of mains- connected customer equipments 4, by way of the "final drop" 10 to the distribution point. These trickle currents are controlled by the respective power control units 33, 43, to prevent overcharging. Using an electrical copper connection 19 provided in parallel with the fibre connection 9, a battery backup 27 can also be maintained in nodes 2 further towards the exchange. 
     These feeds are made reversible, so that if a power outage removes the power supply 14 from the customer premises 4, a "lifeline" plain telephone service between the exchange 1 and the telephone handset 5 is maintained over the connections 9, 10, 13, using the local battery backup 27, 37 in the remote nodes 2, 3. By limiting the service to simple telephony, the battery power 27, 37, 47 can be sufficient to maintain the service for a reasonable duration. 
     The power management systems 23, 33, 43 can be used to transfer charge from one battery 27, 37 to another over the network according to the usage, or remaining life, of each battery 27, 37, 47.

title_en: System and method for power outage and restoration notification in an advanced metering infrastructure network
Reverse powering system for telecommunications node
abstract_en: To initiate the transmission of electrical power over a telecommunications connection (14) from a power-collecting telecommunications interface unit (16) such as a customer premises equipment, connectable to a power supply (18), to a power-receiving unit (22, Fig 4) such as a curbside electrical/optical interface, when a connection (14) is first established, or the collecting unit is first powered up, or in order to re-establish connection after a power outage, control signals are transmitted between low-power modems (55) in the interface units using a low-power communications protocol. This allows the controlled initiation of a larger power output and a higher speed exchange of data once the full telecommunications connection has been established. A low-powered beacon signal is transmitted over the telecommunications connection (14) by the power-collecting telecommunications interface unit on connection to a power supply (18), for detection by the power-receiving telecommunications interface unit. In the event of a loss of power at the input (18), the low power modem (55) initiates power management control signals to cause the power-receiving telecommunications interface to shut down certain functions in order to preserve backup power for essential "lifeline" services.

title_en: Fire extinguishment device for small scale building
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a sprinkler device having initial extinguishment performance, ensuring drinking water by efficiently using service water, and having installment space diversity by solving problems such as: shortage of pressure and water amount of service water in spite of being an assumption, occurring in most cases at a sprinkler facility utilizing service water for small scale building; shortage of an installation space of the facility in an existing building; and a lifeline cutoff in a large scale disaster.SOLUTION: Water amount is ensured by connection of sprinkler pipings by switching a control valve of service water piping brought into at least two houses. Or, a water reservoir of service water is arranged, water amount for an initial extinguishment is secured with a water storage type water supply device by compressing inactive gas or compressed air, and means for feeding service water in combination and sharing of the water reservoir by houses and a piping type water reservoir are arranged so as to correspond to installation space diversity. The device functions even for one house and can keep drinking water storage function and the water amount for the initial extinguishment.

title_en: Urban lifeline waterlogging risk assessment rapid simulation method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid simulation method, a rapid simulation system and a storage medium for urban lifeline waterlogging risk assessment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining key data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-layer overlapped grid model comprising a ground surface layer, a subsurface pipe network layer and a life line facility layer based on key data, pre-calculating accumulated water depth distribution data under different rainfall intensities by using a numerical simulation method based on the multi-layer overlapped grid model, interpolating by using the pre-calculation method to obtain accumulated water depth values under the live rainfall intensities, overlapping the accumulated water depth values with the life line facility, calculating the flooding risk degree of the life line facility, and visually displaying the accumulated water depth distribution data and the flooding risk degree. According to the invention, the pre-calculation and the real-time interpolation of the ponding depth distribution under different rainfall conditions are realized, the accurate ponding depth distribution can be quickly obtained without complex real-time calculation under the live rainfall conditions, the simulation time is greatly shortened, and the high-efficiency technical support is provided for urban waterlogging emergency response.

title_en: A kind of lifesaving appliance
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of lifesaving appliance, comprise the mounting box of a hollow, mounting box front side plate is connected with one by hinge, grip handle is provided with in the outside of door, one end in the inner side of door away from hinge is provided with a card convex, mounting box front side plate is provided with a draw-in groove matched with card convex away from the position that one end of hinge is relative with card convex, door is movably arranged on mounting box by hinge, door is interlockingly connected by card convex and draw-in groove and mounting box activity, a piling bar is vertically provided with in mounting box, a link is provided with above piling bar, link is connected with the lifeline of the hollow of a belt lock catch, by arranging draw ring on lifeline, drowning people is facilitated to catch life saving appliance, by rescue disembarkation, in addition, rescuer need not descend water to succour drowning people, avoids the danger that rescue worker causes because of rescue drowning people, moreover, be located at the mounting box of life saving appliance outside, extend the service life of life saving appliance, reduce public measures maintenance cost.

title_en: Optimization method for coupling operation of multi-energy network and water distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization method for coupling operation of a multi-energy network and a water distribution network, which comprises the steps of firstly, establishing a water-energy contact operation model which is interdependent and acted according to the coupling relation among the water distribution network, a power transmission network, a gas transmission network and a heat distribution network in a multi-energy system; the built model is a dual-target operation model of energy and resources; a double-objective decision framework is adopted to realize fair balance between two targets of energy and resources, and the water-energy connection operation model is expressed as a mixed integer nonlinear model; and processing a double-target competition relationship in the water-energy association operation model by using a double-target optimized Nash bargaining method, so as to realize the optimization of the coupling operation of the multi-energy network and the water distribution network. The method can realize the balance between the energy production cost and the water resource consumption, and provides a solution for the coordination and optimization under the comprehensive operation of energy and resources.

title_en: Urban lifeline water, electricity, gas and heat early warning management and analysis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of city management, and discloses a city lifeline water, electricity, gas and warm early warning management analysis system which comprises a control center, wherein the control center consists of a data processing system and an execution system, the data processing system comprises a data collection module, the execution system comprises an instruction issuing module, the data collection module consists of an online data collection module and an offline data collection module, the control center also comprises a server, the output end and the input end of the server are connected with the output end and the input end of the data processing system, and the output end and the input end of the data collection module are connected with a data uploading module. According to the invention, the data collection module consists of the online data collection module and the offline data collection module, and bidirectional data collection is carried out by the online data collection module and the offline data collection module, so that the stability and accuracy of data collection are ensured, and the follow-up work can be more accurate and complete.
assignees: HENAN DONGLU HIGH TECH IND CO LTD

title_en: Fault Detection and Diagnosis System of Sensors Network for Critical Infrastructure System
title_ko: 주요기반설비의 센서 망에 대한 고장 탐지 및 원인 진단 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a failure detection and diagnosis system of a city gas pipe network comprising: a receiving part (110) for receiving measured value data from a SCADA system (100) installed for data collection of a city gas pipe network by one method from among csv, MYSQL, and MS-SQL; a preprocessing module (120) for removing noise of the received data with a bandband filter and an index weighted moving average filter; a failure detection module (130) for detecting a failure of a measurement sensor when the failure determination index is greater than that of a failure determination upper limit value by using an SPE failure determination index derived from a PCA model, which is a multivariate statistical analysis technique, for data from which noise is removed from the measured value received from the preprocessing module (120); a failure block diagnosis module (140) for identifying a block comprising a failure sensor through an erroneous instruction correction-based algorithm derived from the PCA model when the measurement sensor failure is detected by the failure detection module (130); a failure sensor diagnosis module (150) for identifying a failure sensor through the erroneous instruction correction-based algorithm derived from the PCA model from among sensors included in the block identified by the failure block diagnosis module (140); and a transmission part (160) for transmitting a sensor failure diagnosis result determined by the failure sensor diagnosis module (150) to a terminal (200). In an embodiment of the present invention, an accident, wherein the city gas supply to the end consumer is stopped, can be reduced by the occurrence of the city gas pressure drop due to a delay in failure identification, thereby reducing customer dissatisfaction.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 CIS의 하나인 도시가스 배관망의 고장 탐지 및 진단 시스템에 관한 것으로,  수신부(110), 수신한 데이터의 잡음을 제거하는 전처리 모듈(120), 상기 전처리 모듈(120)로부터 제공받은 측정값에서 잡음이 제거된 데이터에 대해 다변량통계분석 기법인 PCA 모델로부터 도출된 소정의 수식을 이용하여 측정센서의 고장을 탐지하는 고장탐지 모듈(130), 상기 고장탐지 모듈(130)에서 측정센서 고장이 탐지되면, 다중블록 PCA(MBPCA)  모델로부터 도출된 소정의 수식을 통해 고장센서가 포함된 블록을 식별하는 고장블록 진단 모듈(140), 상기 고장블록 진단 모듈(140)에서 식별한 블록에 포함된 센서들을 대상으로 PCA 모델로부터 도출된 소정의 수식을 통해 고장센서를 식별하는 고장센서 진단 모듈(150), 상기의 고장센서 진단 모듈(150)에서 결정한 센서 고장 진단 결과를 단말기(200)로 보내는 송신부(160)를 포함한다. 본 발명의 실시예에서, 객관적인 성능 지수를 개발하여 PCA와 비교하여 성능이 개선될 경우에만 MBPCA를 사용하도록 하여 도시가스 배관망의 고장 탐지 및 진단 시스템의 성능을 높일 수 있다.

title_en: Evacuation building
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an evacuation building capable of being used as an emergency evacuation destination when a tsunami or a flood occurs and maintaining a function of a building body by reliably preventing the same from being destroyed or inundated.SOLUTION: An evacuation building A to be used as an evacuation destination when a tsunami or a flood occurs comprises: an external peripheral pressure resistant wall 1 which extends in an entire circumferential direction, has a height higher than a maximum water level preliminarily set against the tsunami or the flood and is provided with pressure resistance performance to resist water pressure and an impact due to a floating object; and a building body 2 which is constructed inside the external peripheral pressure resistant wall 1 and is provided with a lifeline function. The external peripheral pressure resistant wall 1 has parapet sections 6 which are outwardly projected from an outer face thereof and extended along the entire circumferential direction.

title_en: Establishment and operation method of emergency communication system in a massive disaster situation
title_ko: 재난 상황에서의 긴급통신 시스템의 구축 및 운용 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method to establish and operate an emergency communication system in a situation that part or entire communication system malfunctions due to a natural disaster or a massive accident by propagating the disaster situation, rapidly establishing an emergency communication network and operate a system in an emergency communication mode, performing operation to recognize locations of victims and simultaneously providing a group communication function to command and control rescue agents when a communication life-line needs to be established and maintained to rescue the victims with minimum power consumption. Also, a method according to an embodiment of the present invention makes remote control of victims terminal possible in case of emergency by extending the conception of a public warning system (PWS). As such, base stations and terminals operating in an emergency mode can be operated in a minimum power-consumption mode. Also, a method according to an embodiment of the present invention performs a function to recognize locations of the victims by additionally performing functions related to accurate positioning and a function to increase a survival rate of the victims and victims′ terminals.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자연 재해/재난 또는 대형 사고에 의하여 통신 인프라가 일부 또는 전체가 와해된 상황에서, 신속하게 긴급통신망을 구축하여 재난상황을 전파하고, 긴급통신모드로서 시스템을 동작한다. 피해자들의 위치를 파악하기 위한 동작을 수행하고, 시스템이 최소한의 전력을 소모하며 피해자의 구조를 위한 통신생명선 (communication life-line)을 구축 및 유지하기 위한  필요 시, 재난안전 요원들의 지휘통제를 위한 그룹통신 기능의 동시 제공  시스템의 구축 및 그 운용 방법을 제시한다. 기본적으로 PWS (Public Warning System)의 개념을 확장하여, 긴급 재난상황에서의 피해자 단말을 원격 제어할 수 있도록 한다. 이를 통하여, 긴급모드로 운용되는 기지국 및 단말이 최소 전력 모드로서 운용될 수 있도록 한다. 또한, 단말의 위치에 대한 정밀 측위와 관련된 기능들을 추가적으로 수행하여, 피해자의 위치를 파악하고, 추가적으로 피해자 및 피해자 단말의 생존성을 높이는 기능을 수행한다.

title_en: Marine fire-fighting life-saving box with life cable
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a marine fire-fighting lifesaving case with lifeline, including fire-fighting lifesaving case body and stopper, the equal fixedly connected with gasbag in upper and lower surface of fire-fighting lifesaving case body, the equal fixedly connected with device box in the left and right sides of fire-fighting lifesaving case body, the transversal fretwork state of personally submitting of device box, one side that the fire-fighting lifesaving case body was kept away from to the device box all sets up porosely and has emboliaed the slide, the transversal rectangle of personally submitting of slide, the slide is located the inside one end fixedly connected with spring of device box, the quantity of spring is two and is the upper and lower symmetrical state, the inside fixed connection of spring and device box. Through the arrangement of the air bag, the device box, the sliding plate, the spring, the wheels, the bending plate, the limiting block and the life cable, the beneficial effect that people falling into water can float in water is achieved, the beneficial effect that the people falling into water are drowned in water is avoided, and the advantage that the people falling into water timely return to the ship side is achieved.

title_en: Fresh drinking water tank during drinking water lifeline cutoff and damage due to earthquake or disaster
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a water tank securing fresh water capable of coping with disaster.SOLUTION: A box body 3 in which a long thin water conducting pipe 4 is tightly folded and packed is installed midway between a water meter and a faucet. As all daily household supply water runs through the water conducting pipe 4, water exchange or antiseptic agents are not necessary and fresh water runs to be stocked in the box body 3 until an instance of disaster. When the box body 3 tilts or collapses from a normal installation position due to the disaster, inlet/outlet pipe is shielded instantaneously and the fresh water in the box body 3 is secured without leaking until the water is used.

title_en: A kind of coastal area is guaranteed the minimum rack construction method
abstract_en: It guarantees the minimum rack construction method this application discloses a kind of coastal area, comprising: obtain the key subscriber information for being located at the target cities of coastal area；Obtain the supplying channels information of each key user in the key subscriber information；According to the supplying channels information, the high reliability channel part of each supplying channels is inquired, and determines the start node of each high reliability channel part；According to the power demands of the corresponding key user of the high reliability channel part, energy-accumulating power station is set at the start node of the high reliability channel part, the energy storage configuration of the energy-accumulating power station is matched with the power demands；Solve how to make coastal area guarantee the minimum rack high reliability power supply " lifeline " channel, construct typhoon disaster under self-balancing run partial electric grid the technical issues of.

title_en: Active power distribution network forward push back generation tide optimization calculation method, medium and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forward push back generation tide optimization calculation method, medium and equipment for an active power distribution network, which relate to the technical field of power distribution network analysis, operation and control, and are characterized in that an active power distribution network is constructed based on a physical connection structure of the active power distribution network, and layered to obtain a multi-layer network; predicting iteration times based on parameters of a multi-layer network and corresponding association coefficients to obtain the lowest iteration times, calculating a PV node sensitivity impedance matrix based on all node attributes in the network, judging whether the current iteration times reach the lowest iteration times after forward-pushing back substitution is carried out on the active power distribution network, stopping iteration based on node voltage convergence or iteration times upper limit judgment if the current iteration times reach the lowest iteration times, obtaining a calculation result, and continuing iteration if the current iteration times do not reach the lowest iteration times. By means of the minimum iteration number prediction, the efficient PV node sensitivity impedance matrix construction method and the dynamic optimized relaxation factor, on the premise of guaranteeing calculation accuracy, efficiency and robustness of forward push back power flow calculation of the active power distribution network are remarkably improved.

abstract_en: To provide a town structure that can realize efficient, effective and flexible infrastructure network construction and urban development resistant to disasters or the like, and can also facilitate urban redevelopment plans or the like, thereby improving convenience of future urban use.SOLUTION: A main street area 4 which longitudinally crosses and/or traverses town areas 1, 2, 3 is provided, and an energy plant facility and a lifeline infrastructure facility for supplying at least power and gas on the ground and/or underground of a main street area 4 are also provided. title_en: Multi-region-oriented wind power, load and electricity price combined prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-region-oriented wind power, load and electricity price combined prediction method and system. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting wind power, load and electricity price data of a plurality of areas, obtaining relevant weather and geographical position information, processing the obtained data to form a characteristic input channel, then constructing multi-scale graph convolution by carrying out frequency decomposition on a Laplacian matrix of a graph, capturing multi-scale information in the characteristic channel, defining a new loss function and parameter updating rule to optimize model training, then sharing an intermediate characteristic layer, integrating intermediate characteristics of all target variables to form a shared characteristic matrix, inputting the shared characteristic matrix into the model for training, and finally outputting the wind power, the load and the electricity price target variables simultaneously. The method can extract the unique characteristics of each region, capture the interdependence between different regions and target variables, remarkably improve the prediction precision, and is suitable for the scenes of wind power output, load demand, electricity price prediction and the like of multiple regions.

title_en: Disaster influence full-chain joint simulation method for event-power grid-life line-user
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster influence full-chain joint simulation method for an event-power grid-life line-user, and aims to solve the problems that a composite extreme event cannot be covered, coupling modeling is inaccurate and a unified full-chain simulation frame is lacking in the prior art. The method generates extreme event scenes such as natural disasters, network attacks and the like, builds a multi-granularity lifeline model, and develops joint simulation in two stages (bi-directional coupling system iterative simulation and unidirectional influence system section simulation) to synchronously model 8 important users by combining time-event dual-drive interaction. The full-chain failure process can be accurately simulated, the power grid fault evolution, the life line function loss and the user service availability are output, and support is provided for urban life line toughness assessment and emergency decision.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Evacuation building
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an evacuation building capable of being used as an emergency evacuation destination when a tsunami or a flood occurs and maintaining a function of a building body by reliably preventing the same from being destroyed or inundated.SOLUTION: An evacuation building A to be used as an evacuation destination when a tsunami or a flood occurs comprises: an external peripheral pressure resistant wall 1 which extends in an entire circumferential direction, has a height higher than a maximum water level preliminarily set against the tsunami or the flood and is provided with pressure resistance performance to resist water pressure and an impact due to and a floating object; and a building body 2 which is constructed inside the external peripheral pressure resistant wall 1 and is provided with a lifeline function. A supporting slab 4 which supports the building body 2 is integrally constructed inside the external peripheral pressure resistant wall 1. A base isolation layer 11 is installed between the building body 2 and the supporting slab 4 to enable the building body 2 to be a base-isolated building.

title_en: System allowing person to live in person's own house even if lifeline is intercepted in disaster or the like
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the inconvenience that a person has to live as an evacuee or the like when the lifeline is intercepted or a cut is imposed on water intake to cause shortage of water in a big earthquake.  <P>SOLUTION: Rainwater is stored underground, and is made to flow through a water cleaner to obtain cleaned water as a water source for potable water, bathing water and the like. A person can live in the person's own house by using various electric appliances of 12 V even if the lifeline is intercepted. Thus, the above problem is solved. title_en: Underground comprehensive pipe gallery design method considering civil air defense requirements
abstract_en: The invention provides a design method of an underground comprehensive pipe gallery considering the needs of civil air defense, which can meet the defense requirements considering the needs of civil air defense by carrying out protection design on a main structure of a pipe gallery, a personnel entrance, an exit, a vent, a feed opening, an in-gallery pipeline, electric of the pipe gallery and water supply and drainage of the pipe gallery and adapting protection measures, and can realize standard design, green intelligent construction, war conversion, short construction period and low cost. The invention can scientifically, economically and effectively improve the war time disaster prevention and damage resistance and the peaceful time natural disaster resistance of the comprehensive pipe gallery, is suitable for newly built and built comprehensive pipe galleries to meet the requirements of both civil air defense and implement peacetime function conversion, and ensures the toughness and safety of the urban lifeline system.

title_en: Urban energy system interaction influence and lifting method based on electric-thermal interdependence
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric-thermal interdependence-based urban energy system interaction influence and lifting method, and belongs to the field of energy utilization. The method comprises the steps of establishing a coupling model of three subsystems of electric power, natural gas and heat supply, providing a multidimensional toughness assessment index to assess comprehensive performance under extreme events, introducing an emergency resource scheduling strategy, planning position deployment of a power generation vehicle in the extreme events by using a power generation vehicle scheduling model, optimizing a repair path of a maintenance person under the condition of power network damage by using a maintenance person scheduling model, dynamically reconstructing a topological structure of a power distribution network under the condition of power system damage, maintaining the temperature of the building under the condition of insufficient heat supply by using thermal inertia of the building, and cooperatively optimizing resource allocation of three energy systems. The cooperative operation and emergency recovery of the multi-energy system are realized, the overall performance, the resistance and the restoring force of the system under extreme conditions are improved, and the safety and the stability of energy supply are ensured.

title_en: Pipe Supporting Device for Earthquake-proof Having 3D Displacement
title_ko: 3차원 변위량을 갖는 내진용 일체형 배관지지장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a seismic integrated pipe supporting device with three-dimensional (3D) displacement, comprising: a fixated bracket having a plurality of shaft coupling units protruding to one surface, and capable of being directly fixated on a ceiling or wall surface, or coupled to the same through a separate length adjustment means; a rotation central shaft to insert both ends into a shaft hole formed in the shaft coupling unit; a rod having a long hole-shaped through-hole formed on one end to receive the inserted rotation central axis to allow the 3D displacement in up/down, left/right, and front/rear directions, and allowing the other end to be coupled to a connection supporting member connecting or supporting the pipe; a coupling plate coupled to the fixated bracket by being spaced apart from the fixated bracket at a predetermined interval; and a shock absorption means connected to the coupling plate to receive the rod inside, and actively absorbing the 3D displacement to prevent breakage of the pipe upon an internal or external impact. According to the present invention, to minimize a secondary damage caused from breakage of a water transfer pipe, such as a rising pipe, a horizontal pipe, etc., of water firefighting equipment installed in main infrastructures upon an earthquake or other internal and external impacts, the device actively absorbs displacement and 3D-twisting to prevent breakage of the pipe when the pipe is moved as a consequence of these impacts.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 3차원 변위량을 갖는 내진용 일체형 배관지지장치에 관한 것으로, 일면으로 돌출되는 한 쌍의 축결합부를 갖으며, 천정 또는 벽면에 직접 고정되거나 별도의 길이조절부재를 통해 결합이 가능한 고정 브라켓과, 상기 축결합부에 형성된 축홀(hole)에 양단이 삽입되는 회전중심축과, 상기 회전중심축이 삽입되어 상하, 좌우 및 전후방향의 3차원 변위량을 갖도록 하는 장공형상의 관통홀이 일단에 형성되고, 타단은 배관을 연결 또는 지지하는 연결지지부재가 결합되는 로드와, 상기 고정 브라켓으로부터 일정간격을 두고 상기 고정 브라켓과 결합되는 결합 플레이트와, 상기 결합 플레이트에 연결되어 상기 로드를 내부에 수용하며 내외적인 충격 시 배관의 3차원 변위량을 능동적으로 흡수하여 배관의 파손을 방지하기 위한 완충수단을 포함하며, 지진 및 각종 내외적 충격발생 시 주요기반시설에 설치된 입상관 및 횡주관 등 수계소화설비 송수관의 파손으로 발생하는 2차 피해를 최소화하기 위하여 각종 충격 시 배관이 흔들릴 때 그 변위량과 3D-Twisting을 능동적으로 흡수하여 배관의 파손을 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: Portable multifunctional life-saving rope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable multifunctional lifeline, which comprises: the life-saving rope comprises a storage bin and a life-saving rope body stored in the storage bin, wherein the life-saving rope body comprises a main steel rope, a floating body steel rope, an auxiliary steel rope, a floating ball, a retarder, a plurality of grabbing-assisting thin ropes and a sinking body steel rope. One end of the main steel rope is fixed on the inner wall of the storage bin, and the other end of the main steel rope is provided with the floating ball; 2 pieces of buffer devices are arranged on the main steel rope at intervals, and each buffer device is provided with two arms capable of gradually expanding; two ends of the floating body steel rope are respectively connected with the outer end of one arm of each retarder; two ends of the sinking steel rope are respectively connected with the outer end of the other arm of each retarder; the multiple grabbing-assisting thin ropes are interwoven in a net shape, and two ends of each grabbing-assisting thin rope are respectively connected with two arms of the two retarders or respectively connected with the floating body steel rope and the sinking body steel rope; a handle is arranged on the containing bin. The device is convenient to carry and simple to operate, is in a net shape after being unfolded, is convenient for a person falling into water to grasp, and is also convenient for a rescuer to rescue.

title_en: Disaster prevention handling facility system for building/condominium and drain water storage tank therefor
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To secure the lifeline by enabling extra-use of a domestic drainage function of a building or a condominium for a fixed period of time even if a public sewerage system is made unavailable by an earthquake or a flood disaster.SOLUTION: A disaster prevention handling facility system comprises a storage tank 32 for storing water to be supplied to a building/condominium 10 in the case of emergency, cogeneration systems 40, 40' which are operable in the case of emergency for supplying electricity and heat to the building/condominium 10, and a drain water storage tank 60 for storing at least a part of drain water from the building/condominium 10 in the case of emergency.

title_en: Emergency rescue scheduling optimization method based on multilayer network heterogeneous transport means
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue dispatching optimization method based on a multilayer network heterogeneous transport means, and relates to the technical field of emergency rescue dispatching. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-layer network model, defining parameter representation of a transportation tool dispatching optimization scene, establishing a mixed integer linear programming model based on emergency rescue dispatching optimization of multi-layer network heterogeneous transportation tools, taking transportation tool selection, transportation tool dispatching distribution and transportation route planning schemes as decision variables, and taking total rescue time as an optimization target, and constraining the optimization model. And fifthly, solving a model. The invention has good engineering practicability, controllable calculation process, easy realization, convenient grasping, popularization and application of engineering technicians, can be used as an important decision tool for the allocation and optimization management of emergency rescue tools, and provides powerful support for improving rescue efficiency and optimizing rescue transportation tool allocation.

title_en: The total prevention and PSR system to decrease heavy rain disaster
title_ko: 폭우 재해 저감을 위한 통합방재 및 psr 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a total prevention PSR system, capable of preparing plans for the reduction of flooding damage such as moving main base facilities or limiting the land use of a disaster vulnerable area (S) and a disaster occurrence point (P) in cities by running in parallel with the existing prevention system to prevent disasters such as flooding, caused by heavy rain; and preparing a space drainage system to distribute facilities, delaying and reducing the flow of rainwater, to various places in a city response region (R). Therefore, the flow of rainwater, concentrated on a flooding area, is delayed and reduced by using a city plan facility for the reduction of damage to the disaster vulnerable area (S) and the disaster occurrence point (P).
