title_en: Underground utilities managing system
title_ko: Rfid태그 이용 매설물 관리 장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 RFID태그 이용 매설물 관리 장치에 관한 것으로서 더욱 구체적으로는, 지하에 매설되어서 관리대상이 되는 매설물에 고정되는 고정체와, 상기 고정체에 부착되는 스트링과, 상기 스트링체 고정되는 RFID태그유니트로 이루어진 전자인식표시기와,  
상기 RFID태그유니트 내의 RFID태그와 LF대역으로 무선 통신하는 RFID리더로서의 기능을 가지고 상기 전자인식표시기의 정보를 판독하는 전자인식판독기와,  
상기 전자인식판독기와, 매설물에 관한 필요 정보를 교환하는 GIS와,  
상기 전자인식판독기에 상기 매설물의 위치정보를 제공하는 GPS를 포함하여 구성된다.  
이러한 구성을 통하면, 지중에 종류가 다른 다수의 매설물이 매설된 경우에는, 각 매설물 별로 고유의 RFID태그를 내장하는 전자인식표시기를 설치하여서 타 매설물과 혼돈하지 않고 구분을 할 수 있다.  
여기서, 매설물 예컨대 전기선로, 통신선로, 도시가스관, 상하수도관 등은 도시의 기반시설이며 도시를 유지하는 핵심요소이고 이러한 매설물은 안전하게 보호되기 위해서, 그리고 환경이나 도시 미관 등의 복합적인 요건을 충족하기 위해서 일반적으로 지하에 매립되어 설치된다.

title_en: Multi-target library real-time data synchronization method for electric power metering
abstract_en: The invention provides a power metering-oriented multi-target library real-time data synchronization method which comprises the steps of constructing a metering data dependency model based on a power load curve theory, optimizing a multi-target scheduling strategy by utilizing an improved non-dominant sorting genetic algorithm, processing power data by applying an intelligent slicing and mixed compression strategy, executing synchronization based on a multi-level buffering strategy and a batch writing algorithm, and implementing multi-dimensional consistency verification and generating a layered restoration scheme. The scheme realizes the real-time synchronization of the power metering data with high efficiency, high reliability and low resource consumption, and provides a high-quality data base for the power grid dispatching decision.

title_en: Module type data logger based on for social infrastructure
title_ko: 사회기반시설물을 위한 iot 기반 모듈형 데이터로거
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an IoT-based modular data logger for social infrastructures, capable of being installed in social infrastructures of a plurality of categories using different kinds of sensors for remote monitoring, being connected selectively to different kinds of IoT communication networks, being conveniently installed and used despite using different kinds of sensors and different kinds of IoT communication networks, and monitoring malfunction in accordance with self-diagnosis, thereby stably performing remote monitoring for preventing disasters to social infrastructures and enabling high-efficiency management and convenient installation at low costs in small-scale social infrastructures which do not conventionally draw much attention regarding safety management. The present invention includes: a plurality of sensor connection parts (120, 220) connecting different kinds of sensors; IoT communication network connection parts (130, 230) selectively connected to different kinds of IoT communication networks (20); memories (160, 260) storing data standards by sensor and protocol information for communication with a cloud server (30); and control parts (110, 210) controlling the generation and transmission of a packet by applying a data standard and a protocol in accordance with a sensor (10) connected with a selected IoT communication network (20).

title_en: Method for processing chain effect of electricity-gas interdependent system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for processing the interlocking effect of an electric-gas interdependent system. The method comprises the steps of establishing a rescheduling model of the power system, a rescheduling model of the natural gas system and a model of a coupling element according to the electric-gas interdependent system, further establishing a linkage effect analysis model of the electric-gas interdependent system, further obtaining a scheduling quantity of produced natural gas quantity and a cutting quantity of a natural gas load, adjusting the output of a generator set or cutting off part of the power load by adopting a power system scheduling mechanism, and adjusting the output of a gas source or cutting off part of the natural gas load by adopting a natural gas system scheduling mechanism. The invention couples the interlocking effect into the reliability of the electric-gas interdependent system by modeling the interlocking effect in the electric-gas interdependent system, and provides a basis for ensuring the reliable operation of the electric-gas interdependent system.

title_en: Natural Circulation Type Tree Flowerpot Filtering System to Reduce Non-point Pollution Sources from the Opaque in Urban Areas by Utilizing Urban Infrastructure
title_ko: 도시지역 불투수면에서 발생하는 비점오염원을 도시기반시설을 활용하여 저감하는 자연순환형 나무화분여과시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a natural circulation type tree planter filtration system which reduces non-point pollution sources generated from impervious surfaces in urban areas by utilizing an urban infrastructure. The natural circulation type tree planter filtration system of the present invention comprises: a wooden box; a media filter; an appendage space; a planting space; a vegetation gravel; and a drain. When the natural circulation type tree planer filtration system is installed, there are effects such as flood prevention due to removal of non-point pollution sources of a rainwater and reduction of a peak runoff.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도시지역 불투수면에서 발생하는 비점오염원을 도시기반시설을 활용하여 저감하는 자연순환형 나무화분여과시스템으로서, 기존에 식재되어 있는 조경수, 가로수 등을 이용할 수 있을 뿐 아니라 새로이 조성되는 도시지역 설계에도 적용이 가능하고, 시설을 설치 후에는 도시지역 및 도로에서 발생되는 비점 오염원을 저감시키는 작용과 처리된 우수를 하수도로 이송을 시키는 것이 아닌, 지면저류 및 토양 저류를 통하여 첨두유량과 유출용적을 저감시켜 지하수 고갈 문제 해결 및 홍수 재해 방지에 도움이 되는 기술로 된 자연순환형 나무화분 여과시스템에 관한 것이다. 발명의 구성은 나무상자, 여재필터, 충수공간, 식재공간, 식생토 자갈 및배수구로 이루어져 있다. 상부 식재공간에는 교목(가로수) 및 관목을 식재하여 도심조경을 자연스럽게 할 수 있으며, 하부에는 충수공간에 담수되어 있는 오염된 우수를 여과필터를 통해 일부는 식생토를 통해 식재된 수목에 공급이 되며, 일부는 지하로 순환되는 구조를 가진 자연순환형 나무화분 여과시스템이다. 이 시스템을 우수가 많이 발생하는 지역 등에서는 우수체류장치를 연결하여 더 많은 우수를 지하수로 환수시킬 수 있으며. 나무상자에 우수체류장치를 우수연결관으로 연결하여 활용할 수 있다. 우수체류장치 상부에는 식재공간을 두어 교목 등 초하 류를 식재하여 화단의 형태로 사용할 수 있으며 식생분리판으로 분리된 지하부에는 충수공간을 두어 오염된 우수를 저장시켜 상부에 식재된 교목 등 초하류 등에 공급되고, 일부는 우수연결관을 통해 우수박스로 보내어져 가로수 및 지하수로 돌아가게 된다. 본 발명의 자연순환형 나무화분 여과시스템 설치 시 우수의 비점오염원 제거 및 첨두유출량 감소로 홍수 예방 등의 효과가 있다.

title_en: Floating intelligent perimeter sensor system
abstract_en: A system, method, and floating intelligent perimeter sensor, provide protection for waterways and critical infrastructures. The system and method utilize one or more floating intelligent perimeter sensors to detect, and in some cases identify, hazardous materials associated with vessels in the waterways. The hazardous materials detected, and optionally identified, can include radiological materials, fissile materials, explosives, chemicals and biological materials (CBRNE). A set of radiation data associated with a radiation source in a vessel is received from the one or more floating intelligent perimeter sensors. At least one histogram is generated based on the set of radiation data. The at least one histogram is compared to multiple spectral images associated with known materials. The at least one histogram is determined to substantially match at least one of the multiple spectral images. A determination is made whether a material associated with the radiation source is a hazardous material.

title_en: Identification method and system for critical propagation path of cascading failure of power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for identifying a critical propagation path of cascading failures of a power system, belonging to the technical field of power system failure identification, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring current information and voltage information of each node in the power system based on WAMS system data, and further determining the actual power of each node; constructing an overload outage probability model of the power transmission line according to the actual power of each node; constructing an evaluation model of the N-k fault event according to the overload outage probability model; linearizing the nonlinear constraint of the evaluation model based on the power balance constraint and the propagation path constraint to generate a multi-stage linear programming evaluation model; and determining a key propagation path of the cascading failure according to the linear programming evaluation model. In this way, the interdependencies of the outage lines in the event of an N-k fault can be directly revealed, and the critical propagation paths of cascading overload faults can be effectively identified.

title_en: Water-grain-energy-ecological correlation system collaborative configuration method considering unconventional water utilization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-grain-energy-ecological association system collaborative configuration method considering unconventional water utilization, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a water-grain-energy-ecological association system collaborative configuration model, quantitatively analyzing interaction relations among water resource distribution, agricultural production, energy utilization and ecological protection, quantifying complex interdependencies among a plurality of random variables by adopting a vine copula method, solving the model by adopting an integrated vine copula and multi-stage random optimization method, and analyzing influence of brackish water utilization rate, joint default probability and water level on WFEE association systems. The invention considers the cooperative allocation of unconventional and conventional water resources, reduces the shortage pressure of regional water resources and reflects the complex mutual influence relationship among a plurality of subsystems.

title_en: Power distribution network risk assessment method considering network coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network risk assessment method considering network coupling, and belongs to the technical field of power distribution networks. The method comprises the following steps: step S1: based on the BAG model, calculating the probability of success of RTU attack; step S2: analyzing an uploading signal of the RTU through the FA system, judging whether the FA system executes a fault processing process, if so, performing fault positioning, isolation and recovery, operating a power recovery model considering network coupling, and outputting interrupt cost; step S3: and (2) after the calculation of the interrupt cost is finished in the step (S2), judging whether a simulation stopping condition is met, and if so, calculating the system risk according to the system risk assessment index. According to the invention, by establishing the power supply recovery model considering the interdependence between the network and the physical system, the model is expressed as Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP) in mathematics, and can be solved by the existing solver, compared with the prior art, the power supply recovery model is simpler and more convenient to calculate and has higher calculation precision.

title_en: The method for routing control of packet transmission in vehicular communications
title_ko: 이동 차량간 패킷 전달 경로 제어 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A method for controlling a packet transmission route between moving cars is provided to change a defer time according to an inter-relay node distance using an ODAM(Optimized Dissemination of Alarm Messages) method to shorten an inter-end delay time, thereby effectively broadcasting an emergency warning message during communication between cars. CONSTITUTION: The distance between a transmission node and a relay node car is obtained. Density showing the number of cars located in a service area is obtained. A retransmission delay time of a relay node is adaptively changed by the density and a distance between cars. A car(210) witnesses an accident by the transmission node. The car broadcasts an emergency warning message to surroundings. Cars(220,230) receive the emergency warning message. A car operates as the relay node.

title_en: Urban road network toughness measurement method under multi-layer traffic network dependence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban road network toughness measurement method under multi-layer traffic network dependence, which comprises the following steps of collecting space vector data of urban roads, subways and public transport networks, mapping different space layer data into a multi-layer network model formed by nodes and edges, gradually removing the road network edges and other traffic network lines connected with the road network edges, drawing a relation curve between road network structure indexes and removal proportions under the support of the connection of the rest different traffic layer networks, and comparing phase change threshold values and disaster tolerance changes of the space structures of the road networks under the support of the different traffic layer networks. The invention builds the interconnection model and the toughness measurement model of the road network and other multi-layer traffic networks, can reveal complex mechanisms of the mutual support and the destructive propagation of the road network and the traffic network, can identify key threshold values and important areas of the road space structure change under the multi-layer traffic support, and provides a technical tool for accurately measuring the toughness of the urban road network.

title_en: Urban water supply system toughness critical threshold identification method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and equipment for identifying toughness critical threshold values of an urban water supply system, which comprise the steps of respectively modeling a physical domain and an information domain of the water supply system based on a graph theory method, establishing a double-domain coupling mechanism according to a control theory principle, constructing an information-physical interaction coupling model, introducing an information network fault scene based on the coupling model to analyze the influence of the information network fault on the running state of the urban water supply network, and further establishing a service performance attenuation rate as a toughness critical threshold value evaluation index based on a performance-time curve characteristic, and identifying and outputting the toughness critical threshold values of the system through quantitative calculation. The method has strong systematicness and clear flow, provides a direct basis for the accurate reinforcement and toughness improvement of the system, effectively improves the accuracy and practicability of system modeling by the constructed coupling model, can completely capture the dynamic behavior of the system from function attenuation to recovery, can support the toughness research of a multilayer key infrastructure network, and has important theoretical significance and engineering application value.

title_en: Reverse powering system for telecommunications node
abstract_en: To initiate the transmission of electrical power over a telecommunications connection (14) from a power-collecting telecommunications interface unit (16) such as a customer premises equipment, connectable to a power supply (18), to a power-receiving unit (22, Fig 4) such as a kerbside electrical/cptical interface, when a connection (14) is first established, or the collecting unit is first powered up, or in order to re-establish connection after a power outage, control signals are transmitted between low-power modems (55) in the interface units using a low-power communications protocol. This allows the controlled initiation of a larger power output and a higher speed exchange of data once the full telecommunications connection has been established. A low-powered beacon signal is transmitted over the telecommunications connection (14) by the power-collecting telecommunications interface unit on connection to a power supply (18), for detection by the power-receiving telecommunications interface unit. In the event of a loss of power at the input (18), the low power modem (55) initiates power management control signals to cause the power-receiving telecommunications interface to shut down certain functions in order to preserve backup power for essential "lifeline" services.

title_en: Underground pipe network interaction risk early warning system for urban lifeline
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an underground pipe network interaction risk early warning system for an urban lifeline, which relates to the field of urban lifeline operation monitoring and can improve the efficiency and the timely degree of personnel supervision of underground pipe network interaction safety. The invention comprises the following steps: the auxiliary analysis terminal is accessed to a front end sensor of the area to be detected through a mobile communication network; the auxiliary analysis terminal determines grade information according to the acquired front-end sensor information and sends the grade information to the data processing center; the data processing center establishes a risk interaction prediction model, determines the underground pipe network interaction risk level according to the level information reported by the auxiliary analysis terminal, and reports the underground pipe network interaction risk level to the dispatching monitoring center; and the dispatching monitoring center determines a risk treatment scheme aiming at the area to be detected according to the reported underground pipe network interaction risk level, and sends the risk treatment scheme to the auxiliary analysis terminal.

title_en: Method for forecasting temperature in underground utility tunnel based on residual CNN-LSTM
title_ko: Residual CNN-LSTM 모델로 지하 공동구의 온도변화를 실시간으로 예측하는 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for predicting a temperature change of an underground common duct in real time with a residual cnn-lstm model. Since the underground common duct is an important national facility that jointly accommodates the city's lifeline such as electricity, communication, water supply, and heating, it is difficult to extinguish the fire as well as paralysis of the city's infrastructure in the event of a disaster such as a fire, so the damage increases out of control. Therefore, ordinary prevention and detection activities are important, and to this end, various monitoring equipment, such as a temperature sensor, a fire detection sensor, and various sensors for monitoring and detecting a disaster are installed. The present invention provides the method for predicting in real time how a temperature will change by using deep learning analysis for temperature information collected from temperature sensors in order to detect and predict in advance a sign of occurrence of a large-scale disaster that can occur in an underground common duct such as a fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, Residual CNN-LSTM 모델로 지하 공동구의 온도변화를 실시간으로 예측하는 방법에 관한 것이다. 지하 공동구는 전력, 통신, 수도, 난방 등과 같은 도시의 라이프 라인을 공동으로 수용하는 국가 중요 시설물이기 때문에 화재 등 재난의 발생 시 도시 인프라의 마비는 물론 화재 진압이 어려워 피해가 걷잡을 수 없이 커진다. 따라서 평상시 예방 및 탐지 활동이 중요하며, 이를 위하여 재난 발생의 감시 및 탐지를 위한 이를 위한 각종 감시장비들과 온도센서, 화재감지 센서 등 다양한 센서들이 설치되어 있다. 본 발명에서는 화재 등과 같이 지하 공동구에서 발생할 수 있는 대형 재난의 발생 징후를 사전에 탐지하고 예측하기 위하여 온도 센서들에서 수집되는 온도정보들에 대하여 딥러닝 분석을 이용하여 온도가 어떻게 변화할지를 실시간으로 예측하는 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Photovoltaic power prediction method and system based on attention mechanism and LSTM
abstract_en: The application provides a photovoltaic power prediction method and a system based on an attention mechanism and LSTM, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a meteorological environment data sequence when a photovoltaic panel operates in a current time period, inputting the meteorological environment data sequence into a photovoltaic power prediction model, wherein the photovoltaic power prediction model comprises a multi-head attention module, an LSTM module and a regression module which are sequentially connected, extracting features of the meteorological environment data sequence through the multi-head attention module to obtain a first feature vector, carrying out time sequence dependency modeling analysis on the first feature vector through the LSTM module to obtain a second feature vector, and mapping the second feature vector through the regression module to obtain a predicted power generation sequence of the photovoltaic panel in a future time period, wherein the photovoltaic power prediction model is obtained after super-parameter optimization and training are carried out on a pre-built initial model. The photovoltaic power prediction method and the photovoltaic power prediction device can improve accuracy and efficiency of photovoltaic power prediction.
assignees: Foshan Xianhu Laboratory;WUHAN BUILDING MATERIAL INDUSTRY DESIGN & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Storage and infiltration structure and drainage method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To keep safety from a flood disaster in view of an important subject of prior countermeasures against rainwater to cope with the severance of a lifeline because flood that occurs frequently cannot infiltrate underground from the ground surface to cause an enormous amount of rainfall flowing out of a river, and a flooded state leads to the disaster.  <P>SOLUTION: The ground surface of pavement, concrete or asphalt of a road has no rainwater infiltrating property. The ground surface water thereby flows out abnormally to the river without infiltrating underground to cause the flood disaster. As the countermeasure, a seepage pit is installed for promoting infiltration into the underground from the bottom of a waterway. The outflow of rainwater is thereby suppressed effectively to serve as the countermeasure against the flood disaster, thus acquiring safety and assurance.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: System and method for power outage and restoration notification in an advanced metering infrastructure network
abstract_en: A method and system are provided to transmit a meter power status. The method includes recognizing a power status change at a meter. The method includes, if the meter is scheduled to transmit first, transmitting a notification message to at least one neighboring meter towards a mesh gate, wherein the notification message includes a power status indicator and a meter identifier. The method includes, if the meter is not scheduled to transmit first, waiting a predetermined time period to receive a notification message from at least one neighboring meter. The method includes, responsive to receiving a notification message, adding a meter identifier to the received notification message before retransmitting the modified notification message to at least one neighboring meter. The method includes retransmitting the notification message.

title_en: Electric power supply lifeline construction method based on secondary dry layer contact and mobile energy storage
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing an electric power supply lifeline based on secondary dry layer contact and mobile energy storage, which comprises the following steps of: step S1, obtaining power consumer information and net rack basic information; step S2, constructing an important power consumer evaluation index, and acquiring an important power consumer set according to the obtained power consumer information; step S3, constructing an electric power supply scheme based on secondary dry layer contact according to the obtained important electric power user set and net rack basic information; step S4, establishing a mobile energy storage scheme according to the power load condition of an important power consumer; and step S5, comparing the electric power supply scheme based on the secondary dry layer contact and the mobile energy storage with the mobile energy storage scheme to obtain a better power supply scheme, and constructing an electric power lifeline based on the better power supply scheme. The invention solves the problem of the balance between the reliability and the economy of the power grid users, optimizes the power supply environment and further improves the power supply reliability of the power grid under the condition of better economy.
assignees: FUJIAN YONGFU POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Urban lifeline sensing and safe operation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban lifeline sensing and safety operation system, and relates to the technical field of urban safety management. The system comprises: the pipe network internet of things detection unit is used for acquiring the operation data of each city pipe network in the target city map; the city pipe network includes: the system comprises a heating power pipe network, a drainage pipe network, a comprehensive pipe gallery, a gas pipe network, a water supply pipe network and a road bridge tunnel monitoring network; the distributed internet of things service unit is used for storing and extracting target internet of things data of the operation data and transmitting the target internet of things data by utilizing the video network; the city life line safety situation platform is used for: determining a security situation base according to the operation data; generating accident early warning according to the abnormal value of the target internet of things data, carrying out configuration optimization of each city pipe network according to the accident early warning, and carrying out three-dimensional modeling according to the pipe network structure and corresponding operation data in the target city map to obtain a digital twin scene. The invention can improve the collaborative coordination capacity of the urban pipe network system and optimize the resource allocation.
assignees: SHANGHAI ELECTRIC SMART CITY INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Floating intelligent perimeter sensor system
abstract_en: A system, method, and floating intelligent perimeter sensor, provide protection for waterways and critical infrastructures. The system and method utilize one or more floating intelligent perimeter sensors to detect, and in some cases identify, hazardous materials associated with vessels in the waterways. The hazardous materials detected, and optionally identified, can include radiological materials, fissile materials, explosives, chemicals and biological materials (CBRNE). A set of radiation data associated with a radiation source in a vessel is received from the one or more floating intelligent perimeter sensors. At least one histogram is generated based on the set of radiation data. The at least one histogram is compared to multiple spectral images associated with known materials. The at least one histogram is determined to substantially match at least one of the multiple spectral images. A determination is made whether a material associated with the radiation source is a hazardous material.

title_en: Construction method of bottom-preserving net rack in coastal region
abstract_en: The application discloses a coastal region bottom-preserving net rack construction method, which comprises the following steps: obtaining key user information of a target city in a coastal region; acquiring power supply channel information of each key user in the key user information; inquiring the high-reliability channel part of each power supply channel according to the power supply channel information, and determining the initial node of each high-reliability channel part; according to the power supply requirements of key users corresponding to the high-reliability channel part, an energy storage power station is arranged at a starting node of the high-reliability channel part, and the energy storage configuration of the energy storage power station is matched with the power supply requirements; the technical problem of how to build a 'lifeline' channel for highly reliable power supply of the bottom-protecting net frame in the coastal region and construct a self-balancing local power grid under typhoon disasters is solved.

title_en: Holographic sensing, monitoring and early warning method for urban lifeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses a holographic sensing, monitoring and early warning method for an urban lifeline, which relates to the technical field of urban management and comprises the following steps: s1: monitoring cities, and arranging gas, liquid pressure, flow sensors, liquid level sensors, temperature, humidity and TVOC related data monitoring or front-end sensing sensors to construct a sensor network; s2: collecting monitoring data in real time through the constructed sensor network, and transmitting the monitoring data to the cloud through a wireless transmission communication network; s3: after the cloud receives the data, analyzing and evaluating the monitoring data through the anomaly identification model, and outputting a prediction result; the holographic sensing, monitoring and early warning method for the urban lifeline realizes comprehensive sensing and dynamic monitoring of the urban lifeline and timely sensing and early prediction and early warning functions of urban safety risk.
assignees: CHINA ROAD & BRIDGE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional, multi-layer and multi-granularity multi-network fusion modeling method
abstract_en: The multi-dimensional, multi-layer and multi-granularity multi-network fusion modeling method provided by the embodiment of the application comprises the steps of constructing a multi-dimensional network model according to network data, wherein the multi-dimensional network model comprises a power grid multi-dimensional network, a telecommunication network multi-dimensional network, a broadcast television network multi-dimensional network and an Internet multi-dimensional network; in the multidimensional network model, constructing a multidimensional network model according to different network nodes serving as granularity units; connecting the related network nodes among different networks according to the coupling and association relation among the networks to construct a multi-layer network model; obtaining a multi-dimensional, multi-layer and multi-granularity complex network model for describing a complex system after multi-network fusion; the method and the system not only comprehensively reflect the association relations of different individuals, families and communities under multi-network fusion, but also can effectively analyze and predict the possible behavior activities of the users and the user groups, effectively reveal the complex, potential and inherent association relations among the four networks, and provide basic support for the four-network fusion application service.

title_en: Urban lifeline gas pipeline flood emergency prevention and control system and method based on large model
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-model-based urban lifeline gas pipeline flood emergency prevention and control system and method, which are applied to the technical field of gas pipeline flood emergency. The system comprises an emergency supervision management platform, wherein the emergency supervision management platform is configured to construct a gas pipe network map based on pipeline pressures and gas flow rates of a plurality of pipeline nodes, determine a plurality of suspected leakage points and leakage confidence degrees, execute an evaluation step for each suspected leakage point, determine sampling radius according to the leakage confidence degrees, determine corrosion risks and deformation risks of the suspected leakage points based on water body data and image data, determine comprehensive risk values of target pipeline nodes based on the plurality of corrosion risks and the plurality of deformation risks through a prediction model, and automatically send control signals to a drainage robot to drive the drainage robot to drain water in response to the comprehensive risk values meeting drainage conditions. The invention can automatically perform risk assessment and emergency treatment and timely eliminate the potential safety hazard of damage to the gas pipeline caused by flood disasters.

title_en: Dynamic contingency avoidance and mitigation system
abstract_en: The disclosed subject matter provides systems and methods for allocating resources within an infrastructure, such as an electrical grid, in response to changes to inputs and output demands on the infrastructure, such as energy sources and sinks. A disclosed system includes one or more processors, each having respective communication interfaces to receive data from the infrastructure, the data including infrastructure network data, one or more software applications, operatively coupled to and at least partially controlling the one or more processors, to process and characterize the infrastructure network data; and a display, coupled to the one or more processors, for visually presenting a depiction of at least a portion of the infrastructure including any changes in condition thereof, and one or more controllers in communication with the one or more processors, to manage processing of the resource, wherein the resource is obtained and/or distributed based on the characterization of the real time infrastructure data.
assignees: ANDERSON ROGER N;BOULANGER ALBERT;JOHNSON JOHN A;CALM ENERGY INC;UNIV COLUMBIA

title_en: Water supply system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a water supply system which enables supply of drinking water and water for hygienic management at emergency disaster even when lifelines are completely broken.  <P>SOLUTION: The water supply system includes a raw water storage tank 3 which stores raw water by pumping up the raw water from various water sources by a storage pump, and a treatment tank 5 which removes a part of bacteria and viruses from the raw water stored in the raw water storage tank by driving a purification unit 4 to store the treated water. The treated water stored in the treatment tank is sterilized by electrolytic water generated by driving an electrolytic water unit 6 and then supplied as drinking water or water for hygienic management.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Disaster influence full-chain joint simulation method for event-power grid-life line-user
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster influence full-chain joint simulation method for an event-power grid-life line-user, and aims to solve the problems that a composite extreme event cannot be covered, coupling modeling is inaccurate and a unified full-chain simulation frame is lacking in the prior art. The method generates extreme event scenes such as natural disasters, network attacks and the like, builds a multi-granularity lifeline model, and develops joint simulation in two stages (bi-directional coupling system iterative simulation and unidirectional influence system section simulation) to synchronously model 8 important users by combining time-event dual-drive interaction. The full-chain failure process can be accurately simulated, the power grid fault evolution, the life line function loss and the user service availability are output, and support is provided for urban life line toughness assessment and emergency decision.

title_en: Natural circulation tree filter box system
title_ko: 자연순환형 나무화분여과시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A natural circulation tree filtering box system is provided to remove non-point pollution source of rain to prevent flood by reducing peak outflow. CONSTITUTION: A natural circulation tree filter box system has a concrete structure or a wood box having intensity fitted for the same, a filter and a space fumigant (20), a vegetation space, vegetation soil (33), a gravel layer (34) and a rain discharge pipe (14). A screen net for removing foreign substances when rain is flowed in is installed, and the space fumigant holds rain flowed in through an inlet. Shrub, arbor and the like can be vegetated in the vegetation space. The gravel layer increases water permeation speed. A filtering net is installed in the filter.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로지역 등 도시지역 불투수면에서 발생하는 비점오염원을 도시기반시설을 활용하여 저감하는 빗물 생태저류시설을 조성할 수 있는 시설로서 기존에 식재되어 있는 조경수, 가로수 등을 이용할 수 있을 뿐 아니라 새로이 조성되는 도시지역 설계에도 적용이 가능하고 시설을 설치 후에는 도시지역 및 도로에서 발생되는 비점오염원을 저감시키는 작용과 처리된 우수를 하수도로 이송을 시키는 것이 아닌 지면저류 및 토양 저류를 통하여 첨두유량과 유출용적을 저감시켜 지하수 고갈 문제 해결 및 홍수 재해 방지에 도움이 되는 기술로서 자연순환형 나무화분여과시스템에 관한 것이다. 발명의 구성은 나무상자와 여재필터 충수공간 식재공간 식생토 자갈 및 배수구로 이루어져 있다. 상부 식재공간에는 교목(가로수) 및 관목을 식재하여 도심조경을 자연스럽게 할 수 있으며 하부에는 충수공간에 담수되어있는 오염된 우수를 여과필터를 통해 일부는 식생토를 통해 식재된 수목에 공급이 되며 일부는 지하로 순환되는 구조를 가진 자연순환형 나무화분여과시스템이다. 이 시스템을 우수가 많이 발생되는 지역 등에서는 우수체류장치를 연결하여 더 많은 우수를 지하수로 환수 시킬 수 있으며 나무상자에 우수체류장치를 우수연결관으로 연결하여 활용할 수 있다. 우수체류장치 상부에는 식재공간을 두어 교목 등 초하류를 식재하여 화단의 형태로 사용 할 수 있으며 식생분리판으로 분리된 지하부에는 충수공간을 두어 오염된 우수를 저장시켜 상부에 식재된 교목 등 초하류 등에 공급되고 일부는 우수연결관을 통해 우수박스로 보내지어 가로수 및 지하수로 돌아가게 된다.  자연순환형 나무화분여과시스템 설치 시  우수의 비점오염원 제거 및 첨두유출량 감소로 홍수 예방 등의 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of quickly emergency hangar tunnel equipment and implementation method
abstract_en: A kind of quickly emergency hangar tunnel equipment and implementation method, are related in the lifeline engineerings such as highway, railway, the processing of collapse rock-fall calamity emergency.Equipment is characterized in that：Including by steel grating (1), pearl cotton (2), solid foot device (3), telescoping rod (4), support construction (5) and hinge (6)；Steel grating (1) is connected with telescoping rod (4) by hinge (6)；Pearl cotton (2) covering is pasted on steel grating (1), is arranged on the inside of steel grating (1) Gu foot device (3) is fixed on, and its role is to fixed hangar tunnels, and riverside slumping mass lateral pressure is avoided to be pushed open；Determine clamping telescoping rod after the length of telescoping rod (4)；The left and right upper angle of hangar tunnel respectively symmetrically property be equipped with support construction (5).The device structure is simple, easy to use, foldable transportation to callapsed landslide scene, and hangar tunnel equipment can be put up in a short time, road is dredged, is resumed traffic normal, the secondary slump for also avoiding subsequent fragmentary falling rocks or geological disaster causes damages to Pedestrians and vehicles current on road.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting escape device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire-fighting escape devices, its structure includes descending lifeline, safety hook, slow descending rope rope, rolling wheel, safety belt, the outer surface of descending lifeline is equipped with slideway, slow descending rope rope is wound with the outer circumference surface of descending lifeline and extension is connected to rolling wheel, the present invention is respectively equipped with planetary gear set in the inside of descending lifeline and matches with secondary row star-wheel, planetary gear set generates the uniform descent that descending lifeline is realized in friction by friction block and shaft, and when friction block is smoothed, force block is exposed to be engaged in outer surface with shaft, based on this, pass through force block, the elastic force tension spring and the coefficient movable block level of push rod for pushing up the cooperation of power bar promote inside buckling plate, fastening guide wheel to which buckling plate tail portion is fastened is released, therefore, planetary gear set is replaced to complete joggleword the pop-up of secondary row star-wheel, descending lifeline is continued The decline that remains a constant speed, avoid user in the safety issue for not reaching the failure of descending lifeline in face of ground and generating.

title_en: Fire fighting apparatus for small building
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a sprinkler apparatus in which early stage fire extinguishing ability and tap-water is efficiently used and which has diversity in ensuring drink water and installation space so as to solve problems that: in a water sprinkler facility for small building, premised insurance of pressure and water quantity of tap-water are deficient in almost cases and in an existing building, an installation space for the facility is also deficient; and there is interruption in lifeline due to large-scale disasters.SOLUTION: To provide an apparatus in which a control valve on a water pipe pulled into two or more buildings is turned over and water quantity is ensured by connecting a sprinkler pipe. Otherwise, a water tank for tap-water is provided. Water quantity for early stage fire extinguishing is ensured by a water storing type water supply apparatus using pressurization with inert gas or compressed air so as to provide sharing of means for transferring tap-water in a shared manner and a water tank between the buildings and diversity in installation space for the pipe type water tank. In addition, the apparatus may function in the case of one building, which may maintain the water storing function for drink water and the water quantity for early stage fire extinguishing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Natural gas system toughness assessment method and device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a method, a device and computer equipment for evaluating toughness of a natural gas system, which comprise the steps of constructing an input-output relation model of each department according to total output of each department, an interdependence matrix among each department and a final demand vector of each department, obtaining non-operability data and economic loss of each department after each department is disturbed in a static scene based on the input-output relation model and the non-operability, constructing an evolution process model of system state changing along with time, simulating influence degrees, evolution results and recovery processes of different disturbance scenes according to the evolution process model of the system state changing along with time, determining non-operability data and accumulated economic loss of each department in a dynamic scene, and obtaining a natural gas system toughness evaluation result according to the non-operability data and the economic loss of each department in the static scene and the dynamic scene. The method can consider interaction of departments, and improves accuracy of toughness assessment of the natural gas system.

title_en: Method for identifying and evaluating major safety risk of urban gas system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying and evaluating major safety risks of an urban gas system. Step 1: identifying risk points, wherein the risk points comprise fire accident risk points and explosion risk points; step 2: dividing risk units by production units, wherein the risk units comprise gate stations, high-pressure pipe networks, high-medium-pressure regulating stations, storage and distribution stations, medium-pressure pipe networks and medium-low-pressure regulating stations; and step 3: judging the consequences and the possibility of the harm according to the possible harm of each risk unit, and multiplying the consequences and the possibility to obtain the risk of the determined harm; and carrying out risk analysis and evaluation on the storage tank unit with high risk in the natural gas liquefied storage base by applying a high-risk article, a high-risk process, high-risk equipment, a high-risk place and a high-risk operation risk evaluation model. The invention is beneficial to mastering the safety condition of the urban lifeline in detail, making clear the key points of management and control and restraining serious accidents.
assignees: SINOSTEEL CORPORATION WUHAN SAFETY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION RES INSTITUTE COMPANY LIMITED;SINOSTEEL WUHAN INSTITUTE OF GREEN CENTURY SAFETY MAN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle charges and emergency power source system based on electric automobile charging station
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle charging and emergency power supply system based on an electric vehicle charging station, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle direct current charging nuclear capacity unit, an emergency vehicle alternating current charging unit, an emergency guarantee alternating current output/input unit, an emergency guarantee alternating current output unit and an equipment alternating current input unit, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle direct current charging nuclear capacity unit is connected with a charging/discharging gun and used for charging an unmanned aerial vehicle or inputting electric energy of the unmanned aerial vehicle to the system, and performing active battery capacity verification on an unmanned aerial vehicle battery, the emergency vehicle alternating current charging unit is connected with the charging gun and connected with a quick wiring terminal and used for outputting alternating current or inputting electric energy of an external device to the system, the emergency guarantee alternating current output/input unit is connected with the quick wiring terminal and used for outputting alternating current with various powers, and the equipment alternating current input unit is connected with a charging station alternating current low-voltage system and used for supplying power to the unmanned aerial vehicle direct current charging nuclear capacity unit, the emergency vehicle alternating current charging unit, the emergency guarantee alternating current output/input unit and the emergency guarantee alternating current output unit. The invention can rapidly form an unmanned aerial vehicle charging infrastructure network and an emergency shelter with a reliable emergency power supply by utilizing the existing charging station network.
assignees: GUANGZHOU JINBO NEW ENERGY SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: Multi-layer network cascade failure-based multi-mode intermodal network toughness assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-layer network cascading failure-based multi-mode intermodal network toughness assessment method, and belongs to the technical field of multi-mode intermodal network operation and toughness assessment. The method comprises the steps of constructing a public molten iron weighted undirected multilayer network model by adopting an ML-space method according to the multilayer structure of a multi-modal network and the characteristic of freight transportation circulation, calculating the multi-layer centrality and freight transportation level of nodes to determine node importance degree by fusing network topology and freight transportation attribute double view angles on the basis, constructing a load-capacity cascade failure model comprising initial load, node capacity and differential load distribution strategies by combining sub-network heterogeneity, constructing a full-stage toughness assessment system comprising resistance capacity, absorption capacity and recovery capacity on the basis of a toughness triangle theory, and comparing network toughness under different cascade failure and recovery strategies through MATLAB software numerical simulation to reveal the influence rule of node capacity coefficient on toughness. The invention starts from the actual operation scene of the multi-mode intermodal network, considers the multi-layer characteristics and the cascade failure propagation rule, provides the accurate evaluation method of the toughness of the multi-mode intermodal network under the cascade failure scene, and provides scientific references for planning construction, risk prevention and control and toughness improvement of the multi-mode intermodal network.

title_en: Use of composite particles for protecting a lifeline structure against seismic wave damage
abstract_en: Composite particles of a hard core coated by a layer of hydratable, swellable clay such as bentonite are useful for constructing, modifying and/or supporting lifeline structure such as dams, berms and levees, and/or pipelines or conduits for oil, gas, sewage, water, or cables or wires for transmission of electrical power or data information. The method involves placing the composite particles in a location within, below, or about the lifeline structure, and hydrating them to cause them to swell and fill and seal the voids around the structure to form a resilient support having a high damping ratio and low hydraulic conductivity that is maintained after exposure to strain forces. The composite particles are advantageous in damping seismic waves and reducing the potential damage from an earthquake, explosion, tremor, fatigue loading, or similar seismic event.

title_en: A kind of Novel firefighting life-escape slow-falling device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Novel firefighting life-escape slow-falling devices, including descending lifeline, locking member and rope reel, integral type descending lifeline hook connecting hole is provided at the top of the descending lifeline, governor is provided with below the descending lifeline, speed-regulating switch is provided at the governor center, and rope reel is provided with below governor left end, the rope reel includes two annular rope side panels, the inner ring and bearing outer ring of two rope side panels are socketed, the outer ring of two bearing inner races and rope rope beam barrel is socketed, there are flat key slots on the inner wall of the rope rope beam barrel, the locking member includes the strip locking ontology of metal material, the both ends of the locking ontology are hinged with the first clamping part and the second clamping part.The utility model descending lifeline may be implemented fixed point and stop dropping, and motor driven rope rope beam barrel carries out the electric stowing of slow descending rope rope, time saving and energy saving, and design reasonable, safe and efficient.
assignees: SHENYANG INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Electric power communication network redundant path strategy acquiring method
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power communication network redundant path strategy acquiring method. The method includes the following steps that: an electric power network fault propagation model is established according to the capacity load information of an electric power network node; a communication network model composed of a control center node and router nodes is established, an interdependent coupling network model of an electric power communication network is established according to connection relations between nodes in the electric power network fault propagation model and communication network nodes; and the minimum subnet of the interdependent coupling network model is obtained, wherein the minimum subnet describes the redundant path strategy of the electric power communication network. When the electric power communication network malfunctions, fault information occurrence can be suppressed according to the redundant route strategy, and therefore, cascaded power outage caused by fault propagation can be avoided or alleviated, and the reliability of an electric power communication network system can be improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power grid toughness assessment method and system based on urban lifeline cross-system interconnection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for evaluating toughness of a power grid based on cross-system interconnection of urban lifelines, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a communication network model of the power grid to be evaluated in a target area; the method comprises the steps of carrying out fault propagation on a power grid to be evaluated under a preset disaster situation through a preset cascading fault mechanism to obtain a fault propagation result, carrying out recovery simulation on the power grid to be evaluated under the preset disaster situation through a preset recovery mechanism to obtain a recovery simulation result, analyzing the fault propagation result and the recovery simulation result based on a predefined structural toughness index to obtain the structural toughness of the power grid to be evaluated, analyzing the fault propagation result and the recovery simulation result based on a predefined functional toughness index to obtain the functional toughness of the power grid to be evaluated, fusing the structural toughness and the functional toughness to obtain comprehensive toughness, and completing the toughness evaluation of the power grid to be evaluated. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device remarkably improve the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the power grid toughness evaluation.

title_en: 3D Active Warning and Recognition Environment (3D AWARE): A low Size, Weight, and Power (SWaP) LIDAR with Integrated Image Exploitation Processing for Diverse Applications
abstract_en: An invention is disclosed for a multi-mode LIDAR sensor system that embodies a high pulse rate fiber laser operating in the SWIR wavelength at 1.5 microns, a long linear array of small SWIR sensitive detectors with very high speed readout electronics, and fully integrated methods and processing elements that perform target detection, classification, and tracking using techniques that emulate how the human visual path processes and interprets imaging data. High resolution three dimensional images are created of wide areas. Image exploitation processing methods detect objects and object activities in real time thus enabling diverse applications such as vehicle navigation, critical infrastructure protection, and public safety monitoring.

title_en: Wind farm short-term wind speed prediction method combining VMD and attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power plant short-term wind speed prediction method combining a VMD and an attention mechanism, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining wind speed space-time data of a target site, establishing a series SWSM according to an original data set, carrying out VMD wind speed decomposition on SWSM, combining a CNN model with the attention mechanism, aiming at each son SWSM, using a SENet model at the bottom layer to extract airspace characteristics of wind speed, carrying out wind speed time domain characteristic extraction by using a GRU model at the top layer to obtain respective prediction results, accumulating each prediction result to obtain final prediction wind speed, fully utilizing the space-time correlation of wind speed, combining the VMD and the attention mechanism, improving the unstable characteristic of the original wind speed, utilizing the attention mechanism to optimize the CNN-GRU model, enabling the model to capture the characteristics of long-distance interdependence in the sequence more easily, effectively improving the wind speed prediction precision, and guaranteeing the reliable operation of a power system.

title_en: Quantitative analysis method for influence on grid real-time load control caused by communication failures
abstract_en: The present invention provides a quantitative analysis method for an influence on grid real-time load control caused by communication failures, and considers a power system and a communication system to be a coupled and interdependent complex system for analysis. The quantitative analysis method based on the influence on grid real-time load control caused by communication failures can make importance assessment on monitoring and control equipment in a grid through the load shedding quantity, and can implement risk assessment on the power communication complex system through statistical analysis on an equipment availability probability. Based on this, by taking potential risks of various communication failures occurrence and consequences thereof into consideration, centralized grid control measures are adjusted in real time to minimize the expanded risk of the grid accident, thereby providing an implementation basis to establish and design a grid online assistant decision-making system for communication risks.

title_en: Optimized control of power depots using multi-tenant charging system-of-systems
abstract_en: Optimization of independently operated power infrastructure sites, such as electric vehicle (EV) depots, can result in sub-optimal operation across a plurality of power infrastructure sites. Disclosed embodiments aggregate a plurality of power infrastructure sites, which support flexible loads, into a virtual site model, representing a multi-tenant charging system-of-systems, that can be optimized as a single unit, across one or more criteria, to maximize utilization of infrastructure assets and provide robustness against uncertainties during operation of the power infrastructure sites, while minimizing energy costs. When applied to EV depots, embodiments can mitigate or reduce delays in the operation of EV fleets.

title_en: Power system load prediction method based on double-layer XGBoost considering multiple characteristics
abstract_en: A power system load prediction method based on double-layer XGBoost considering multiple characteristics adopts CART tree as a base learner, inputs preprocessed historical load and characteristic data, trains layer by constructing a plurality of weak learners to obtain a model and screens a characteristic set which obviously influences the load. In the second layer model training process, K-fold cross validation is introduced to divide a training set and a testing set of data, so that the influence on the model hyper-parameters is avoided, and finally, the characteristics of the testing set are input into the model to obtain a final prediction result. The method has the advantages of avoiding standardization of data characteristics, processing field missing data, avoiding concern about whether the characteristics are interdependent or not, having good model learning effect, providing a novel prediction method for accurate load prediction of the power system, ensuring safe and stable operation of the power system, ensuring reliability of power supply and improving social and economic benefits.

title_en: Reverse powering system for telecommunications node
abstract_en: To initiate the transmission of electrical power over a telecommunications connection (14) from a power-collecting telecommunications interface unit (16) such as a customer premises equipment, connectable to a power supply (18), to a power-receiving unit (22, Fig 4) such as a kerbside electrical/cptical interface, when a connection (14) is first established, or the collecting unit is first powered up, or in order to re-establish connection after a power outage, control signals are transmitted between low-power modems (55) in the interface units using a low-power communications protocol. This allows the controlled initiation of a larger power output and a higher speed exchange of data once the full telecommunications connection has been established. A low-powered beacon signal is transmitted over the telecommunications connection (14) by the power-collecting telecommunications interface unit on connection to a power supply (18), for detection by the power-receiving telecommunications interface unit. In the event of a loss of power at the input (18), the low power modem (55) initiates power management control signals to cause the power-receiving telecommunications interface to shut down certain functions in order to preserve backup power for essential "lifeline" services.

title_en: Multi-dimensional, multi-layer and multi-granularity multi-network fusion modeling method
abstract_en: The multi-dimensional, multi-layer and multi-granularity multi-network fusion modeling method provided by the embodiment of the application comprises the steps of constructing a multi-dimensional network model according to network data, wherein the multi-dimensional network model comprises a power grid multi-dimensional network, a telecommunication network multi-dimensional network, a radio and television network multi-dimensional network and an internet multi-dimensional network; in the multi-dimensional network model, a multi-granularity network model is constructed according to different network nodes as granularity units; connecting the related network nodes among different networks according to the coupling and association relation among the networks to construct a multilayer network model; obtaining a multi-dimensional, multi-layer and multi-granularity complex network model for describing a complex system after multi-network fusion; the method and the system not only comprehensively reflect the incidence relation of different individuals, families and communities under multi-network fusion, but also can effectively analyze and predict the behavior activities of the users and the user groups thereof, effectively reveal the complex, potential and internal incidence relation among the four networks, and provide basic support for the four-network fusion application service.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Emergency electric power supply train dispatching system and method for recovering urban power supply
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency power supply trolley dispatching system and method for recovering urban power supply in the technical field of power systems, comprising the following steps of obtaining global state information in the current state; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a scheduling path and a power supply strategy of an individual power supply vehicle through a power supply vehicle scheduling neural network model which is built in advance and comprises a DQN network and a shared attention module based on global state information in a current state, evaluating a reward value of the power supply vehicle after scheduling and supplying power to the power supply vehicle based on the scheduling path and the power supply strategy, obtaining a scheduling path and the power supply strategy with highest combined total value after training and updating the power supply vehicle scheduling neural network model based on the reward value, and scheduling and supplying power to all the power supply vehicles based on the scheduling path and the power supply strategy with the highest combined total value. According to the invention, the dispatching paths and strategies of a plurality of power supply vehicles are optimized through the DQN network and the power supply vehicle dispatching neural network model of the shared attention module, so that the recovery speed and efficiency of urban lifelines after disasters are effectively improved.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Electric power supply lifeline construction method based on secondary dry layer contact and mobile energy storage
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing an electric power supply lifeline based on secondary dry layer contact and mobile energy storage, which comprises the following steps of: step S1, obtaining power consumer information and net rack basic information; step S2, constructing an important power consumer evaluation index, and acquiring an important power consumer set according to the obtained power consumer information; step S3, constructing an electric power supply scheme based on sub-dry layer contact according to the obtained important electric power user set and the net rack basic information; step S4, establishing a mobile energy storage scheme according to the power load condition of an important power consumer; and step S5, comparing the electric power supply scheme based on the secondary dry layer contact and the mobile energy storage with the mobile energy storage scheme to obtain a better power supply scheme, and constructing an electric power lifeline based on the better power supply scheme. The invention solves the problem of the balance between the reliability and the economy of the power grid users, optimizes the power supply environment and further improves the power supply reliability of the power grid under the condition of better economy.

title_en: Analysis method for financial behaviors between electric power material market
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power material financial behavior analysis, in particular to an analysis method of financial behavior among current markets of electric power materials, which is characterized in that a complex network of a spot market and a complex network of a future market are respectively established according to time sequences among various modes, acceptance factors of price fluctuation by current market participants are introduced, a coarse granulation method is established to classify node states in the complex network of the current market, steady state coefficients of price difference between the current market and the current market are introduced, a double-layer coupling complex network is established based on price evolution relation among the two complex networks, and price coupling strength indexes are established to analyze financial behavior characteristics of the market participants. By constructing a multilayer network, a new method for analyzing financial behaviors between spot markets and futures markets through historical prices of electric power materials and raw materials thereof is provided, so that the price fluctuation rule of the electric power materials can be mastered more accurately, and theoretical support and technical guidance are provided for minimizing the purchase cost of the electric power materials.

title_en: A kind of horizontal rails device at shock insulation seam
abstract_en: A kind of horizontal rails device at shock insulation seam disclosed by the utility model, including left rotary shaft column steel pipe and right spindle column steel pipe, left built-in fitting and right built-in fitting, left flange plate and right ring flange, the dynamic steel pipe and dynamic steel pipe of right-hand rotation that turns left, several horizontal steel tubes and several left horizontal cases identical with horizontal steel tube quantity and right horizontal case.When an earthquake occurs, turn left to move steel pipe and dynamic steel pipe of turning right can be freely rotated, socket of the horizontal steel tube based on left horizontal case and right horizontal case can Free water smoothly move, to realize in seismic process, any direction movement can planar occur with both sides beam slab for the lifeline at shock insulation seam, and lifeline is in protection state always.

title_en: A kind of meter and the Wind turbines short term reliability Forecasting Methodology of running status
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of meter and the Wind turbines short term reliability Forecasting Methodology of running status, comprise the following steps: obtain Wind turbines state parameter by status monitoring with data collecting system, status monitoring parameter is divided into two classes；For device temperature parameter, set up state parameter forecast model based on reverse transmittance nerve network, calculate protection act probability based on prediction residual distribution character, for remaining parameter, calculate protection act probability according to meter and threshold crossing time；By wind energy turbine set operation maintenance data and SCADA data, stoppage in transit number of times and the moment wind speed of stopping transport of Wind turbines are added up, set up the Wind turbines statistics outage model that wind speed is interdependent；Get over limit information in conjunction with stoppage in transit statistical information and state parameter, calculate Wind turbines short-term stoppage in transit probability.This method can evaluate Wind turbines stoppage in transit risk in a short time exactly, increases substantially the accuracy of Wind turbines short-term outage model, and the short term reliability for whole wind energy turbine set is assessed and safety and economic operation provides Technical Reference.

title_en: A kind of horizontal rails device at shock insulation seam
abstract_en: A kind of horizontal rails device at shock insulation seam disclosed by the utility model, including left column steel pipe and right column steel pipe, left built-in fitting and right built-in fitting, upper left location tray and lower-left location tray, upper right location tray and bottom right location tray, upper left rotating casing and lower-left rotating casing, upper right rotating casing and bottom right rotating casing, upper horizontal steel tube and lower horizontal steel tube, intermediate steel pipe, left vertical steel pipe and right vertical steel pipe.When an earthquake occurs, upper left rotating casing and lower-left rotating casing can be rotated relative to left column steel pipe, upper right rotating casing and bottom right rotating casing can be rotated relative to right column steel pipe, upper horizontal steel tube, lower horizontal steel tube can Free water smoothly move, to realize in seismic process, any direction movement can planar occur with both sides beam slab for the lifeline at shock insulation seam, and lifeline is in protection state always.

title_en: Optimization method for coupling operation of multi-energy network and water distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization method for coupling operation of a multi-energy network and a water distribution network, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a water-energy connection operation model which is interdependent and acting according to the coupling relation between the water distribution network and a power transmission network, a gas transmission network and a heat distribution network in the multi-energy system; the built model is a double-target operation model of energy and resources; a dual-objective decision framework is adopted to realize fair balance between two objectives of energy and resource, and the water-energy linkage operation model is expressed as a mixed integer nonlinear model; and processing the double-objective competition relationship in the water-energy source relation operation model by utilizing a double-objective optimized Nash bargaining method to realize the optimization of the coupling operation of the multi-energy source network and the water distribution network. The method can realize the balance between the energy production cost and the water resource consumption, and provides a solution for the coordination and optimization of the energy and the resource under the comprehensive operation.

title_en: Tunnel construction risk assessment method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a risk assessment method and device for tunnel construction and a storage medium. The risk assessment method comprises the following steps: constructing a Bayesian network according to predetermined evaluation indexes, wherein the evaluation indexes comprise risk events of tunnel construction and influence indexes causing the risk events; acquiring construction site data of a current tunnel; determining the structural parameters of the Bayesian network according to the construction site data, the Copula function of the interdependence relation of the evaluation indexes and the marginal distribution parameters of each evaluation index; and constructing the risk event prediction model according to the structural parameters and the Bayesian network. According to the method and the device, the accuracy of the risk prediction model is guaranteed, the demand quantity and the model calculation quantity of data can be greatly reduced, and the method and the device can be used for evaluating multiple risks such as water inrush and mud gushing in the tunnel construction process.

title_en: Floating intelligent perimeter sensor system
abstract_en: A system, method, and floating intelligent perimeter sensor, provide protection for waterways and critical infrastructures. The system and method utilize one or more floating intelligent perimeter sensors to detect, and in some cases identify, hazardous materials associated with vessels in the waterways. The hazardous materials detected, and optionally identified, can include radiological materials, fissile materials, explosives, chemicals and biological materials (CBRNE). A set of radiation data associated with a radiation source in a vessel is received from the one or more floating intelligent perimeter sensors. At least one histogram is generated based on the set of radiation data. The at least one histogram is compared to multiple spectral images associated with known materials. The at least one histogram is determined to substantially match at least one of the multiple spectral images. A determination is made whether a material associated with the radiation source is a hazardous material.

title_en: Method and device for analyzing coupling risk of energy and traffic system in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for analyzing coupling risk of energy and a traffic system in extreme weather. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: respectively establishing a power system simulation operation model, a heating system simulation operation model, a traffic system simulation operation model and an extreme weather simulation model; after the electric power system simulation operation model, the heating system simulation operation model and the traffic system simulation operation model are coupled, an energy-traffic simulation operation model is established by considering the damage influence of the extreme weather simulation model; and based on the energy-traffic simulation operation model, carrying out risk analysis on the coupled energy-traffic system by utilizing Monte Carlo simulation. The invention can capture the mutual coupling and interdependence relation of different infrastructure systems when facing disaster damage, fully reveal the risks faced by the energy-traffic coupling system under the action of extreme weather disasters, and better assist the prevention and response of extreme weather events.

title_en: Lifeline incapacitation grading method, device, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a system and a storage medium for classifying life line incapacitation levels, which comprise the steps of S1, obtaining group mental state influence factors of sudden events, S2, obtaining sudden power disaster event influence factors, S3, correlating the group mental state influence factors with the sudden power disaster event influence factors, and carrying out sudden power disaster event severity assessment through a comprehensive fuzzy evaluation method. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the severity level of different sudden power disaster events can be given according to the actual conditions of the events.
