title_en: Power-Aware: DFOS Deployment A Hybrid Heuristic and Integer Linear Programming Strategy
abstract_en: A novel, two-stage Distributed Fiber Optic Sensor (DFOS) placement strategy and method that ensures resilient monitoring of critical infrastructure during electrical power supply failures. This strategy and method combines a heuristic algorithm, PURE (Power Source-aware Route Exploration), with Integer Linear Programming (ILP) optimization. The PURE algorithm explores potential DFOS routes while explicitly considering the dependency of DFOS devices on the electrical power distribution network, ensuring routes electrically powered by the same electrical power feeder are disjoint. Subsequently, the ILP selects the optimal set of DFOS placements to minimize the total number of deployed sensors while meeting critical infrastructure monitoring requirements, such as redundant monitoring for high-importance links. The method enhances the observability of critical links, achieving 100% monitoring coverage for important links during simulated power outages affecting an electric feeder.

title_en: Ready-package emergency bridge and construction method for changing same into permanent bridge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ready-package emergency bridge and a construction method for changing the same into a permanent bridge. The ready-package emergency bridge comprises at least two longitudinal beams and bridge road steel plates, wherein the at least two longitudinal beams are parallelly laid; the bridge road steel plates are laid on the longitudinal beams and can limit horizontal and longitudinal freedom degrees; each longitudinal beam comprises longitudinal beam segments which are sequentially fixedly connected along a longitudinal direction; the horizontal longitudinal beams are fixedly connected through horizontal linkage; and the bridge road steel plates are laid on the longitudinal beams in segments along the longitudinal direction. The standard longitudinal beam segments can be combined into the longitudinal beams and the longitudinal beams and the standard bridge road steel plates are combined into a temporary bridge when accidents happen so that the bridge can be fast constructed after the accidents and the traffic of roads are restored within a shorter time to ensure that supplement and supply lifeline can be established in time or normal transportation can be restored after a disaster; in addition, after the emergency temporary bridge is open to traffic, the emergency temporary bridge can be changed into the permanent bridge without maintaining or reconstructing the accident bridge under the condition that the transportation is not obviously influenced, therefore period from the accident to the normal traffic of the road is obviously shortened, and manpower and material resource cost is saved.

title_en: Set ball vertical earthquake isolating cylinder
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of set ball vertical earthquake isolating cylinder, it comprises the open doffing in one end is closed in one end, at least one self-contained spheres is formed ball aggregate, dividing plate and one end and closes the open upper guide composition in one end, described ball aggregate is contained in the cylindrical shell of doffing, and described dividing plate directly lies in the top of set spheroid; Described upper guide is inserted in doffing.This shock insulation cylinder both can use as vertical earthquake isolating separately, can combine again with existing horizontal seismic isolation device, formed the compound support of three-dimensional isolation.Not only isolation property is good for this shock insulation cylinder, and simple structure, good endurance, cheap, have certain resistance to capsizing, be specially adapted to the building to vertical earthquake isolating sensitivity such as nuclear power station, lifeline engineering, towering high level, large span, long cantilever, and be applicable to the engineering structures that needs to isolate vertical ambient vibration.

title_en: Charge automatic payment system and method for paying charge automatically
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To pay charges without imposing loads on a charge collection institution and a user.  <P>SOLUTION: A charge automatic payment system 1 has a display screen 3A capable of displaying unpaid information on a user 2 in accordance with identification information on the user 2 of a lifeline, such as electricity, gas, and water, and is provided with: an automatic payment machine 3 which enables the user 2 to deposit charges corresponding to the unpaid information and can be installed at an arbitrary place; and a server 4 which is connected to the automatic payment machine 3 via a communication network 5 and can transmit a variety of information including the unpaid information on the user 2 to the automatic payment machine 3.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Floor multifunction emergency rescue fixator
abstract_en: The utility model floor multifunction emergency rescue fixator, be made up of fixing main part and fixing fitting, fixing main part is by front divider, rear adjustment divider and adjustment crossbeam composition, regulate on crossbeam and have adjustment locating hole, crossbeam front end is regulated to be fixedly connected with front divider, crossbeam front top is regulated to be fixedly connected with front support rod, front support rod is welded with C shape water-band fixed head, back-up block is all equipped with in the two ends of front support rod, two back-up blocks are respectively equipped with support and regulate pin, front support rod is provided with quick dress rope self-locking device, rear adjustment divider has pin, pin upper end is respectively provided with a plate, two connecting plates have pin-and-hole and are furnished with Bolt with latching action, the shaft of pin installs clamping screw and presser feet is housed, connecting plate welding back stay, regulates back partition frame to be connected with adjustment crossbeam by Bolt with latching action, fixing fitting has a doorframe shaped steel frame, and steelframe one side block pin is provided with fastening screw mandrel, and fastening screw mandrel is provided with presser feet, the utility model makes simple, is easy to carry, safe and reliable, and collection fire hose, rope ladder, safety rope and descending lifeline are fixed as one.

title_en: Dynamic Contingency Avoidance and Mitigation System
abstract_en: The disclosed subject matter provides systems and methods for allocating resources within an infrastructure, such as an electrical grid, in response to changes to inputs and output demands on the infrastructure, such as energy sources and sinks. A disclosed system includes one or more processors, each having respective communication interfaces to receive data from the infrastructure, the data comprising infrastructure network data, one or more software applications, operatively coupled to and at least partially controlling the one or more processors, to process and characterize the infrastructure network data; and a display, coupled to said one or more processors, for visually presenting a depiction of at least a portion of the infrastructure including any changes in condition thereof, and one or more controllers in communication with the one or more processors, to manage processing of the resource, wherein the resource is obtained and/or distributed based on the characterization of said real time infrastructure data.
assignees: ANDERSON ROGER N;BOULANGER ALBERT;JOHNSON JOHN A

title_en: Use of composite particles for protecting a lifeline structure against seismic wave damage
abstract_en: Composite particles of a hard core coated by a layer of hydratable, swellable clay such as bentonite are useful for constructing, modifying and/or supporting lifeline structure such as dams, berms and levees, and/or pipelines or conduits for oil, gas, sewage, water, or cables or wires for transmission of electrical power or data information. The method involves placing the composite particles in a location within, below, or about the lifeline structure, and hydrating them to cause them to swell and fill and seal the voids around the structure to form a resilient support having a high damping ratio and low hydraulic conductivity that is maintained after exposure to strain forces. The composite particles are advantageous in damping seismic waves and reducing the potential damage from an earthquake, explosion, tremor, fatigue loading, or similar seismic event.

title_en: Vulnerability assessment method based on mixed transmission allocation factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vulnerability assessment method based on mixed transmission allocation factors, which belongs to the technical field of interdependent network vulnerability assessment and comprises the steps of constructing a coupling system model comprising an electric power network layer, a hydrogen energy network layer and a logistics network layer, respectively calculating the transmission allocation factors of the electric power network layer, the hydrogen energy network layer and the logistics network layer, establishing an interlayer sensitivity coupling relation through a coupling weight matrix, forming a global mixed transmission allocation factor (MTDF) matrix by adopting a layered sensitivity calculation and cross-layer coupling mapping technology, realizing cross-layer influence quantification of new energy output fluctuation, automatically identifying key fragile nodes and establishing a cascading fault propagation model, and solving the technical problem of assessing the coupling vulnerability of a three-layer network of a green harbor electric power-hydrogen energy-logistics by calculating L2 norm to propose a vulnerability assessment index before and after a fault.

title_en: Recycling asphalt concrete for subbase layer of way using waste asphalt concrete and cinder
title_ko: 폐아스팔트 콘크리트 및 석탄재를 이용한 도로 기층용 상온 재생 아스팔트 콘크리트
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A room temperature recycling asphalt concrete for a sub-base layer using waste asphalt concrete and coal dust is provided to prevent carbon dioxide and toxic gas which is generated in heating concrete by manufacturing the concrete at room temperature without heating process. CONSTITUTION: A room temperature rejuvenated asphalt concrete for a sub-base layer comprises: coal dust 5 - 100 parts by weight; waste limestone or granular activated charcoal 1 - 12 parts by weight; blister steel low heat mixed cement 5 - 20 parts by weight; reject ash 0.1 - 10 parts by weight; anhydrous gypsum or blending material 0.1 - 5 parts by weight; an emulsifier 0.1 - 1 parts by weight; an elastomer 0.1 - 10 parts by weight; and calcium silicate aqueous solution 0.1 - 10 parts by weight.

title_en: Fault Detection and Diagnosis System of Sensors Network for Critical Infrastructure System
title_ko: 주요기반설비의 센서 망에 대한 고장 탐지 및 원인 진단 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 CIS의 하나인 도시가스 배관망의 고장 탐지 및 진단 시스템에 관한 것으로,  수신부(110), 수신한 데이터의 잡음을 제거하는 전처리 모듈(120), 상기 전처리 모듈(120)로부터 제공받은 측정값에서 잡음이 제거된 데이터에 대해 다변량통계분석 기법인 PCA 모델로부터 도출된 소정의 수식을 이용하여 측정센서의 고장을 탐지하는 고장탐지 모듈(130), 상기 고장탐지 모듈(130)에서 측정센서 고장이 탐지되면, 다중블록 PCA(MBPCA)  모델로부터 도출된 소정의 수식을 통해 고장센서가 포함된 블록을 식별하는 고장블록 진단 모듈(140), 상기 고장블록 진단 모듈(140)에서 식별한 블록에 포함된 센서들을 대상으로 PCA 모델로부터 도출된 소정의 수식을 통해 고장센서를 식별하는 고장센서 진단 모듈(150), 상기의 고장센서 진단 모듈(150)에서 결정한 센서 고장 진단 결과를 단말기(200)로 보내는 송신부(160)를 포함한다. 본 발명의 실시예에서, 객관적인 성능 지수를 개발하여 PCA와 비교하여 성능이 개선될 경우에만 MBPCA를 사용하도록 하여 도시가스 배관망의 고장 탐지 및 진단 시스템의 성능을 높일 수 있다.

title_en: City lifeline remote monitering system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city life line remote monitoring system, relating to the technical field of city management, and aiming at the problems of labor waste and labor waste in the prior art, the invention provides a scheme which comprises a cloud background monitoring system, wherein the cloud background monitoring system is remotely and wirelessly connected with an oil transportation online monitoring system, a hot gas online monitoring system, an electric power online monitoring system, a water supply online monitoring system, a sewage online monitoring system, a precipitation online monitoring system, a bridge online detection system, a special equipment online monitoring system, a fire fighting online monitoring system and a personnel online monitoring system, the invention can carry out nearby treatment at the first time, reduce the situation development, further reduce the damage caused by danger, maximally ensure the city operation and the life and property safety of people, simultaneously reduce the frequency of personnel detection, further reduce the working intensity and the labor input of personnel, the efficiency and the frequency of detection are increased, and the safe and stable operation of the lifeline is further ensured.

title_en: Electric power Internet of things security risk assessment method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric power automation, and discloses a safety risk assessment method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for an electric power internet of things, which comprises the steps of establishing an information network graph, an electric power network graph and an inter-network dependency relationship of the electric power internet of things based on a dependent network theory; acquiring attacked nodes in the information network graph, assigning the state values of the attacked nodes to preset attack success probability, and updating the state values of all the nodes in the information network graph according to an information side graph calculation method; determining attack success probability of each node in the electric power network diagram through interdependency relation among networks according to the updated state value of each node in the information network diagram; determining the state value of each node in the electric power network graph by a physical side graph calculation method according to the attack success probability of each node in the electric power network graph; and obtaining a safety risk evaluation value of the power internet of things according to the state value of each node in the power grid graph. The safety assessment accuracy and comprehensiveness are greatly improved, and guidance is provided for designing or improving the topology of the power Internet of things.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Underground base facilities protection system using DAS system and drone
title_ko: Ｄａｓ 시스템과 드론을 이용한 지중매설 기반 시설 보호 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is an underground infrastructure protection system using a DAS system and a drone. The underground infrastructure protection system using a DAS system and a drone according to the present invention comprises: an integrated control server linked to an underground infrastructure management system including piping, power and communication cables, gas pipes, and oil pipelines and a distributed acoustic surveillance (DAS) system using optical communication cable; and a drone, wherein when the DAS system detects an excavation work related to underground infrastructure (piping, power and communication cables, gas pipes, oil pipelines), the DAS system dispatches the drone in emergency to allow the drone to arrive at a construction excavation site, capture the drone's camera video and transmit the same to the integrated control server and provide workers with remote warning broadcasts by using the drone's speaker to caution against digging during construction work. Accordingly, warnings about construction excavations are broadcast by using the drone's speaker to prevent damage to the underground infrastructure in advance.
abstract_ko:
DAS 시스템과 드론을 이용한 지중매설 기반 시설 보호 시스템이 개시된다. 
DAS 시스템과 드론을 이용한 지중매설 기반 시설 보호 시스템은 배관, 전력 및 통신 케이블, 가스관, 송유관이 포함된 지하매설물 관리 시스템과 광통신 케이블을 이용한 분산 음향 감시(DAS) 시스템과 연동된 통합관제서버; 및 상기 분산 음향 감시(DAS) 시스템이 지중매설 기반시설(배관, 전력 및 통신 케이블, 가스관, 송유관)에 관련된 굴착 공사가 감지되면, 드론을 긴급 출동시켜 건설 공사 굴착 현장에 도착하여 드론의 카메라 영상 촬영 통합관제서버로 전송, 드론의 스피커를 사용한 작업자들에게 건설 공사 굴착 주의 원격 경고방송을 제공하는 드론을 포함한다.   
그렇게 함으로써, 드론의 스피커를 사용한 건설 공사 굴착 주의 경고방송을 함으로써 지중매설 기반시설 손상을 사전에 방지한다.

title_en: Electrical Safety Emergency Response Systems and Related Methods
abstract_en: An electrical safety system and method is provided which includes a flexible electrical safety vest, a lifeline coupled with the vest in various configurations, and leg straps. The electrical safety vest includes a number of loops which are used to couple the lifeline in a variety of relationships that enable different types of maneuvering of a worker with relation to a hazard. Various embodiments of the invention can be used to rapidly and safety remove a worker from proximity to an immediate threat to their life, health, or safety. Direct and indirect extraction from a danger are enabled. A variety of methods are also provided for operating various embodiments of the invention.

title_en: A kind of quantitative analysis method that communication failure influences the control of power grid real-time load
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of quantitative analysis method that communication failure influences the control of power grid real-time load, electric system and communication system are considered to analyze at the composite system of coupling and interdependence, the present invention is based on quantitative analysis method of the communication system failure to electric system real-time load control service impact can be evaluated by off-load amount size the different degree that equipment is monitored and controlled in power grid, and by the statistical analysis to equipment availability probability, it can be achieved that power communication composite system risk assessment.Based on this, to all kinds of communication failures occur potential risk and caused by consequence consider, adjustment power grid centralized control measure in real time, makes the widened least risk of power grid accident, so that the powernet aid decision-making system for building meter and communication risk provides implementation basis.

title_en: Attack party view angle-based network attack risk assessment method for CPS (control Performance Standard) mutual existence system of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network CPS (cyber physical system) interdependence system cyber attack risk assessment method based on an attacker perspective, which is used for analyzing the risk level caused by starting attacks on a power grid CPS system and analyzing the risk condition of a potential attack path of a power grid on the premise of different attack invasion objectives from the perspective of an attacker, can provide a new perspective for the research of a security analysis and protection method of the power grid CPS and provides an accurate basis for power grid operators to make defensive measures.

title_en: System and method of mobile field inspection
title_ko: 모바일 현장조사 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 단말기에 탑재된 현장조사 앱을 통해 현장조사 관리시스템 서버에 저장된 현장정보를 열람하는 단계, 상기 현장조사 앱에 현장의 주소, 현장 주변 건물이나 시설물 이름, 현장의 지명 등과 같은 현장 정보를 입력하고, 상기 입력된 현장 정보에 대응되는 현장의 현장조사방법 유형으로서, point inspection, node checking 및 route following으로 이루어진 군에서 선택된 현장조사방법 유형을 상기 현장조사 관리시스템 서버로부터 제공받는 단계 및 상기 현장 유형에 따라 수행된 현장조사 결과를 상기 현장조사 관리시스템 서버에 전송하는 단계를 포함하는 위치기반 모바일 현장조사 방법 및 이러한 방법을 구현하는 위치기반 모바일 현장조사 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 복잡한 도시에서 도시 기반시설, 건축물, 교통, 문화재, 공공시설 등 다양한 도시 요소들에 대한 현장조사 수행에 있어서, 지속적이고 장기적으로 수집해야 할 정보를 체계적이고 통합적으로 관리할 수 있고, 효율적인 모니터링 시스템을 구현할 수 있다.

title_en: Power backup system
abstract_en: An electrically powered node (3) of a telecommunications system has a battery power backup (37) associated with its power control unit (33). Under normal conditions it are maintained fully charged by means of trickle currents from the mains power feeds (14) to each of a number of mains- connected customer equipments (4), by way of the "final drop" (10) to the distribution point. These trickle currents are controlled by the respective power control units (33, 43), to prevent overcharging. Using an electrical copper connection (19) provided in parallel with the fibre connection (9), a battery backup (27) can also be maintained in nodes (2) further towards the exchange. These feeds are made reversible, so that if a power outage removes the power supply (14) from the customer premises (4), a "lifeline" plain telephone service between the exchange (1) and the telephone handset (5) is maintained over the connections (9, 10, 13), using the local battery backup (27, 37) in the remote nodes (2, 3). By limiting the service to simple telephony, the battery power (27, 37, 47) can be sufficient to maintain the service for a reasonable duration. The power management systems (23, 33, 43) can be used to transfer charge from one battery (27, 37) to another over the network according to the usage, or remaining life, of each battery (27, 37, 47).

title_en: A kind of environment in mobile stations monitoring management system based on narrowband Internet of Things
abstract_en: A kind of environment in mobile stations monitoring management system based on narrowband Internet of Things described in the utility model, including：Data acquisition device, application server monitor computer, and the data acquisition device includes, power monitoring unit, Environment Monitor Unit, fire fighting monitoring unit, control unit, protenchyma combined network communication unit.Pass through data acquisition device independent acquisition and transmission environment in mobile stations information, it is not take up master transmissions passage, and integrated action monitoring unit, it realizes and the full name of environment in mobile stations is detected, simultaneously communications are carried out using narrowband Internet of Things, signal penetration power is strong, equipment power dissipation is low, network reliability and safe, promote base station internally-powered distribution, environmental parameter, the validity of security protection administration of the prevention and control, so as to improve base station communication supportability, superior technique support is provided for communication infrastructure network, is conducive to communication network and generates better economic benefit.

title_en: Functional recovery decision-making method of interdependent hydroelectric system based on flexible city
abstract_en: The invention discloses a functional recovery decision-making method of a hydropower system based on interdependence of a flexible city, which comprises the following steps: s1, initialization data: s2, randomly generating a plurality of sequences of the serial numbers of the damage components, wherein the sequences are used as chromosomes, namely the initial population, setting the identity codes of the chromosome slices and an information pool of the integral hydroelectric function level in the corresponding damage state, and setting the iteration times of a genetic algorithm; s3, judging whether the identity code of the chromosome slice to be evaluated already exists in the information pool: if the water-electricity integral function level exists, the water-electricity integral function level in the information pool is directly called; otherwise, calculating to obtain the integral function level of the hydropower; and S4, operating the chromosome to obtain the next generation of chromosomes, and selecting the optimal chromosome based on the adaptive function value if the iteration times are reached. The method can meet the requirement of time urgency of recovery after disasters when optimizing the function recovery decision method of the interdependent hydropower system, thereby being really applied to actual disaster scenes.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;STRAIT INNOVATION INTERNET CO LTD

title_en: Distributed power supply generated power prediction method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for predicting the generated power of a distributed power supply, which belong to the technical field of power generation power prediction and comprise the steps of collecting wind speed data and radiation intensity data during power generation of the distributed power supply, and calculating a wind speed influence coefficient and radiation conversion efficiency based on the wind speed data and the radiation intensity data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a distributed power prediction network comprising an input processing layer, a feature mapping layer, a space-time fusion layer, an optimization feedback layer and a prediction output layer, generating a power generation predicted value, and calculating a confidence interval of the power generation predicted result through the power generation predicted value based on a Bayesian inference method. The invention effectively solves the problem of uncertainty in the prediction of the power generated by the distributed power supply by combining the space-time feature extraction and the Bayesian inference method. Compared with the traditional method, the method can accurately capture the fluctuation and the interdependence of radiation conversion and wind speed influence in time and space dimensions, thereby improving the precision of the prediction of the generated power.
assignees: XINGYUAN ZHIYUAN TECH CHENGDU CO LTD;SHANGHAI JIAO TONG UNIVERSITY SICHUAN RESEARCH INST

title_en: Remote monitoring and early warning system for urban lifeline
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of urban management, and discloses a remote monitoring and early warning system for an urban lifeline. The system comprises: the monitoring system, the middleware of the Internet of things and the server are electrically connected in sequence; the monitoring system is used for acquiring monitoring data related to the urban lifeline; the internet of things middleware is used for converting formats of all monitoring data into unified internet of things metadata, and converting the internet of things metadata corresponding to the monitoring data after format conversion into different business event data for processing by a server side according to different business rules preset by different types of monitoring data; the server side is used for respectively monitoring the states of the urban lifelines corresponding to the different types of monitoring data according to the different types of service event data, acquiring alarm data in the service event data, and carrying out early warning display on the alarm data when the states of the urban lifelines are abnormal. The application can realize the modern informatization comprehensive management of the urban lifeline.

title_en: Wind power multi-scale decomposition prediction method
abstract_en: A wind power multi-scale decomposition prediction method. The current single-point prediction is not comprehensive and accurate enough, and cannot be adapted to the quantitative and accurate requirements of wind power plants and power grid dispatching institutions on risk management. The method comprises the steps of sequentially performing feature selection and data decomposition processing on actually obtained wind power data to form an original wind power sequence, constructing a depth prediction model according to the multi-scale modal data, completing a determination process of a probability prediction interval in a residual error distribution mode depth prediction model through self-adaptive bandwidth kernel density estimation, establishing an initial model after the actually obtained wind power data is formed into the original wind power sequence, performing feature selection processing on the initial model, namely calculating weighted marginal contribution on each feature of the initial model according to all related feature subsets by utilizing a SHAP algorithm based on a Shapley value in a game theory, and completing a feature data acquisition process of accurately quantifying interdependence and interaction effects among features.

title_en: Liquefaction countermeasure method of existing buried pipe
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a liquefaction countermeasure method of an existing buried pipe in which a liquefaction countermeasure of lifelines of gas-pipes, potable water pipes, sewer pipes, etc., in residential areas such as subdivision lots for sale where roads and detached houses are densely built can be performed simply and economically.SOLUTION: Two or more filling pipes 2 are installed at predetermined intervals in an extension direction of an existing buried pipe 1. Liquid chemicals are injected from the filling pipes 2 by either following methods, and the existing buried pipe 1 is integrated with an agglomeration body in the earth to be refilled, and thereby the floating of the existing buried pipe 1 in the earthquake is suppressed. (1) A method for suppressing the floating of the existing buried pipe 1 in the earthquake by fixing the existing buried pipe 1 in the non-liquefaction layer of the natural ground. (2) A method for suppressing the floating of the existing buried pipe 1 by solidifying the earth to be refilled under the existing buried pipe to thereby cause the earth of the non-liquefaction layer to fall into right and left parts and the upper part thereof in the earthquake. (3) A method for suppressing the floating by solidifying the upper surface or the side surface of the existing buried pipe 1 and integrating the existing buried pipe 1 with the agglomeration body to thereby increase the gravity applied to the existing buried pipe 1 and the agglomeration body.
assignees: UNIV TOKYO;KYOKADO ENG CO;KYOKADO ENG CO

title_en: Method and storage medium for realizing parallel computation of power dispatching mass data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing parallel computation of power dispatching massive data and a storage medium, wherein the method analyzes a computation request by means of a lexical analysis, analyzes different phrases and interdependencies of the computation request to obtain a lexical analysis table, combines the analyzed lexical analysis table into a multi-way tree to form a grammar analysis tree, converts the grammar analysis tree into a sequence dependency graph of object operation to form an object computation graph, converts the object computation graph into a series of vector primitive operations through a vectorization computation engine to form a vector computation graph, and enables the vector primitive operations to be executed on a multi-core processor, thereby improving the parallel efficiency of the power dispatching multi-element heterogeneous massive data computation.

title_en: Novel lifeboat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel lifeboat, including the lifeboat body, the inside fixed mounting of lifeboat body has fixed leg ware, and the upper surface of lifeboat body is provided with the wiring ware, one side fixedly connected with couple of lifeboat body, the surface of couple cup joints and installs the life buoy, one side fixed mounting of life buoy has the lifeline, the other end and the wiring ware fixed connection of lifeline, one side of lifeboat body is close to the rear surface position department fixed mounting of life buoy and has the bumper. The utility model discloses a set up fixed leg ware, can fix own both legs when the rescuer rescues, on pulling the lifeboat with the personnel of falling into water again, avoided sliding into the river from the lifeboat in, through setting up second spring and bolt, can come its fix according to the thickness of leg, through setting up first pivot, the rescuer can adjust the direction wantonly, has brought the convenience for the rescuer.

title_en: Wind power plant short-term wind speed prediction method combining VMD and attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term wind speed prediction method for a wind power plant combining a VMD (minimum mean Square) and an attention mechanism, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining wind speed space-time data of a target station, establishing a series SWSM (Single-Range short Range; extracting wind speed time domain characteristics by using the GRU model at the top layer, and obtaining respective prediction results; accumulating all the prediction results to obtain a final predicted wind speed; the method fully utilizes the time-space correlation of the wind speed, combines the VMD and the attention mechanism, improves the unstable characteristic of the original wind speed, optimizes the CNN-GRU model by utilizing the attention mechanism, enables the model to capture the long-distance interdependence characteristic in the sequence more easily, effectively improves the wind speed prediction precision, and ensures the reliable operation of the power system.

title_en: Early overflow detection and grading early warning processing system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an early overflow detection and grading early warning processing system and method, and belongs to the technical field of well control safety in petroleum and natural gas drilling engineering. According to the invention, potential nodes are introduced as intermediate variables, so that the dependency relationship among attribute variables is simplified, and a plurality of attribute variables are independent relative to the intermediate variable conditions, so that the model structure is simplified, and meanwhile, the interdependence relationship among the nodes can be reflected, thereby being applied to actual working conditions and achieving the purposes of improving the overflow monitoring accuracy and reducing the discrimination error. In addition, the invention also increases a plurality of grading early warning thresholds, constructs an overflow early warning risk assessment part and an early warning grading and processing mode part, can more comprehensively understand stratum characteristics, judge overflow causes and control subsequent shaft pressure, and has important significance.

title_en: A kind of elastic distribution network planning method based on extreme disturbance event
abstract_en: The elastic distribution network planning method based on extreme disturbance event that the invention discloses a kind of, this method passes through disaster-resistant type Electric Power Network Planning key technology of the further investigation based on lifeline engineering, in view of the power distribution network service restoration towards lifeline engineering, first, it is to restore electrical breakdown element and important load as primary goal, pay attention to rapidity, emphasizes Saving in time costs.Its main task is the system power generation capacity obtained using recovery process initial stage, and search is allowed to realize with block switch, interconnection switch that important load is connected reasonably to grid transmission, in the shortest possible time gradually recovery system rack.Secondly, interconnection switch is operated by what is be directly connected with power supply interrupted district in dragnet, using recovery power failure load as much as possible as main target.Finally, by Dissatisfied rope net it is indirect be connected with power supply interrupted district operate interconnection switch, the sorry of all loads cannot be restored to make up local distribution, realized with local with network recovery cooperation.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD YANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Urban lifeline gas pipeline flood emergency prevention and control system and method based on large model
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-model-based urban lifeline gas pipeline flood emergency prevention and control system and method, which are applied to the technical field of gas pipeline flood emergency. The system comprises an emergency supervision management platform, wherein the emergency supervision management platform is configured to construct a gas pipe network map based on pipeline pressures and gas flow rates of a plurality of pipeline nodes, determine a plurality of suspected leakage points and leakage confidence degrees, execute an evaluation step for each suspected leakage point, determine sampling radius according to the leakage confidence degrees, determine corrosion risks and deformation risks of the suspected leakage points based on water body data and image data, determine comprehensive risk values of target pipeline nodes based on the plurality of corrosion risks and the plurality of deformation risks through a prediction model, and automatically send control signals to a drainage robot to drive the drainage robot to drain water in response to the comprehensive risk values meeting drainage conditions. The invention can automatically perform risk assessment and emergency treatment and timely eliminate the potential safety hazard of damage to the gas pipeline caused by flood disasters.
assignees: CHENGDU QINCHUAN IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method for power outage and restoration notification in an advanced metering infrastructure network
abstract_en: A method and system are provided to transmit a meter power status. The method includes recognizing a power status change at a meter. The method includes, if the meter is scheduled to transmit first, transmitting a notification message to at least one neighboring meter towards a mesh gate, wherein the notification message includes a power status indicator and a meter identifier. The method includes, if the meter is not scheduled to transmit first, waiting a predetermined time period to receive a notification message from at least one neighboring meter. The method includes, responsive to receiving a notification message, adding a meter identifier to the received notification message before retransmitting the modified notification message to at least one neighboring meter. The method includes retransmitting the notification message.

title_en: Wind power multi-scale decomposition prediction method
abstract_en: A wind power multi-scale decomposition prediction method. The current single-point prediction is not comprehensive and accurate enough, and cannot be adapted to the quantitative and accurate requirements of wind power plants and power grid dispatching institutions on risk management. The method comprises the steps of sequentially performing feature selection and data decomposition processing on actually obtained wind power data to form an original wind power sequence, constructing a depth prediction model according to the multi-scale modal data, completing a determination process of a probability prediction interval in a residual error distribution mode depth prediction model through self-adaptive bandwidth kernel density estimation, establishing an initial model after the actually obtained wind power data is formed into the original wind power sequence, performing feature selection processing on the initial model, namely calculating weighted marginal contribution on each feature of the initial model according to all related feature subsets by utilizing a SHAP algorithm based on a Shapley value in a game theory, and completing a feature data acquisition process of accurately quantifying interdependence and interaction effects among features.

title_en: Multifunctional rescue fixed mount
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of multifunctional rescue fixed mount, belongs to fire-fighting equipment field.Be provided with guide plate, it is characterized in that, guide plate is longitudinal structure, a directive wheel is installed in the groove of guide plate front end, guide plate end is laterally fixed with a cross bar, the middle part of cross bar is vertically installed with a handles, the cross bar of handle both sides is welded with respectively the water-band retainer ring of two annulars, guide plate side is welded with rope ladder fixed mount successively, water knockout drum fixed mount, descending lifeline fixed mount, longitudinally two fixture blocks paralleled are fixed with on the downside of guide plate, two clamping plate are processed with respectively a screw, screw rod is combined with in screw, the end of screw rod is fixed with swing handle.The utility model can transport fire-fighting equipment from the outlet such as balcony, window and carry out the rescue of personnel, and rescue work efficiency is high, and fire fighter's physical demands is little, and can ensure the personal safety of fire fighter.

title_en: Floating intelligent perimeter sensor system
abstract_en: A system, method, and floating intelligent perimeter sensor, provide protection for waterways and critical infrastructures. The system and method utilize one or more floating intelligent perimeter sensors to detect, and in some cases identify, hazardous materials associated with vessels in the waterways. The hazardous materials detected, and optionally identified, can include radiological materials, fissile materials, explosives, chemicals and biological materials (CBRNE). A set of radiation data associated with a radiation source in a vessel is received from the one or more floating intelligent perimeter sensors. At least one histogram is generated based on the set of radiation data. The at least one histogram is compared to multiple spectral images associated with known materials. The at least one histogram is determined to substantially match at least one of the multiple spectral images. A determination is made whether a material associated with the radiation source is a hazardous material.

title_en: Transmission and distribution network collaborative optimization method and system considering electric power and traffic multilayer network coupling model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cooperative optimization of transmission and distribution networks, in particular to a cooperative optimization method and a cooperative optimization system of transmission and distribution networks, which take an electric power and traffic multilayer network coupling model into consideration. Because the single-moment operation feasible region of the power distribution network is influenced by the current state parameters of the system, the method adopts a deep learning method to realize the prediction of the single-moment operation feasible region of the power distribution network, and simultaneously, the lower boundary of the operation feasible region of the power distribution network is approximately processed in order to improve the accuracy of the prediction.

title_en: Planning and optimizing configuration method for active traction network energy system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a planning and optimizing configuration method of an active traction network energy system, which is characterized in that a planning and optimizing configuration method with universality is constructed through three typical scenes, and planning configuration is carried out on new energy and an energy storage system in the traction network by taking running cost and full life cycle net present values into consideration, so that the economic feasibility of a railway system is ensured, the carbon reduction of the railway system is ensured, and meanwhile, the energy source is maximally realized. According to the invention, a double-layer optimization model is adopted to perform capacity configuration optimization, an intelligent algorithm is adopted to perform capacity planning on a renewable energy system and an energy storage system by an upper-layer optimization model, the net present value cost in the whole life cycle is the lowest, the operation cost is calculated by a solver by a lower-layer optimization model, the operation cost of operation and maintenance, purchase, electricity selling and the like is reduced, the upper layer and the lower layer are interdependent, the whole life cycle cost and the real-time operation efficiency are considered, and the scientificity and the operability of the energy system planning are improved.
assignees: QINGHAI NEGO NEW ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Power backup system
abstract_en: An electrically powered node (3) of a telecommunications system has a battery power backup (37) associated with its power control unit (33). Under normal conditions it are maintained fully charged by means of trickle currents from the mains power feeds (14) to each of a number of mains- connected customer equipments (4), by way of the "final drop" (10) to the distribution point. These trickle currents are controlled by the respective power control units (33, 43), to prevent overcharging. Using an electrical copper connection (19) provided in parallel with the fibre connection (9), a battery backup (27) can also be maintained in nodes (2) further towards the exchange. These feeds are made reversible, so that if a power outage removes the power supply (14) from the customer premises (4), a "lifeline" plain telephone service between the exchange (1) and the telephone handset (5) is maintained over the connections (9, 10, 13), using the local battery backup (27, 37) in the remote nodes (2, 3). By limiting the service to simple telephony, the battery power (27, 37, 47) can be sufficient to maintain the service for a reasonable duration. The power management systems (23, 33, 43) can be used to transfer charge from one battery (27, 37) to another over the network according to the usage, or remaining life, of each battery (27, 37, 47).
assignees: BRITISH TELECOMM;COOPER IAN ROBERT;HUMPHREY LESLIE DEREK

title_en: natural circulation tree filter box system
title_ko: 자연순환형 나무화분 여과시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로지역 등 도시지역 불투수면에서 발생하는 비점오염원을 도시기반시설을 활용하여 저감하는 빗물 생태저류시설을 조성할 수 있는 시설로서, 기존에 식재되어 있는 조경수, 가로수 등을 이용할 수 있을 뿐 아니라 새로이 조성되는 도시지역 설계에도 적용이 가능하고, 시설을 설치 후에는 도시지역 및 도로에서 발생되는 비점오염원을 저감시키는 작용과 처리된 우수를 하수도로 이송을 시키는 것이 아닌, 지면저류 및 토양 저류를 통하여 첨두유량과 유출용적을 저감시켜 지하수 고갈 문제 해결 및 홍수 재해 방지에 도움이 되는 기술로 된 자연순환형 나무화분 여과시스템에 관한 것이다. 발명의 구성은 나무상자, 여재필터, 충수공간, 식재공간, 식생토 자갈 및 배수구로 이루어져 있다. 상부 식재공간에는 교목(가로수) 및 관목을 식재하여 도심조경을 자연스럽게 할 수 있으며, 하부에는 충수공간에 담수되어 있는 오염된 우수를 여과필터를 통해 일부는 식생토를 통해 식재된 수목에 공급이 되며, 일부는 지하로 순환되는 구조를 가진 자연순환형 나무화분 여과시스템이다. 이 시스템을 우수가 많이 발생하는 지역 등에서는 우수체류장치를 연결하여 더 많은 우수를 지하수로 환수시킬 수 있으며. 나무상자에 우수체류장치를 우수연결관으로 연결하여 활용할 수 있다. 우수체류장치 상부에는 식재공간을 두어 교목 등 초하류를 식재하여 화단의 형태로 사용할 수 있으며 식생분리판으로 분리된 지하부에는 충수공간을 두어 오염된 우수를 저장시켜 상부에 식재된 교목 등 초하류 등에 공급되고, 일부는 우수연결관을 통해 우수박스로 보내어져 가로수 및 지하수로 돌아가게 된다. 본 발명의 자연순환형 나무화분 여과시스템 설치 시 우수의 비점오염원 제거 및 첨두유출량 감소로 홍수 예방 등의 효과가 있다.

title_en: Monitoring method and device for gas facility
abstract_en: The application relates to a monitoring method and device for a gas facility, wherein the method comprises the following steps: map positioning information of a gas facility is obtained; determining corresponding equipment monitoring information according to the map positioning information; based on a preset communication rule, transmitting equipment monitoring information to an Internet of things facility monitoring platform. The device uses the method, the corresponding equipment monitoring information is determined by acquiring the map positioning information of the gas facility, and finally the equipment monitoring information is transmitted to the Internet of things facility monitoring platform based on the preset communication rule, so that the gas facility can be better monitored and managed, the real-time monitoring and control of the gas facility are realized, the state and risk of the facility are better evaluated, the safety of an urban lifeline is ensured, the safety and reliability of the equipment are improved, and the occurrence of accidents is effectively prevented.

title_en: Multi-station photovoltaic power generation power prediction method and system based on graph attention network
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-station photovoltaic power generation power prediction method and a system based on a graph attention network, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining a space dependency model containing a station space relationship according to the station dependency relationship based on the graph attention network; the method comprises the steps of constructing a time-dependent model containing site time relation based on an autoregressive long-term memory network and a probability framework, constructing a first missing data filling layer according to a spatial feature compensation strategy, constructing a second missing data filling layer according to a temporal feature compensation strategy, constructing a third missing data filling layer according to the space-time correlation of a neighbor site set, constructing a space-time data processing layer, and constructing a photovoltaic power generation power prediction model according to the spatial-dependent model, the time-dependent model and the time-space data processing layer by utilizing historical operation data of a photovoltaic site. The method has the beneficial effects of reducing the requirement on training data, improving the photovoltaic power generation power prediction pertinence, and improving the photovoltaic power generation power prediction accuracy and the model applicability.

title_en: Infrastructure cascade failure prediction method and system for flood disaster scenario construction
abstract_en: The invention provides an infrastructure cascade failure prediction method and system for constructing flood disaster situations, which comprise the steps of constructing extreme storm flood disaster situations by using a numerical simulation method, constructing independent network topologies of traffic infrastructures, power infrastructures and communication infrastructures, analyzing cascade relations and disaster propagation mechanisms of the power-communication-traffic infrastructures under extreme storm impact, constructing a third-order network model of urban key infrastructure cascade failure, wherein the third-order network model comprises the third-order network topology model, the extreme storm flood model, the disaster propagation model and the cascade failure model, setting infrastructure failure conditions according to the submerged water depth of the urban infrastructure affected by the extreme storm, and performing infrastructure node failure prediction, independent infrastructure network failure prediction and urban key infrastructure cascade failure prediction. The invention can predict the cascade failure of the infrastructure.

title_en: Railway geological disaster intelligent safety monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a railway geological disaster wisdom safety monitoring early warning system which includes following step 1) data acquisition module: including high integrated data acquisition equipment and low coupling data acquisition equipment, high integrated data acquisition equipment and low coupling data acquisition equipment all contain four functional unit at least: the device comprises a sensing module, a calculation storage module, a communication module and a power supply module; the high-integration data acquisition equipment is characterized in that a sensor module, a calculation storage module, a communication module and a power supply module are highly integrated in one equipment, and the modules are interdependent and cannot independently provide related functions; the low-coupling data acquisition equipment means that the communication module, the sensor module and the calculation storage module are relatively independent; the communication module and the power supply module are standardized and defined, and can be used for butting a plurality of standard or one different type of sensing equipment, and the RS485+ ModBus protocol is used for internal data transmission.

title_en: Arrangement and method for detecting at least one at least temporarily occurring billing-relevant physical event during use of an electrified non-rail-bound road vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to an arrangement for detecting at least one at least temporarily occurring billing-relevant physical event during use of an electrified non-rail-bound road vehicle, in particular road vehicle for transporting goods, preferably overhead line truck, in the catchment area of an electrified non-rail-bound road traffic network, in particular overhead line network, the electrified non-rail-bound road vehicle having at least one current collector, in particular one pantograph, and an energy-measuring device, in particular direct-current electricity meter, wherein the road vehicle, the current collector and the energy-measuring device are designed such that they are functionally connected to a communication bus, in particular a field bus, preferably a so-called controller area network bus, CAN bus, such that they can, in accordance with a communication protocol, form messages to be transmitted on the communication bus and/or read out messages received on the communication bus. The invention also relates to a corresponding method, to a non-rail-bound electrified road traffic vehicle and to a non-rail-bound electrified road traffic infrastructure network.

title_en: Use of composite particles for protecting a lifeline structure against seismic wave damage
abstract_en: Composite particles of a hard core coated by a layer of hydratable, swellable clay such as bentonite are useful for constructing, modifying and/or supporting lifeline structure such as dams, berms and levees, and/or pipelines or conduits for oil, gas, sewage, water, or cables or wires for transmission of electrical power or data information. The method involves placing the composite particles in a location within, below, or about the lifeline structure, and hydrating them to cause them to swell and fill and seal the voids around the structure to form a resilient support having a high damping ratio and low hydraulic conductivity that is maintained after exposure to strain forces. The composite particles are advantageous in damping seismic waves and reducing the potential damage from an earthquake, explosion, tremor, fatigue loading, or similar seismic event.

title_en: Fire Bell Induction Induction Display Indicator
title_ko: 화재벨 감응 발광 유도표시 완강기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a descending lifeline enabling people to make an emergency escape in case of a fire by using a wire rope and, more specifically, relates to a descending lifeline with a fire bell induction indicator, capable of enabling an escaper to make a quick escape by more easily recognizing the position of the descending lifeline through a chemical light emission lamp turned on after the detection of a fire bell for a predetermined time. The present invention comprises: a descending lifeline part having a wire rope wound thereon; and a lamp part for easy position recognition. The descending lifeline part comprises: a winding drum having a wire rope wound thereon; and a speed reducing gear part combined inside the winding drum to reduce the winding speed of the winding drum. The lamp part comprises: a descending display lamp turned on with supplied power; and a chemical light emission band lamp operated when power is cut off. According to the present invention, since the descending display lamp is turned on after an emergency bell sound is detected for a predetermined time, a malfunction of the descending display lamp caused by the malfunction of the emergency bell can be prevented, and also, even when power is cut off or backup power is discharged, the chemical light emission band lamp is operated to emit light chemically, and thus, the descending lifeline can always be recognized.

title_en: Tunnel construction risk assessment method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a risk assessment method and device for tunnel construction and a storage medium. The risk assessment method comprises the following steps: constructing a Bayesian network according to predetermined evaluation indexes, wherein the evaluation indexes comprise risk events of tunnel construction and influence indexes causing the risk events; acquiring construction site data of a current tunnel; determining the structural parameters of the Bayesian network according to the construction site data, the Copula function of the interdependence relation of the evaluation indexes and the marginal distribution parameters of each evaluation index; and constructing the risk event prediction model according to the structural parameters and the Bayesian network. According to the method and the device, the accuracy of the risk prediction model is guaranteed, the demand quantity and the model calculation quantity of data can be greatly reduced, and the method and the device can be used for evaluating multiple risks such as water inrush and mud gushing in the tunnel construction process.

title_en: Urban water relation-oriented urban storage and evacuation space optimization method and simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban water storage and drainage space optimization method and an urban water storage and drainage space simulation system, particularly relates to the field of urban water resource management and optimization, and aims to solve the problems of low efficiency and poor response capability of an urban water storage and drainage system, and avoid short-term season influence original data through a long-term and short-term memory network. Analyzing the contribution of the reservoirs in the dispatch network, calculating the comprehensive significance and interaction in combination with the multi-layer network analysis, and evaluating the importance of the reservoirs from multiple dimensions. And identifying a reservoir in a high-pressure area by adopting a clustering optimization method, performing space optimization, enhancing the adjusting capability and relieving the pressure in the high-load area. And combining a self-service method and Monte Carlo simulation test to optimize the reliability of the result, ensuring the stability and consistency of the high-influence area and avoiding accidental judgment. The urban water resource management system realizes the accurate regulation and control of the urban water storage and discharge system, improves the resource scheduling efficiency, ensures the stability and the sustainability of urban water resource management, and provides a scientific and effective optimization scheme.

title_en: Method for identifying fragile coupling link between power grid control system and power primary equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of safe and reliable operation guarantee of an intelligent power grid, and discloses a method for identifying a fragile coupling link between a power grid control system and primary power equipment, which comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a network model of a smart grid control system and primary power equipment interdependent coupling, wherein the network model comprises a power grid and an information grid; step 2, constructing a vulnerability identification method based on node centrality, thereby obtaining node electrical centrality indexes among all nodes in the power network and approximate centrality indexes of effective information lengths among all nodes in the information networkMarking; step 3, calculating comprehensive risk measurement index DLC based on power grid-information grid C (P i ，C i ) (ii) a Step 4, calculating the comprehensive risk measurement index DLC C (P i ，C i ) And finding out and removing the key fragile coupling link of the power grid-information grid. title_en: System and Method For Power Outage and Restoration Notification in an Advanced Metering Infrastructure Network
abstract_en: A method and system are provided to transmit a meter power status. The method includes recognizing a power status change at a meter. The method includes, if the meter is scheduled to transmit first, transmitting a notification message to at least one neighboring meter towards a mesh gate, wherein the notification message includes a power status indicator and a meter identifier. The method includes, if the meter is not scheduled to transmit first, waiting a predetermined time period to receive a notification message from at least one neighboring meter. The method includes, responsive to receiving a notification message, adding a meter identifier to the received notification message before retransmitting the modified notification message to at least one neighboring meter. The method includes retransmitting the notification message.

title_en: Method and system for predicting icing galloping of power transmission line
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for predicting icing galloping of a power transmission line, comprising the following steps: obtaining galloping monitoring data of a power transmission line; based on the galloping monitoring data of the power transmission line, a pre-trained deep learning galloping prediction model is utilized to obtain a prediction result of icing galloping of the power transmission line; the deep learning galloping prediction model is obtained by training a stacked self-encoder by taking historical galloping monitoring data as input data of training data and icing galloping index values corresponding to the historical galloping monitoring data as output data of the training data, wherein the stacked self-encoder comprises an input layer, at least two continuous hidden layers and a Softmax output layer; according to the application, the deep learning galloping prediction model constructed by stacking self-encoders based on a multi-layer network structure can be used for carrying out efficient and accurate icing galloping prediction on a large number of conditions.

title_en: Multi-mode large model-based intelligent power system fault diagnosis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent diagnosis method and system for a power system fault based on a multi-mode large model, comprising the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data in the operation of the power system through a power fault multi-mode knowledge center, transmitting the data to the multi-mode large model, extracting local features corresponding to the data and cross-mode associated features, inputting the extracted features into an electrical diagram RAG fault positioning algorithm, positioning a fault region and outputting a candidate set through graph structure matching, retrieval enhancement and range correction, inputting the candidate set feature data into a stacked self-encoder diagnosis model, performing layer-by-layer feature conversion and analysis through a multi-layer network, outputting fault feature vectors, inputting the vectors into a fault probability map reasoning algorithm, and determining fault types and probabilities through temporary map construction, rule screening, probability calculation and verification fusion, and feeding the results back to the knowledge center and performing visual presentation. The invention improves the positioning precision and the feature analysis depth of the fault area and effectively meets the fault diagnosis requirement of the modern power system.

title_ko: 밴사의 통신망을 이용한 가맹점의 위험감지 안내시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 가맹점주에게 위험감지 안내서비스를 제공 시 별도의 기반시설의 구축 없이도 제공이 가능한 밴사의 통신망을 이용한 가맹점의 위험감지 안내시스템에 관한 것으로, 가맹점에 설치되는 것으로 가맹점 내에 위험이 감지된 경우 이를 위험감지신호로 생성하는 위험감지센서부(10)와, 상기 침입감지센서(11)로부터 생성된 위험감지신호를 전송받아 위험발생신호로 가공하는 컨트롤러(20)와, 해당 가맹점을 식별하는 식별정보인 가맹점 식별정보가 기저장된 것으로 상기 컨트롤러(20)로부터 위험발생신호를 전송받아 그 전송된 위험발생신호에 상기 가맹점 식별정보를 취합하는 신용카드조회단말기(30)와, 상기 신용카드조회단말기(30)로부터 가맹점 식별정보가 취합된 위험발생신호를 전송받아 해당 위험을 제압하는 위험제압업체가 운영하는 업체단말기(50)로 해당 가맹점의 위험이 통보되도록 제어하는 VAN사 서버(40)로 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.
