title_en: Construction system of disaster prevention type building structure
abstract_en: To provide a construction system for disaster prevention type building structure that appropriately implements BCP measures in an event of a natural disaster according to type, scale, and installation status of the structure, securing a lifeline of each building structure, and using hydrogen that is a clean energy source as a fuel to replace fossil fuels.SOLUTION: An automatic electrical power generation device 1 is provided that is installed in a building construction structure and comprises as one unit, a fuel cell 2, hydrogen generation and supply means generating and supplying hydrogen as fuel, and activation means activating the hydrogen generation and supply means to generate hydrogen. In the automatic electrical power generation device, the hydrogen generation and supply means is constituted of methylcyclohexane 4 and a dehydrogenation device 3, the activation operation is constituted of a heating device 5 heating a catalyst 18. After the activation of the dehydrogenation device, the catalyst is heated by the heat of separated and generated toluene in place of the heating device to separate the methylcyclohexane 4 into hydrogen and toluene to generate hydrogen, which is used as fuel for the fuel cell.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: multiple standard gateway and its interface method
title_ko: 다표준 게이트웨이 및 정합 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multiple standard gateway and a matching method thereof for accommodating various standard wireless communication schemes in a gateway, supporting smooth communication with a command system, minimizing heat generated in a repeater by changing a communication scheme of a repeater exposed to high temperatures. According to the present invention, a multiple standard gateway comprises: a wireless transceiver for transmitting and receiving wirelessly with at least one of a disaster communication network, a mobile communication network, and a local area network; a repeater matching device for matching with a repeater and a lifeline to transmit a transmission/reception signal of the wireless transceiver to the repeater; and a control device for controlling the wireless transceiver and the repeater matching device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 게이트웨이에서 여러 표준의 무선 통신 방식을 수용하여 지휘 시스템과 원활한 통신을 지원하고, 고온에 노출된 중계기의 통신 방식을 가변하여 중계기에서 발생할 수 있는 열을 최소화하는 다표준 게이트웨이 및 정합 방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명의 다표준 게이트웨이는 재난 통신망, 이동 통신망, 및 근거리 통신망 중 적어도 어느 하나의 통신망과 무선으로 송수신하는 무선 송수신 장치, 무선 송수신 장치의 송수신 신호를 중계기로 전달하기 위하여 중계기와 라이프 라인으로 정합하는 중계기 정합 장치, 및 무선 송수신 장치 및 중계기 정합 장치를 제어하는 제어 장치로 이루어진다.

title_en: System and method for analyzing cyber security postures and real-time asset validation for critical infrastructure
abstract_en: In an aspect, system and method for analyzing cybersecurity posture for an OT infrastructure is disclosed. The method comprises categorizing a plurality of devices of one or more plants of the OT infrastructure into a plurality of levels, based on an exposure of each device to a communication network, identifying CVEs of components of the plurality of devices, at each level. The method comprises assigning a severity value to the one or more CVEs of components and determining a plant cybersecurity posture score (PCPS) for the one or more plants. The method comprises computing a critical infrastructure cybersecurity posture score for the OT infrastructure. The method comprises applying remediation to one or more vulnerable components based on a prioritization sequence. In another aspect, system and method for real- time asset validation of connected devices in the OT infrastructure is performed based on the device critical parameters, cybersecurity parameters, and functional safety parameters.

title_en: Urban water relation-oriented urban storage and evacuation space optimization method and simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban water storage and drainage space optimization method and an urban water storage and drainage space simulation system, particularly relates to the field of urban water resource management and optimization, and aims to solve the problems of low efficiency and poor response capability of an urban water storage and drainage system, and avoid short-term season influence original data through a long-term and short-term memory network. Analyzing the contribution of the reservoirs in the dispatch network, calculating the comprehensive significance and interaction in combination with the multi-layer network analysis, and evaluating the importance of the reservoirs from multiple dimensions. And identifying a reservoir in a high-pressure area by adopting a clustering optimization method, performing space optimization, enhancing the adjusting capability and relieving the pressure in the high-load area. And combining a self-service method and Monte Carlo simulation test to optimize the reliability of the result, ensuring the stability and consistency of the high-influence area and avoiding accidental judgment. The urban water resource management system realizes the accurate regulation and control of the urban water storage and discharge system, improves the resource scheduling efficiency, ensures the stability and the sustainability of urban water resource management, and provides a scientific and effective optimization scheme.
assignees: FUJIAN FUDA ARCHITECTURAL PLANNING DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Emergency power supply device as accessory for lead-in device
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an emergency power supply device as an accessory for a lead-in device which is useful as a power supply if lifelines are snapped due to the occurrence of disaster, such as earthquakes, does not require much running cost and has a function as a mark for guidance for evacuation.  <P>SOLUTION: The emergency power supply device, as an accessory for the lead-in device 12 for leading a power lead-in wire L into each of buildings H, is provided with: a power generation device 15; a power accumulating device for accumulating power from the power generating device 15; and a control device for converting and/or controlling the power from the power accumulating device.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Tunnel water leakage risk spatial dependency prediction method and prediction system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dynamic sensing and control of water leakage risk of shield tunnels, and discloses a method and a system for predicting spatial dependence of water leakage risk of tunnels, wherein a risk index system influencing the water leakage of a shield tunnel is constructed by analyzing a risk causing mechanism of water leakage; model design: the method comprises the steps of PCBN model Bayesian network structure design, risk index optimal edge distribution identification and fitting; and (3) model verification: and model application comprises water leakage risk evaluation and correlation analysis of risk indexes. The method combines the dynamic reasoning and diagnosis of the Bayesian network model and the Copula theory for the interdependence processing advantages among indexes, establishes the Pair-Copula Bayesian model for shield tunnel water leakage risk assessment, and realizes fitting of the occurrence and development mechanism of water leakage diseases in the actual shield tunnel operation period to the maximum extent, thereby obtaining more accurate risk evaluation results as a risk management real-time decision support tool.

title_en: the building structure for cosmos art gallery
title_ko: 코스모스아트갤러리용 건축구조물
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a building structure for a cosmos art gallery provided as a spiral pentagonal-type building structure capable of providing an infrastructure for tourism resources related to overall viewing, education, music, performances, images and cultural arts experience and performing complex functions in regard to cultural art fields such as astronomical constellation, ancient history, mathematics, sailing, philosophy, ideology and the like among the shining cultural heritage of Korea. The building structure for a cosmos art gallery includes: a work exhibition hall (104) in which an electric pipe facility space (EPS), a machine facility piping space (PS), a communication cable pipe space (TPS), and a fire-fighting alarm valve room (A/V) are arranged and formed in each floor of an art gallery main building (A), an outer side of a center core composed of a floor exhibition space and viewing routes and an inner wall surface is composed of an exhibition wall; a media facade module (102) for astronomical constellation display, in which an outer wall surface of each floor is recessed with one selected from among LED lighting and an LED panel; and a rooftop object (C) in which a media mapping system is installed on a certain spot in one selected from among the inside and outside of a sculpture in which crescent moon, sun and star shapes are vertically and sequentially built in the uppermost part of the rooftop.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 코스모스아트갤러리용 건축구조물에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세히는  우리나라의 빛나는 문화 유산중 천문(天文)관련 별자리,고대사,수리,항해, 철학,사상 등의 문화예술분야의 총체적인 관람, 교육, 음악, 공연, 영상 및 문화예술체험관련 관광자원의 기반시설제공 및 복합적인 기능을 수행할수 있도록 하는 아트갤러리본관 건축구조물로서,센터코어형 구조에 중추기능 집중화로 작품 주제별 배치가 용이하며, 작품관람동선의 순환성과 뷰(view)가 좋으며,평면적으로 유효면적이 증대되는 효과의 평면적 역할 이외에,구조적으로도 골조의 비틀림 저항성능도 확보시키며, 아트갤러리본관 각층은 코스모스아트갤러리용 건축구조물의 모티브를 극대화시키기 위하여,아트갤러리본관의 각층 외벽면을 천문별자리가 디스플레이되는 대형 미디어파사드모듈을 구축함과 동시에; 옥탑에 조성된 초승달,해,별형상의 옥탑오브제에 탑재투영되는 미디어맵핑시스템에 의한 주야간경관 연출에 따른 천문 포토존 제공과 볼꺼리 제공 및 문화예술관련 국내외 각종 전시공간 제공과 더불어 모티브가 천문(天文)인 독창적인 관광으뜸명소로 대두되게 하는 효과를 제공하도록 하는 유용한 발명인 것이다.

title_en: Underground base facilities protection system using DAS system and drone
title_ko: Ｄａｓ 시스템과 드론을 이용한 지중매설 기반 시설 보호 시스템
abstract_en: A system for protecting underground buried infrastructure using a distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) system and a drone is disclosed. The system for protecting underground buried infrastructure using a DAS system and a drone comprises: an integrated control server linked with an underground buried infrastructure management system including pipelines, power and communication cables, gas pipelines, and oil pipelines, and a distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) system using an optical communication cable; and a drone. When the distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) system detects excavation work related to the underground buried infrastructure (pipelines, power and communication cables, gas pipelines, and oil pipelines), the drone is urgently dispatched to arrive at the excavation site of the construction work, transmits camera image data captured by the drone to the integrated control server, and performs a remote warning broadcast to workers using a speaker of the drone to alert them to excavation caution during the construction work, thereby preventing damage to the underground buried infrastructure in advance. The drone includes a GPS receiver, a camera, a directional speaker, and a 13.56 MHz RFID tag. Accordingly, by performing a warning broadcast for construction excavation caution using the speaker of the drone, damage to the underground buried infrastructure can be prevented in advance.
abstract_ko:
DAS 시스템과 드론을 이용한 지중매설 기반 시설 보호 시스템이 개시된다. 
DAS 시스템과 드론을 이용한 지중매설 기반 시설 보호 시스템은 배관, 전력 및 통신 케이블, 가스관, 및 송유관이 포함된 지하매설물 관리 시스템과 광통신 케이블을 이용한 분산 음향 감시(DAS) 시스템과 연동된 통합관제 서버; 및 상기 분산 음향 감시(DAS) 시스템이 지중매설 기반 시설(배관, 전력 및 통신 케이블, 가스관, 송유관)에 관련된 굴착 공사가 감지되면, 드론을 긴급 출동시켜 건설 공사 굴착 현장에 도착하여 드론의 카메라 영상 촬영 데이터를 통합관제 서버로 전송하고, 드론의 스피커를 사용한 작업자들에게 건설 공사 굴착 주의 원격 경고 방송을 하여 상기 지중매설 기반 시설의 손상을 사전에 방지되도록 하며, GPS 수신기와 카메라와 지향성 스피커 및 13.56MHz RFID 태그가 부착된 드론을 포함한다. 따라서, 드론의 스피커를 사용한 건설 공사 굴착 주의 경고 방송을 함으로써 지중매설 기반시설 손상을 사전에 방지한다.

title_en: A kind of modified fire disaster escaping machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of modified fire disaster escaping machines, including the cabinet being installed in floor, escaping rope and rope micro-nano structure are equipped in cabinet, for storing escaping rope, escaping rope can be removed and hang under floor the rope micro-nano structure；Descending lifeline is further included, is declined on escaping rope for survivor along rope for pressing from both sides to invest.Fire fast-escape machine is powered for more people's fast-escapes not against power equipment for it, and survivor is escaped using escaping rope and descending lifeline, simple in structure, easy to operate, and safe and reliable and environmental protection can help survivor quickly to escape from the fire scene；During using this fire fast-escape machine, when life-saving, is short, and since the machine employs brake case automatic slow-down device, during downslide, in personal weight different range, gliding speed can autobalance, it is safe without deceleration in downslide way.

title_en: Anomaly detection method and system based on similarity learning fusion model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent power utilization, and provides an anomaly detection method and system based on a similarity learning fusion model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining electricity utilization information to be detected; carrying out power utilization anomaly detection based on the trained similarity learning fusion model; the training process of the similarity learning fusion model comprises the following steps: constructing a heterogeneous information network based on pre-acquired power data, and simultaneously learning user similarity power consumption behaviors to obtain similarity power consumption behavior groups; grouping based on the similarity power utilization behaviors, and respectively performing context learning on the power utilization behavior data of different groups to obtain power utilization expression vectors of users; capturing the interdependence relation between the similarity grouping vector and the electricity expression vectors of different groups by adopting a graph attention machine mechanism so as to obtain a comprehensive expression vector of a user; constructing a softmax prediction function by utilizing the comprehensive expression vector of the user; and training learning parameters of the similarity learning fusion model based on the loss function of the output value of the softmax prediction function.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power backup system
abstract_en: An electrically powered node of a telecommunications system has a battery power backup associated with its power control unit. Under normal conditions it is maintained fully charged by means of trickle currents from the mains power feeds to each of a number of mains—connected customer equipments, by way of the “final drop” to the distribution point. These trickle currents are controlled by the respective power control units to prevent overcharging. Using an electrical copper connection provided in parallel with the fibre connection, a battery backup can also be maintained in nodes further towards the exchange. The feeds are reversible, so that if a power outage removes the power supply from the customer premises, a “lifeline” plain telephone service between the exchange and the telephone handset is maintained using the local battery backup in the remote nodes. By limiting the service to simple telephony, the battery power can be sufficient to maintain the service for a reasonable duration. The power management systems can be used to transfer charge from one battery to another over the network according to the usage, or remaining life, of each battery.

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance operation management system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent operation and maintenance operation management system based on artificial intelligence, which comprises a multi-source data collection module, a data optimization module, a power plant equipment maintenance prediction model building module and an operation and maintenance intelligent operation management module. The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an intelligent operation and maintenance operation management system based on artificial intelligence, which creatively proposes that equipment is used as a network node, equipment process dependence is used as a directed edge, a network diagram structure is constructed for equipment maintenance, and a risk transmission chain among different equipment can be effectively identified, so that the operation and maintenance management of a power plant is changed from local prediction to global association modeling; by adopting a direct and indirect double-layer spatial dependency joint modeling mechanism, the direct spatial dependency models the explicit process relationship between adjacent devices through a graph attention network, the indirect spatial dependency models the implicit relationship of non-adjacent devices through a spatial attention mechanism, the prediction precision is improved, and the accuracy of an intelligent operation and maintenance operation decision is improved.

title_en: DC power distribution network benefit evaluation system and method for infrastructure network access
abstract_en: The utility model adopts a neural network model based on deep learning to excavate time sequence cooperative difference correlation characteristic information of using cost and utility value of a plurality of infrastructures under the condition of accessing a direct current power distribution network in time dimension, so as to accurately evaluate the network access benefit of the plurality of infrastructures accessing the direct current power distribution network, thereby realizing comprehensive benefit quantification of the whole life cycle of the multi-main-participated direct current power grid resources.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Urban road network toughness measurement method under multi-layer traffic network dependence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring the toughness of an urban road network under the dependence of a multilayer traffic network, which comprises the following steps: collecting space vector data of urban roads, subways and public transport networks; mapping different spatial layer data into a multi-layer network model formed by nodes and edges; gradually removing the road network connecting edge and other traffic network lines connected with the road network connecting edge; and drawing a relation curve between the road network structure index and the removal proportion under the connection support of the different traffic layer networks, and comparing the phase change threshold value and disaster-bearing capacity change of the space structure of the road network under the support of the different traffic layer networks. The invention builds the interconnection model and the toughness measurement model of the road network and other multi-layer traffic networks, can reveal complex mechanisms of the mutual support and the destructive propagation of the road network and the traffic network, can identify key threshold values and important areas of the road space structure change under the multi-layer traffic support, and provides a technical tool for accurately measuring the toughness of the urban road network.

title_en: Lifeline differential planning method for improving toughness of urban power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lifeline differentiation planning method for improving toughness of an urban power grid, and belongs to the technical field of power grid planning methods. A life line differentiation planning method for improving toughness of an urban power grid comprises the steps of constructing a local power grid limit survival capacity quantification index, quantifying power supply guarantee levels of loads with different importance levels in an extreme fault scene, based on an improved commodity flow model, establishing multi-path power supply topology constraint applicable to the loads with different importance levels, guaranteeing requirements of the life line loads on power supply path redundancy, establishing an urban power grid life line differentiation planning model, and realizing optimal construction of a multi-level local power grid through local power grid boundary division, resource allocation and level constraint. The lifeline differentiated planning method for improving the toughness of the urban power grid can solve the problem that the existing method can not well realize the grade load differentiated guarantee under the limited resource condition.

title_en: Multi-time space supply and demand risk identification method for electric power system based on scene simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a scene simulation-based multi-time space supply and demand risk identification method for an electric power system, which comprises a data acquisition preprocessing unit, a risk identification module, a scene simulation module, a dynamic mapping module, an acquisition and prediction model, a time-varying relation network and a machine learning model, wherein the data acquisition preprocessing unit is used for generating a database with space-time labels to construct an electric power network model, the risk identification module and the scene simulation module are used for displaying risk and adequacy data of each region and each time period in a thermodynamic diagram and distribution diagram form to form an electric power network fluctuation area, different variables in the electric power network system are acquired to generate dynamic nodes, interdependence relations among the variables form edges among the nodes, the time-varying relation network of each time period is constructed, the time-varying relation network is combined with the machine learning model to construct a prediction model reflecting nonlinear dynamic change of the electric power network, the prediction model of the nonlinear dynamic change is constructed to adjust the electric power network model, and the evaluation precision of the space-time distribution of the electric power network is guaranteed, and the method has the advantages of establishing the time-varying relation network, improving the prediction precision and response speed and precisely capturing risk factors.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Reverse powering system for telecommunications node
abstract_en: To initiate the transmission of electrical power over a telecommunications connection from a power-collecting telecommunications interface unit o such as a customer premises equipment, connectable to a power supply, to a power-receiving unit such as a curbside electrical/optical interface, when a connection is first established, or the collecting unit is first powered up, or in order to re-establish connection alter a power outage, control signals are transmitted between low-power modems in the interlace units using a low-power communications protocol. This allows the controlled initiation of a larger power output and a higher speed exchange of data once the full telecommunications connection has been established. A low-powered beacon signal is transmitted over the telecommunications connection by the power-collecting telecommunications interface unit on connection to a power supply, for detection by the power-receiving telecommunications interface unit. In the event of a loss of power at the input, the low power modem initiates power management control signals to cause the power-receiving telecommunications interface to shut down certain functions in order to preserve backup power for essential “lifeline” services.

title_en: A kind of vertical lifeline at shock insulation seam
abstract_en: A kind of vertical lifeline at shock insulation seam disclosed by the utility model, including left column steel pipe and right column steel pipe, left built-in fitting and right built-in fitting, upper left location tray and lower-left location tray, upper right location tray and bottom right location tray, upper left rotating casing and lower-left rotating casing, upper right rotating casing and bottom right rotating casing, left frame vertical steel pipe and left frame vertical steel pipe, upper horizontal rails steel pipe and lower horizontal rails steel pipe, intermediate vertical steel pipe.When an earthquake occurs, upper left rotating casing and lower-left rotating casing can be rotated relative to left column steel pipe, upper right rotating casing and bottom right rotating casing can be rotated relative to right column steel pipe, upper horizontal rails steel pipe, lower horizontal rails steel pipe can Free water smoothly move, to realize in seismic process, any direction movement can planar occur with both sides beam slab for the lifeline at shock insulation seam, and lifeline is in protection state always.

title_en: Dynamic contingency avoidance and mitigation system
abstract_en: The disclosed subject matter provides systems and methods for allocating resources within an infrastructure, such as an electrical grid, in response to changes to inputs and output demands on the infrastructure, such as energy sources and sinks. A disclosed system includes one or more processors, each having respective communication interfaces to receive data from the infrastructure, the data comprising infrastructure network data, one or more software applications, operatively coupled to and at least partially controlling the one or more processors, to process and characterize the infrastructure network data; and a display, coupled to said one or more processors, for visually presenting a depiction of at least a portion of the infrastructure including any changes in condition thereof, and one or more controllers in communication with the one or more processors, to manage processing of the resource, wherein the resource is obtained and/or distributed based on the characterization of said real time infrastructure data.

title_en: Vulnerability assessment method based on mixed transmission allocation factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vulnerability assessment method based on mixed transmission allocation factors, which belongs to the technical field of interdependent network vulnerability assessment and comprises the steps of constructing a coupling system model comprising an electric power network layer, a hydrogen energy network layer and a logistics network layer, respectively calculating the transmission allocation factors of the electric power network layer, the hydrogen energy network layer and the logistics network layer, establishing an interlayer sensitivity coupling relation through a coupling weight matrix, forming a global mixed transmission allocation factor (MTDF) matrix by adopting a layered sensitivity calculation and cross-layer coupling mapping technology, realizing cross-layer influence quantification of new energy output fluctuation, automatically identifying key fragile nodes and establishing a cascading fault propagation model, and solving the technical problem of assessing the coupling vulnerability of a three-layer network of a green harbor electric power-hydrogen energy-logistics by calculating L2 norm to propose a vulnerability assessment index before and after a fault.

title_en: Cascade fault analysis method based on digital twin and physical power and related components
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure analysis method and related components based on digital twin and physical power, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a double-layer coupling network model through a digital twin virtual network and a physical power network; setting a cascading failure propagation process through the load information of the digital twin virtual network and the physical power network and a preset load redistribution strategy, so as to construct a multi-layer network cascading failure model, updating the multi-layer network cascading failure model according to the communication delay between the digital twin virtual network and the physical power network to obtain a target cascading failure model, and carrying out cascading failure analysis on a specified power system by utilizing the target cascading failure model. The invention is based on the coupling symbiosis between the digital twin virtual network and the physical power network, and combines communication delay to construct the target cascading failure model, and the analysis accuracy and reliability of the cascading failure of the power system can be effectively improved through the target cascading failure model.

title_en: Transverse elastic limiting and longitudinal hydraulic fusing damping combined support system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transverse elastic limiting and longitudinal hydraulic fusing damping combined support system. The longitudinal restraint of a hydraulic fusing damping support and the transverse restraint of a limiting height adjusting rubber support are adopted. The hydraulic fusing damping support is located between the top of a first main pier and the bottom of a main beam, wherein the first main pier and the main beam are located on the same side of a midspan. The limiting height adjusting rubber support is located between the inner side of an arch springing and the outer side of the main beam. A second main pier opposite to the first main pier is provided with a two-way movable spherical steel support. The longitudinal restraint is in the locking state under normal circumstances, it is ensured that the longitudinal restraint is achieved under the effect of braking force and track force in the using period, unlocking is achieved in an earthquake, the damping effect is achieved, and locking is recovered after the earthquake. Transverse restraint ensures that transverse limiting is achieved in the using period, the support is not disengaged, and transverse earthquake force can be reduced. Under the effect of the earthquake and the rare occurrence earthquake, both the pier body and the foundation work within the elastic range, the earthquake intensity which a bridge can resist is greatly improved, connecting of traffic lifelines at key transportation nodes is kept, and the important effect on earthquake relief is achieved.

title_en: A kind of Lifesaving Heaving Device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Lifesaving Heaving Device, comprise handle, described handle is provided with trigger component, the upper rear end of handle is provided with gun stock assembly, and the front end, top of handle is provided with cylinder, is provided with emitting module in described cylinder, there is transmitting sleeve pipe the front end of described cylinder, described transmitting sleeve pipe be provided with body, the rear end of described cylinder is provided with the emission control valve coordinating emitting module, described emission control valve connect by felting needle mechanism the gas cylinder being arranged on rear end.The utility model Lifesaving Heaving Device is used for jettisoning at a distance lifeline, buoy quoit, remote water survival can be realized, also be suitable for the shooting rope operation that civilian, police, military, fire-fighting, ship-to-ship, ship to shore, high building or mountain stream etc. rescue occasion simultaneously, and it is of the present utility model lightweight, be easy to carry, novel in structural design is compact, and range is large.

title_en: Risk management support system for electric power infrastructure
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a risk management support system for electric power infrastructure to determine social risk generated by the power supply construction based on power supply construction information performed on a lifeline forming an electric power infrastructure.  <P>SOLUTION: The risk management support system (100) for electric power infrastructure includes a storage section (150) for storing an power supply construction risk master table (152) for matching power supply construction with the risk at a point where the power supply construction is performed and power supply construction risk link information (154) for matching the power supply construction with the risk at at least one remote place separated from the point caused by the power supply construction, an information acquiring section (112) for acquiring the power supply construction information, and a risk calculating section (114) for calculating social risk generated by an objective construction included in the power supply construction information referring to the table and link information based on the acquired power supply construction information.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: System for evaluating environmental load of steel box girder bridge (stb), and method for the same
title_ko: 강박스교의 환경부하량 평가 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system for evaluating an environmental load of a steel box girder bridge, and a method thereof, which among various infrastructures such as water and sewerage, railroad, dam, port, airport, and the like, the most frequently applied steel box is selected for roads to evaluate an environmental load in each of the planning, design, and maintenance stages of single and complex facilities, and establishes a standard quantity-based environmental load evaluation model which can evaluate the environmental load with only basic design information to evaluate the environmental load at the design stage of the steel box bridge, so that reliability compared to the existing environmental load evaluation model can be improved, and constructs a maintenance environmental load evaluation model to evaluate the environmental load at the maintenance stage of the steel box bridge, so that reliability compared to the existing environmental load assessment model is provided.
abstract_ko: 상하수도, 철도, 댐, 항만, 공항 등 다양한 사회기반시설물 중에서 도로를 대상으로 가장 적용빈도가 높은 강박스를 선정하여 단일 시설물과 복합 시설물의 기획단계, 설계단계 및 유지관리단계 각각의 환경부하량 평가를 실시할 수 있고, 또한, 기본적인 설계정보만으로 환경부하량을 평가할 수 있는 표준물량-기반 환경부하량 평가모델을 구축하여 강박스교의 설계단계 환경부하량을 평가함으로써 기존의 환경부하량 평가모델에 비해 신뢰성을 향상시킬 수 있으며, 또한, 유지관리 환경부하 평가모델을 구축하여 강박스교의 유지관리단계 환경부하량을 평가함으로써 기존의 환경부하량 평가모델에 비해 신뢰성을 향상시킬 수 있는, 강박스교의 환경부하량 평가 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: System and Method for Analyzing Cyber Security Postures and Real-Time Asset Validation for Critical Infrastructure
abstract_en: A system and method for analyzing cybersecurity posture for an OT infrastructure includes categorizing a plurality of devices of one or more plants into levels, based on an exposure of each device to a communication network, identifying CVEs of components of the plurality of devices; assigning a severity value to the one or more CVEs of components and determining a plant cybersecurity posture score for the one or more plants; computing a critical infrastructure cybersecurity posture score for the OT infrastructure; and applying remediation to one or more vulnerable components based on a prioritization sequence.

title_en: System and method for analyzing cyber security postures and real-time asset validation for critical infrastructure
abstract_en: In an aspect, system and method for analyzing cybersecurity posture for an OT infrastructure is disclosed. The method comprises categorizing a plurality of devices of one or more plants of the OT infrastructure into a plurality of levels, based on an exposure of each device to a communication network, identifying CVEs of components of the plurality of devices, at each level. The method comprises assigning a severity value to the one or more CVEs of components and determining a plant cybersecurity posture score (PCPS) for the one or more plants. The method comprises computing a critical infrastructure cybersecurity posture score for the OT infrastructure. The method comprises applying remediation to one or more vulnerable components based on a prioritization sequence. In another aspect, system and method for real- time asset validation of connected devices in the OT infrastructure is performed based on the device critical parameters, cybersecurity parameters, and functional safety parameters.

title_en: Photovoltaic module profit prediction model system and method based on big data model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic module profit prediction model system and a photovoltaic module profit prediction method based on a big data model. The modules cooperate with each other to realize data collection, integration, modeling and analysis. The invention has the characteristic of real-time updating, can adapt to the dynamic change of the photovoltaic market, and provides more reliable support for the decision of the photovoltaic industry. The method comprises the steps of data acquisition and cleaning, multi-source data fusion and feature extraction, construction and training of a prediction model, real-time data access and model updating, prediction result display and decision support and the like. The steps are related and interdependent, accurate prediction and intelligent decision support of the benefits of the photovoltaic module are realized through refined operation and efficient algorithm support, and powerful support is provided for sustainable development of the photovoltaic industry.
assignees: THE FIRST CONSTRUCTION INSTALLATION CO LTD OF CHINA CONSTRUCTION THIRD ENG BUREAU

title_en: Supply chain risk dynamic early warning method and system based on time sequence data association analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supply chain risk dynamic early warning method and system based on time sequence data association analysis, wherein the system comprises a perception layer, an analysis layer and an application layer; the sensing layer comprises sensors applied to various links of a supply chain, the analysis layer comprises a time sequence data processing module, a dynamic dependency modeling module and a real-time risk calculation module, the application layer comprises an intelligent early warning module, and when the comprehensive risk score obtained by the real-time risk calculation module reaches a corresponding early warning threshold value, the intelligent early warning module is triggered and timely sends early warning information out through integrating different communication interfaces. The invention forms an intelligent and closed-loop industrial monitoring and diagnosis system through various front edge technologies, realizes transition from passive response to active prediction, accurate positioning, quick treatment and root cause treatment, and provides a powerful technical support for ensuring the safe, stable and efficient operation of complex systems.
assignees: CHENGDU JIUZHOU ELECTRONIC INF SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Urban lifeline pipeline risk identification method based on GIS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GIS-based urban lifeline pipeline risk identification method which comprises the steps of S1, collecting underground water initial data, metal mineral initial data, pipeline data, engineering longitude and latitude coordinates and population distribution map data, preprocessing, S2, extracting underground environment characteristics through a convolution layer, updating a preprocessed pipeline map model to obtain an updated pipeline map model, constructing an improved double-gate map neural network, extracting fusion characteristics of all pipelines, S3, extracting construction influence characteristics of the pipelines and population risk characteristics of the pipelines, combining the fusion characteristics of all the pipelines, extracting comprehensive risk characteristics, converting the comprehensive risk characteristics into risk grades, and S4, calculating the pipeline risk map model and identifying and displaying in a GIS platform. The method can solve the problems that the traditional method has low inspection efficiency, is difficult to combine multi-source heterogeneous data, and further cannot realize accurate risk identification of urban lifeline pipelines.

title_en: Method for constructing reliability evaluation and maintenance optimization model of offshore wind farm in Internet of things background
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing a reliability evaluation and maintenance optimization model of an offshore wind power plant in the background of the Internet of things, which can effectively solve the problem that the whole power grid is affected once the transmission process of the power grid is interrupted in the prior art; according to the characteristics of a layered architecture of the Internet of things and an offshore wind farm, a multi-layer network model of the offshore wind farm is built, a shape parameter change model, a fan and component reliability model thereof are built according to temperature data and wind speed data, and a perception layer node reliability evaluation model is built; according to the wind turbine fault sequence and distance, the offshore wind farm radius maintenance optimization model is established, the reliability of the sensing layer nodes and the communication path is evaluated, the fan fault time is predicted, and further the maintenance scheme is optimized, so that the operation and maintenance management of the offshore wind power network is intelligently maintained, and the method is an innovation on the offshore wind farm reliability evaluation and maintenance optimization model.

title_en: Flush toilet facility for evacuation destinations
abstract_en: To provide a flush toilet facility for emergency use in the event of an unforeseen emergency, such as flooding of houses due to overflowing rivers or landslides caused by torrential rains that cut off lifelines, including electricity, water and sewage, and require several days for recovery.SOLUTION: A flush toilet facility that can be used as a flush toilet in normal times and as a disaster toilet that can be used even when water and sewage and electricity are not available in an emergency comprises a toilet bowl 3, a water storage tank 2 located above the toilet bowl, and a sewage storage tank 1 located below the toilet bowl. The sewage storage tank is a vertical tank, and its internal side surface is formed in a tapered shape (also called a cone shape) from a suitable height toward a bottom surface, and a discharge port 8 is provided at a tip portion thereof. The discharge port is held in the open state of a funnel plug 6 suspended from an upper part of the sewage storage tank in normal times, and in the closed state by the funnel plug in an emergency.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Power backup system
abstract_en: An electrically powered node of a telecommunications system has a battery power backup associated with its power control unit. Under normal conditions it is maintained fully charged by means of trickle currents from the mains power feeds to each of a number of mains—connected customer equipments, by way of the “final drop” to the distribution point. These trickle currents are controlled by the respective power control units, to prevent overcharging. Using an electrical copper connection provided in parallel with the fibre connection, a battery backup can also be maintained in nodes further towards the exchange. The feeds are reversible, so that if a power outage removes the power supply from the customer premises, a “lifeline” plain telephone service between the exchange and the telephone handset is maintained using the local battery backup in the remote nodes. By limiting the service to simple telephony, the battery power can be sufficient to maintain the service for a reasonable duration. The power management systems can be used to transfer charge from one battery to another over the network according to the usage, or remaining life, of each battery.

title_en: A kind of multi-functional Quick rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of multi-functional Quick rescue device, comprise top hook, descending lifeline, safety belt, sit band, GPS positioning lamp combining structure, backrest, gas defence fire prevention head-shield, described multi-functional Quick rescue device is configured with top hook, descending lifeline, gas defence fire prevention head-shield and bottom carrier combination structure, be connected with seat band bottom backrest in the carrier combination structure of described bottom, backrest top is fallen rope be connected with descending lifeline by slow, the slow rope that falls is provided with gas defence fire prevention head-shield, in described multi-functional Quick rescue device, the material of each parts all has good fire resistance, tension and wear resistance, described GPS positioning lamp facilitates user to determine position, be beneficial to rescue personnel to search and rescue, described descending lifeline controls decrease speed automatically, between velocity interval 0.5-1.5m/s, adaptive performance is had to weight, the duplicate protection of both shoulders protecting band and safety belt is had in user's use procedure, gas defence fire prevention head-shield can in time by toxic smoke and user isolation, reach lifesaving object.

title_en: Systems and methods for emergency prevention and control for urban lifeline gas pipelines during flooding based on a large model
abstract_en: A system for emergency prevention and control for urban lifeline gas pipelines during flooding based on a large model is provided. The system includes an emergency supervision-management platform configured to: construct a gas pipeline network map based on pipeline pressures and gas flow rates of a plurality of pipeline nodes; determine a plurality of suspected leakage points and a plurality of leakage confidence levels of the plurality of suspected leakage points; perform an evaluating process on each suspected leakage point; determine, based on a plurality of corrosion risks and a plurality of deformation risks of the plurality of suspected leakage points, a comprehensive risk of a target pipeline node using a prediction model; and in response to the comprehensive risk meeting a drainage condition, automatically send a control signal to a drainage robot to drive the drainage robot to carry out drainage.
assignees: CHENGDU QINCHUAN IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid project risk assessment system and method integrating Pareto and Borda rules
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid project risk assessment system and method integrating Pareto and Borda rules, and belongs to the technical field of project risk assessment. The system comprises a multi-dimensional risk interaction relation identification module, a risk interaction weight generation module, a risk ranking and Pareto processing module and a multiparty dynamic game decision module, wherein the multi-dimensional risk interaction relation identification module is used for analyzing the interdependence relation among all risk factors of a target power grid project and constructing a multi-dimensional risk relation network map, the risk interaction weight generation module is used for determining interaction weights among all the risk factors, the risk ranking and Pareto processing module is used for ranking all the risk factors based on a Pareto analysis method to obtain a preliminary risk priority ranking list and key risk factors, and the multiparty dynamic game decision module is used for performing game decision on ranking schemes of a plurality of project participants based on a Borda rule and combining the preliminary risk priority ranking list to obtain a final risk priority ranking list. The risk ranking method and the risk ranking device can improve the rationality of risk ranking, and based on the ranking result, the effect of risk assessment on the items can be improved.

title_en: A kind of horizontal rails device at shock insulation seam
abstract_en: A kind of horizontal rails device at shock insulation seam disclosed by the utility model, including left column steel pipe and right column steel pipe, left built-in fitting and right built-in fitting, left rotary shaft loose-leaf and right spindle loose-leaf, left vertical steel pipe and right vertical steel pipe, several left horizontal steel tubes and several right horizontal steel tubes identical with left horizontal steel tube quantity.When an earthquake occurs, pass through the left rotary shaft loose-leaf and right spindle loose-leaf respectively with left column steel pipe and right column fastener for connection, left horizontal steel tube and right horizontal steel tube be in always same straight line can Free water smoothly move, to realize in seismic process, any direction movement can planar occur with both sides beam slab for the lifeline at shock insulation seam, and lifeline is in protection state always.

title_en: Modeling coupling method for electric power information physical system based on interdependence network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a modeling coupling method of an electric power information physical system based on an interdependence network, which comprises the following steps: establishing a power grid model according to a complex network theory, and calculating to obtain a power grid adjacency matrix; establishing an information network model according to a complex network theory, and calculating to obtain an information network adjacency matrix; establishing an information physical dependent model based on an inherent self-similar coupling theory, and constructing a topological structure of the electric power information physical system based on an electric power network and an information network adjacency matrix; and establishing a power grid and information network weight model based on the topological structure of the power information physical system and the power flow distribution characteristic of the power system, and obtaining corresponding line weights for reflecting the occupation condition of each line. According to the invention, on the basis of considering the power flow distribution characteristics of the power system, the analysis index is put forward to build the weight model, so that the model has more power characteristics, the model with higher coupling degree between the power network and the information network is obtained, and the energy is more reasonably scheduled.

title_en: Repair staff calling system, method and program
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To make contact for quickly calling repair work staff when an accident occurs in a public service business using an infrastructure network.  <P>SOLUTION: A repair staff calling system includes an accident information acquisition section 21 for acquiring accident information including the content and the location of the accident; a power distribution network information storage section 41; a required staff decision section 27 for deciding the number of staffs necessary for the repairing the accident concerned; a staff information storage section 42 for storing staff information; a meeting spot determination section 29 for determining a staff meeting spot; a staff location information reception section 28 for receiving present staff location information from a communication means carried by each staff; a distance decision section 30 for deciding the distance between each staff and the meeting spot; and a call staff determination section for determining staffs satisfying the number of staffs decided by the required staff decision section, as staffs to be called from among staffs who is decided by the distance decision section 30 to be located within a predetermined distance.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Multi-state association infrastructure network elasticity optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network elasticity optimization method for a multi-state association infrastructure, which comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting the structure and operation information of a related infrastructure network; step 2, establishing an operation strategy optimization model of the associated network; step 3, establishing a two-stage stochastic programming model; step 4, processing the two-stage random programming model into a mixed integer linear programming model; step 5, generating a large number of disaster scenes by using a Monte Carlo simulation method and reducing the number of the generated scenes by using a scene reduction technology; step 6, solving the two-stage random programming model after the linearization treatment by adopting an L-shaped method; and 7, solving the optimal protection strategy of the first-stage associated network and displaying the optimal protection strategy in an image mode. The invention can help a decision maker to seek the optimal protection strategy of the transport node and the link of the associated infrastructure network, improve the overall elasticity and the capacity of meeting the requirement of the associated network to the maximum extent, and reduce the influence of various disaster events.

title_en: Waterworks asset management system
title_ko: 상수도 자산관리 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a waterworks asset management system, which can determine remaining service life of an asset using a failure mode, and can perform waterworks asset management more accurately by evaluating degree of danger of the asset on the basis of performance using business risk exposure (BRE), and also, can be linked with a geographic information system (GIS) easily by providing a waterworks asset management framework and a platform thereof corresponding to a domestic electronic government standard framework, and can be used in asset evaluation easily by being commercialized according to the real state of a local government, and also, can comply with an international standard by composing the waterworks asset management frame work on the basis of a framework of an international asset management standard (ISO55000) and an international infrastructure asset management manual (IIMM).

title_en: Water supply-energy supply coupling planning method for industrial park
abstract_en: The invention provides a water supply-energy supply coupling planning method for an industrial park, which comprises the following steps: step 1: firstly, respectively establishing a power distribution network model, a heat supply network model and a water distribution network model; step 2: based on the established model, a coupling planning model of the interdependent and acting water-energy contact network is established, and a specific planning model with a mutual coupling relation is established by combining with a coupling element; and step 3: and constructing a mixed integer nonlinear programming model taking the total investment operation cost as an objective function by combining a water-energy network, carrying out optimization solution on the model through an IPOPT solver, providing an optimal energy supply scheme, and exploring how to reasonably configure energy storage and water storage equipment to optimize the investment operation cost. The invention provides a new direction for the combined planning under the coupling action of energy and resources, and the coupled operation planning model of the energy and the resources has good social significance for building an intelligent integrated social comprehensive energy and resource network in the future.

title_en: Method and device for predicting landslide instability of reservoir area
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for predicting landslide instability in a reservoir area, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining porosity, cohesive force and sliding mass density of target landslide sliding belt soil, establishing a normal stress and rate dependency model according to rate dependency data of residual friction coefficients of the sliding belt soil, coupling to obtain a combined model, dispersing the target landslide into cylinders, calculating dead weight stress, hydrostatic pressure, superporous water pressure, water resistance, floating force, dynamic friction resistance and cohesive force of each cylinder, listing and solving a dynamic balance equation to obtain landslide acceleration of each cylinder, calculating initial motion state of each cylinder by taking rapid downward sliding moment of the landslide as an initial time point, iteratively calculating motion state, acceleration and speed of each cylinder at all moments, obtaining friction coefficients through experimental data and combining the superporous water pressure, and accurately calculating the motion speed of the target landslide.

title_en: Disaster/accident prevention mouse
abstract_en: To solve the problem that since power failure can occur in a big disaster that happens suddenly, security of lighting is mandatory not only for the sake of security but also for the sake of mental stability, it can be that people are not able to shout out when asking for rescue, but a battery capacity of a portable telephone for calling for rescue becomes insufficient, which does not allow lighting of the portable phone to be used for secure lighting easily.SOLUTION: As a solution, it is considered that items we are usually familiar with is best when they are available during a rare disaster. A PC is normally used for business in an office and by providing a mouse of the PC with equipment for disaster prevention, security of lighting, a large volume of buzzer, and charging a smartphone as one of lifelines become possible when power failure occurs, so that it is possible to operate portable telephones for many hours. The multifunctional emergency kit has multiple functions, small volume and light weight, is convenient for carrying and operation, and the like, and can be widely used in emergency rescue, disaster relief and daily use for families or organizations.

title_en: System and method for power outage and restoration notification in an advanced metering infrastructure network
abstract_en: A method and system are provided to transmit a meter power status. The method includes recognizing a power status change at a meter. The method includes, if the meter is scheduled to transmit first, transmitting a notification message to at least one neighboring meter towards a mesh gate, wherein the notification message includes a power status indicator and a meter identifier. The method includes, if the meter is not scheduled to transmit first, waiting a predetermined time period to receive a notification message from at least one neighboring meter. The method includes, responsive to receiving a notification message, adding a meter identifier to the received notification message before retransmitting the modified notification message to at least one neighboring meter. The method includes retransmitting the notification message.

title_en: A kind of ecological farm field system

title_en: Urban traffic lifeline construction method and system in extreme stormy weather
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a system for constructing an urban traffic life line in extreme stormy weather, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out rainstorm waterlogging simulation; removing waterlogging invalid road sections, and carrying out traffic simulation on the reserved effective road network to obtain severely congested road sections; according to the traffic accident data, analyzing black spots of urban road accidents, and obtaining a high-risk road section; combining the results of storm waterlogging simulation, traffic simulation and urban road accident black spot analysis, and identifying an initial traffic life line set; judging whether the traffic life line set meets the expected requirement, if so, outputting the urban traffic life line set in extreme stormwater weather, otherwise, perfecting the water drainage waterlogging prevention facility with the aim of recovering the use function of part of the invalid road sections, and re-identifying the corrected traffic life line set until the corrected traffic life line set meets the requirement. The method and the system are beneficial to identifying and perfecting the life line of the urban traffic and improving the disaster resistance capability of the urban traffic in extreme stormwater weather.

title_en: Active power distribution network forward push back generation tide optimization calculation method, medium and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forward push back generation tide optimization calculation method, medium and equipment for an active power distribution network, which relate to the technical field of power distribution network analysis, operation and control, and are characterized in that an active power distribution network is constructed based on a physical connection structure of the active power distribution network, and layered to obtain a multi-layer network; predicting iteration times based on parameters of a multi-layer network and corresponding association coefficients to obtain the lowest iteration times, calculating a PV node sensitivity impedance matrix based on all node attributes in the network, judging whether the current iteration times reach the lowest iteration times after forward-pushing back substitution is carried out on the active power distribution network, stopping iteration based on node voltage convergence or iteration times upper limit judgment if the current iteration times reach the lowest iteration times, obtaining a calculation result, and continuing iteration if the current iteration times do not reach the lowest iteration times. By means of the minimum iteration number prediction, the efficient PV node sensitivity impedance matrix construction method and the dynamic optimized relaxation factor, on the premise of guaranteeing calculation accuracy, efficiency and robustness of forward push back power flow calculation of the active power distribution network are remarkably improved.

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance operation management system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent operation and maintenance operation management system based on artificial intelligence, which comprises a multi-source data collection module, a data optimization module, a power plant equipment maintenance prediction model building module and an operation and maintenance intelligent operation management module. The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an intelligent operation and maintenance operation management system based on artificial intelligence, which creatively proposes that equipment is used as a network node, equipment process dependence is used as a directed edge, a network diagram structure is constructed for equipment maintenance, and a risk transmission chain among different equipment can be effectively identified, so that the operation and maintenance management of a power plant is changed from local prediction to global association modeling; by adopting a direct and indirect double-layer spatial dependency joint modeling mechanism, the direct spatial dependency models the explicit process relationship between adjacent devices through a graph attention network, the indirect spatial dependency models the implicit relationship of non-adjacent devices through a spatial attention mechanism, the prediction precision is improved, and the accuracy of an intelligent operation and maintenance operation decision is improved.

title_en: System and method for power outage and restoration notification in an advanced metering infrastructure network
abstract_en: A method and system are provided to transmit a meter power status. The method includes recognizing a power status change at a meter. The method includes, if the meter is scheduled to transmit first, transmitting a notification message to at least one neighboring meter towards a mesh gate, wherein the notification message includes a power status indicator and a meter identifier. The method includes, if the meter is not scheduled to transmit first, waiting a predetermined time period to receive a notification message from at least one neighboring meter. The method includes, responsive to receiving a notification message, adding a meter identifier to the received notification message before retransmitting the modified notification message to at least one neighboring meter. The method includes retransmitting the notification message.

title_en: System and method for analyzing cyber security postures and real-time asset validation for critical infrastructure
abstract_en: In an aspect, system and method for analyzing cybersecurity posture for an OT infrastructure is disclosed. The method comprises categorizing a plurality of devices of one or more plants of the OT infrastructure into a plurality of levels, based on an exposure of each device to a communication network, identifying CVEs of components of the plurality of devices, at each level. The method comprises assigning a severity value to the one or more CVEs of components and determining a plant cybersecurity posture score (PCPS) for the one or more plants. The method comprises computing a critical infrastructure cybersecurity posture score for the OT infrastructure. The method comprises applying remediation to one or more vulnerable components based on a prioritization sequence. In another aspect, system and method for real- time asset validation of connected devices in the OT infrastructure is performed based on the device critical parameters, cybersecurity parameters, and functional safety parameters.

title_en: Power-aware dfos deployment a hybrid heuristic and integer linear programming strategy
abstract_en: A novel, two-stage Distributed Fiber Optic Sensor (DFOS) placement strategy and method that ensures resilient monitoring of critical infrastructure during electrical power supply failures. This strategy and method combines a heuristic algorithm, PURE (Power Source-aware Route Exploration), with Integer Linear Programming (ILP) optimization. The PURE algorithm explores potential DFOS routes while explicitly considering the dependency of DFOS devices on the electrical power distribution network, ensuring routes electrically powered by the same electrical power feeder are disjoint. Subsequently, the ILP selects the optimal set of DFOS placements to minimize the total number of deployed sensors while meeting critical infrastructure monitoring requirements, such as redundant monitoring for high-importance links. The method enhances the observability of critical links, achieving 100% monitoring coverage for important links during simulated power outages affecting an electric feeder.

title_en: Electrical safety emergency response systems and related methods
abstract_en: An electrical safety system and method is provided which includes a flexible electrical safety vest, a lifeline coupled with the vest in various configurations, and leg straps. The electrical safety vest includes a number of loops which are used to couple the lifeline in a variety of relationships that enable different types of maneuvering of a worker with relation to a hazard. Various embodiments of the invention can be used to rapidly and safety remove a worker from proximity to an immediate threat to their life, health, or safety. Direct and indirect extraction from a danger are enabled. A variety of methods are also provided for operating various embodiments of the invention.

title_en: Use of composite particles for protecting a lifeline structure against seismic wave damage
abstract_en: Composite particles of a hard core coated by a layer of hydratable, swellable clay such as bentonite are useful for constructing, modifying and/or supporting lifeline structure such as dams, berms and levees, and/or pipelines or conduits for oil, gas, sewage, water, or cables or wires for transmission of electrical power or data information. The method involves placing the composite particles in a location within, below, or about the lifeline structure, and hydrating them to cause them to swell and fill and seal the voids around the structure to form a resilient support having a high damping ratio and low hydraulic conductivity that is maintained after exposure to strain forces. The composite particles are advantageous in damping seismic waves and reducing the potential damage from an earthquake, explosion, tremor, fatigue loading, or similar seismic event.
